plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的每条回复下面加一行：本次问答花了多少钱 + 账户余额（充值/礼金分开列，没有礼金就只显示充值余额）。鼠标悬停时显示饼图。按该轮 token 用量乘官方峰谷单价计算，内置节假日表；算不出价就写明原因，不静默出错。插件自身不联网（余额由 dsh 宿主查询）、不落盘、无依赖。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-cost-receipt [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/divineeagleblackhand/dsh-cost-receipt) 在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）每条回复下面加一行：**本次问答花了多少钱**，以及账户余额。鼠标悬停可看费用构成的饼图，按花费占比画。 ``` 本次问答花费 ¥0.165824 账户余额 ¥6.2164 礼金余额 ¥1.5366 ``` ## 特点 - **按"一问一答"计价**：每条回复下面一行，看的是刚才这一问花了多少。历史轮次也有数字，按它当时的时段定价，打开旧会话照样算得出来。 - **余额拆成两个数**：`账户余额`只算充值余额，`礼金余额`另起一项，相加才是钱包总额。没有礼金时第二项不显示。余额只出现在每条对话的最新一轮（历史轮次显示当时的钱没有意义）。 - **悬停看费用构成**：本次问答与整场对话**并排两个环，按花费占比画**，不是 token 占比。因为缓存命中的 token 通常占 99%，却只占不到四成花费；按 token 画会退化成一个看不见的细弧。 - **算不出价就写明原因**，绝不静默出错：角标会直接写 `未收录模型 xxx`、`混用多模型（a + b）`、`用量未标注模型`。拿别的模型的单价硬套会错好几倍，而且看不出来。 - **角标上的时刻表示"未变"，不是"刚读过"**：宿主会缓存账号查询，所以那个 `HH:MM:SS` 是**余额上次变化的时刻** —— 时刻不动＝数字没再变过。鼠标悬停还能看到**最后一次查询时刻**，两个一对比就知道是读数陈旧、还是余额真的没动。 ## 安装 从 npm 装（推荐：名字短，还能锁版本）： ``` dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-cost-receipt ``` 或直接从 GitHub 仓库装： ``` dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/divineeagleblackhand/dsh-cost-receipt ``` 也可以在 dsh 插件页的「添加插件」里粘上面任意一条地址（桌面版的 profile 名就是 `desktop`）。 装完刷新页面。若角标没出现，完全退出并重启桌面版。 > 若直连 GitHub 困难，用 npm 那条命令；或先把仓库克隆到本地，再用绝对路径安装。 ## 隐私与联网 - **插件自身不直接联网**：`client.js` / `index.js` 里没有任何 `fetch`、`XMLHttpRequest`、WebSocket 调用，可以逐行核对。 - **余额经由宿主查询**：插件通过 dsh 宿主的 `account/getBalance` 取余额（和你打开账号设置看到的是同一条路径），因此**每 30 秒会触发一次账号查询，页面不可见时降为每 3 分钟一次**。这是它唯一与外部有关的动作，走的是 dsh 自带的账号功能，账号令牌始终只在宿主手里。 - **零存储**：不写任何文件，不用 localStorage。 - **零凭据访问**：不读 API Key，不读任何配置文件。 - 唯一读取的本地数据是当前会话的 token 用量，也就是 dsh 自己「本轮用量」面板用的那一份。 > 仓库里的 `tools/fetch-holidays.mjs` 是**维护脚本**，用来刷新内置的节假日表：它需要联网（默认查第三方节假日 API，也可传入国务院通知原文的 URL 做交叉校验），由维护者**一年手动跑一次**，而且**不会随 npm 包发布给用户**（打包白名单 `files` 里只有插件运行必需的那几个文件）。 ## 计价口径与边界 | 项 | 口径 | |---|---| | 一轮 | 一次问答：一条用户消息 → 最终回复 | | 计价 | 缓存命中输入 / 未缓存输入 / 缓存写入 / 输出 四桶分别乘单价。缓存写入按未命中输入计价（官方没有单独的缓存写入价） | | 单价 | 人民币 / 百万 token，按模型分开，取自官方价目表 | | 时段 | 高峰＝北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，**不含法定节假日**，其余时间空闲价。判定与你的系统时区无关 | | 节假日 | 内置国务院 2026 年安排（19 天）。未收录的年份退回"不修正"，不会给错答案，只是不再修正 | | 币种 | **只支持人民币账户**。检测到非人民币钱包时一个金额都不显示，只提示「仅支持人民币账户」 | 已知误差： - **跨峰谷边界的轮次**按该轮结束时刻整轮定价，最坏偏 50%（一轮 5 分钟跨界的概率约 1.4%）。 - **整场累计**只覆盖已加载进视图的轮次；超长会话分页时这个数会偏低。 - **单价表与节假日表会随官方更新**，需要手动改常量（见下）。 ## 兼容性 - 需要 **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2**：插件依赖它内部的 turn-tail 数据与 account Remote。dsh 升级后如果角标消失，第一个要怀疑的就是这里。 - Web 版与桌面版均可，Windows 与 macOS 均可（纯客户端插件，不碰文件系统，也没有平台分支）。 - 非人民币账户不显示金额（见上）。 ## 开发 ``` npm test ``` 测试脚本会**从 `client.js` 里切片抽出真实的计价代码来执行**，而不是复制一份——避免"测的和跑的不是同一份"。覆盖：峰谷时段边界、节假日、三项拆解对账、饼图与角标同源、会话累计、悬停面板结构、币种判定、中英字典对齐。 - 改价格表：`client.js` 顶部的 `PRICES` - 刷新节假日表：`node tools/fetch-holidays.mjs <年份>`（可再传国务院通知原文 URL 做交叉校验） ## 许可 MIT --- **English** — A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin that adds one line under every reply showing what that exchange cost, priced from the turn's own token usage at the official peak/off-peak CNY rates, together with the account and bonus balances. Hover for a cost breakdown of the exchange versus the whole conversation. When a price cannot be computed it says why instead of guessing. The plugin makes no network calls of its own — the balance is read through the dsh host, which is also how dsh's own account page reads it; it stores nothing and never touches credentials. Requires dsh 0.2.0-rc.2; CNY accounts only.

plugins.description: Self-contained outbound proxy for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: bundled mihomo core, Clash subscription import, its own latency ranking and automatic failover. No third-party proxy client, no system proxy.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-net-proxy

**Paste this into your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness — anything that can run commands) and it will install and configure this plugin for you:**

```text
Install the DSH plugin at https://github.com/FIZMIE/dsh-net-proxy into my DeepSeek Harness.
Read its README, wire it into ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json and cordis.patch.yml,
then use the tools in its tools/ directory to fetch the mihomo core and geodata.
Ask me for my Clash subscription link, import it, turn the proxy on, and
verify it works by fetching https://github.com.
```

*A self-contained outbound proxy for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.*

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

> **You need a subscription.** This plugin is a *client*. It does not sell, provide or
> bypass anything by itself — bring a Clash-format subscription link from whatever
> provider you already use. Without one it has no nodes to connect through.

---

## What it does

Paste a Clash subscription link once. The plugin then:

1. **Starts its own proxy core** — a bundled mihomo binary, so nothing else has to be installed
2. **Measures every node itself** against `https://github.com`, concurrently
3. **Uses the fastest one**, and switches automatically when a node dies
4. **Routes the agent's traffic through it** — `web_fetch`, model calls, and child processes like `git` and `npm`

No Clash client running in the background. No system proxy. No hosts file. No admin rights.

---

## Why it exists

Asking an agent to work with GitHub from a censored network goes like this: the request
times out, the agent concludes the network is broken, and you end up explaining your proxy
setup by hand, every session.

The usual fixes do not fit an agent:

- **A system proxy** is invisible to it — `fetch` inside a Node process does not use one.
- **A GUI proxy client** may not be running, and the agent cannot start a GUI app from its sandbox.
- **The client's own `url-test` group** re-tests on a fixed interval (often daily) against
  `gstatic.com`, which is not the site you actually care about, and it does not re-test when
  a request fails.

So this plugin measures the thing that matters, when it matters, and switches when a request
fails.

---

## Install

### The one-prompt way

Copy the block at the top of this file into an agent that can run shell commands. It has
everything it needs: the repo URL, where the profile lives, which tools to run, and how to
verify the result.

### By hand

```powershell
# 1. Clone somewhere permanent (not into the profile's node_modules)
git clone https://github.com/FIZMIE/dsh-net-proxy.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-net-proxy"

# 2. Let the profile see it
#    Add to $DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\package.json:
#      "dependencies": { "dsh-net-proxy": "link:C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/plugins/dsh-net-proxy" }
#      "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-net-proxy" ] } }
#    then create the link so the loader resolves the name:
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-net-proxy" `
  -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-net-proxy"

# 3. Register the bundle in $DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml:
#      - id: dsh-net-proxy
#        disabled: false

# 4. Check the pieces are in place
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-net-proxy\tools\verify-setup.mjs"

# 5. Restart DeepSeek Harness (a new host plugin cannot be hot-mounted)
```

The core and geodata are **committed to this repository**, so step 5 is the last one —
there is nothing to download. If you want to refresh them later (or you stripped them out
to keep the clone small), see [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

---

## Use

Open **Settings → Network proxy**.

- **First time:** paste your subscription link, press **Update subscription**
- **Every other time:** press **Enable proxy**. That is the whole flow — it starts the core,
  ranks the nodes and takes over outbound traffic in about two seconds.

The node table shows every node with its measured latency; click one to pin it, or
**Fastest (automatic)** to go back to automatic selection. **Activity log** shows what the
plugin has been doing.

### It stays off until you ask

Opening the app does **nothing**: no core process, no subscription download, no dispatcher
(~4 ms). A previous session's "on" does not restore itself — the plugin starts closed and
waits for you to enable it. If you would rather not think about it, the agent-memory section
below tells the agent to enable it when a task needs it.

### Agent memory

On install the plugin appends a short section to `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` teaching the agent
that the proxy exists and how to turn it on. Without it the agent has no way to know, and
would keep reporting GitHub as unreachable. It is written **once**, and only when no such
section is present — a file you have since edited is never rewritten. Set
`"writeMemory": false` in `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-net-proxy/config.json` to opt out.

---

## Verified behaviour

Measured against a real 23-node subscription:

| | |
|---|---|
| Nodes ranked | 23/23 reachable, fastest ≈ 90 ms, slowest ≈ 274 ms |
| Click to live | ≈ 2 s from pressing *Enable* |
| Cost of app start | ≈ 4 ms, and no process started |
| Exit IP, proxy on | `5.34.221.111` — Tokyo, JP (Akari Networks) |
| Exit IP, proxy off | `112.50.79.219` — Guangzhou, CN (China Mobile) |
| Failover | current node retired → walked to the next → `https://github.com` returned 200 |
| Loopback | stays direct (`127.0.0.1:19387` reached DSH itself, not the proxy) |

The core's own log is the proof that traffic went through it rather than somewhere else:

```
[TCP] 127.0.0.1:60196 --> github.com:443 match DomainKeyword(github) using 九云[...]
[TCP] 127.0.0.1:60206 --> 127.0.0.1:19387 match IPCIDR(127.0.0.0/8) using DIRECT
```

---

## Design notes

Worth reading before changing the code — most of these were learned the hard way.

**The subscription document is never reshaped.** mihomo's YAML parser rejects duplicate
mapping keys (stricter than the YAML spec), so prepending your own keys fails outright, and
lifting a block like `dns:` out of the document breaks its neighbours. The plugin rewrites
only a handful of listener/controller **scalars, in place**, and leaves every block exactly
where the provider put it — including provider quirks such as unquoted full-width colons in
node names.

**The subscription's own selector group is used, not a new one.** Creating a group would mean
editing the group list, which runs into the paragraph above. Real subscriptions ship a
selector covering all their nodes, so the plugin discovers it through the API and switches
within it.

**The proxy is swapped without a restart.** Routing goes through a single undici dispatcher
installed into Node's global-dispatcher slot — the same cross-package mechanism
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` uses. Because the dispatcher is read per request, a node switch
changes where the very next request goes.

**Geodata must be bundled, and must be the full set.** A subscription's rules reference
`GEOIP,CN` / `GEOSITE`, so the core needs the databases *before* it can parse the config.
Missing them, it tries to download from GitHub and **hangs with no error at all**. Pointing
`geox-url` at nothing makes it exit fatally. The "lite" databases omit the `gfw` category,
and a subscription whose DNS config references it fails with
`list gfw not found in geosite.dat`. The core also looks for these files in its *working
directory*, not beside the executable, so they are copied there on every start.

**The subscription download has a second path through the bundled core.** The host's own
`fetch` is subject to whatever proxy environment the process carries, and on a censored
network it may simply have no route out — which is the worst place to fail, because that
download is the plugin's only way in. So when `fetch` fails, the plugin starts its bundled
core on a throwaway config containing nothing but `MATCH,DIRECT` (no subscription, no nodes,
no geodata needed to boot), uses it as an HTTP proxy for the download, then tears it down. A
separate process with an ordinary network stack

plugins.description: 列出并删除 DSH 已归档会话：默认移入回收站可恢复，带二次确认与日志归属校验。
plugins.readme_text:
## dsh-delete-archived-session
一个 DSH 插件：**列出并删除已归档的会话**。
DSH 本身只有「归档」和「取消归档」两个操作。**归档只是把会话藏起来，日志永远留在磁盘上**，官方没有任何办法把那块空间收回来。
### 安全设计

删会话就是把聊天记录销毁掉，所以这个插件刻意做得很保守。

1.只删已归档的。

2.必须明确确认。

3.必须先证明归属。

4.不跑出根目录。

5.默认可以恢复。

6.顺手清掉归档记录。

7.DSH不崩。

### 安装

这是一个标准的 DSH 插件包：`package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`cordis.patch.yml` 负责插入一行。

**方法一（推荐）**：在对话里说一句「把这个插件装上」，让 AI 调用插件管理器安装。

**方法二**：自己手动加。在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖并登记 bundle：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-delete-archived-session": "file:./dsh-delete-archived-session" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-delete-archived-session"] } }
}
```

装好后需要重启 DSH 才生效。

### 配置

插件**不导入 Node 标准库以外的任何东西**——它注册的是朴素的工具/命令描述对象，也不接受 schemastery 的 `Config`。这样做是为了不管 profile 怎么提升 DSH 自身的依赖，它都能挂载成功。

配置因此走环境变量：

| 环境变量 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_DELETE_ARCHIVED_SESSIONS_ROOT` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | 要操作的会话根目录 |
| `DSH_DELETE_ARCHIVED_SESSIONS_TRASH` | `<根目录>/../.deleted-sessions` | 删除时移入的回收站 |
| `DSH_DELETE_ARCHIVED_SESSIONS_PERMANENT` | 不设（允许永久删除） | 设为 `0`、`false` 或 `no` 则禁止永久删除，强制走可恢复路径 |

`$DSH_HOME` 的读取方式和 DSH 本身一致：先看 `$DSH_HOME`，没有就用 `~/.dsh`。

plugins.description: 给你的页面装上会呼吸的光标。25 套鼠标光标动效，封装为零依赖 Web Component，原生 Canvas 绘制，一行 import 接入，Vue / React / Next.js 与纯 HTML 通吃。每套自带主题光标（雪花冒寒气、火牙飘火星、闪电打电弧），响应滚轮与长按蓄力，铺满视口却 pointer-events: none，不干扰宿主的按钮、输入框与文字选择。

# CursorKit **给你的页面装上会呼吸的光标** 25 套鼠标光标动效，封装为零依赖 Web Component。原生 Canvas 绘制，一行 `import` 接入，Vue / React / Next.js 与纯 HTML 通吃。 [在线演示](https://cursor.lxpavilion.top/)  ·  [纯净展示页](https://cursor.lxpavilion.top/show.html) | | | |:---:|:---:| | | |
## 用法 引入动效模块会自行注册自定义元素，然后在页面任意位置放一个标签。主题光标默认开启，宿主页面无需任何配置。 `snow` 换成任意效果名即可，只用哪个就只引入哪个。`registerAll()` 一次注册全部。 ### 方式一：下载文件 把 `src/core/` 和 `src/effects/` 一起复制进项目。动效文件会 `import '../core/base.js'`，只复制单个动效文件会缺依赖。 ```html ``` ### 方式二：npm 安装 ```bash npm i cursorkit-effects ``` ```html ``` ### 在框架里用 组件是标准 Custom Element，任何框架里都只是「import 一次 + 放一个标签」，不需要 wrapper。 **Vue 3** ```vue ``` 不加配置也能渲染，但 Vue 会先把非原生标签当组件解析，开发时刷 "Failed to resolve component" 警告。按官方建议在构建配置里声明跳过： ```js // vite.config.js vue({ template: { compilerOptions: { isCustomElement: (t) => t.includes('-') } } }) ``` **React** ```jsx import 'cursorkit-effects/src/effects/snow.js'; export default function App() { return ; } ``` **Next.js / 任何 SSR 环境** 动效模块顶层就 `extends HTMLElement`，服务端没有 `HTMLElement`，直接 import 会让 SSR 抛错。把注册放进 `useEffect`，只在浏览器里执行： ```jsx 'use client'; import { useEffect } from 'react'; export default function CursorFx() { useEffect(() => { import('cursorkit-effects/src/effects/snow.js'); }, []); return ; } ``` ## 浏览器扩展 装个扩展，访问到的每个页面都自动带上动效。[下载最新构建](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/cursorkit/releases/latest)，解压后在 `edge://extensions` 开启「开发人员模式」，点「加载解压缩的扩展」选中该目录。 Edge / Chrome 通用，详细请看 [`extension/README.md`](./extension/README.md)。 ## DSH 插件 装进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Web 界面，25 种动效铺满整个窗口，在「设置 → 通用」里切换。发布在 npm，零运行时依赖。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add dsh-cursorkit ``` 也可以在侧栏的「插件」面板里添加 `dsh-cursorkit`。详细请看 [`plugins/dsh-cursorkit/README.md`](./plugins/dsh-cursorkit/README.md)。

plugins.description: Refuses Git inside a Jujutsu workspace and hands the model jj commands instead. Jujutsu-native VCS & version control for the DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-jujutsu

Jujutsu for DeepSeek Harness
Makes the harness jj-native — the agent uses jj instead of Git, and is told why.

--- Inside a [Jujutsu](https://jj-vcs.dev) workspace the agent stops reaching for Git and uses `jj` instead — and it is _told_ why, rather than just being blocked. - **Refuses Git where it would mislead.** `git status` in a colocated repo reports a different state than `jj status`. The guard catches that and hands back the command to run instead. - **Eleven `jj` tools**, so the model can read and write history without shelling out and parsing output. - **Teaches the model** what `jj` is: no staging area, `@` is always a commit, change IDs survive rewrites. - **A settings panel**, on the plugin's own page. The plugin is invisible outside a Jujutsu workspace. In a plain Git repo it does nothing at all. ## Install Install from the harness **Plugins** page, or: ```bash dsh plugin install dsh-jujutsu ``` Then open **Plugins → Jujutsu** to configure it. It works out of the box; the defaults are chosen to be safe. ### Requirements | | | | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `jj` | **Required.** 0.46.0 or newer. `brew install jj` | | `jj-hunk` | Optional. Adds hunk-level `split`/`squash`. Without it those two tools report unavailable rather than failing. `cargo install --git https://github.com/laulauland/jj-hunk --tag v0.5.1 jj-hunk` | | Node | 24 or newer | ## What it does ### Refuses Git, and says what to run instead The refusal is **translated, not templated**: the guard parses the command you actually typed and hands back the exact `jj` command it maps to. | You run | What happens | | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `git log --oneline -6` | `Refused: git log --oneline -6. Run: jj log -r ::@ --limit 6 --no-graph` | | `git diff HEAD~1` | `Refused: git diff HEAD~1. Run: jj diff --from @-` | | `git push origin main` | `Refused: git push origin main. Run: jj git push --remote origin --bookmark main` | | `git status` | `Refused: git status. Run: jj status` | | `git add src/a.ts` | Refused with the reason instead of a command: there is no staging area to add to | | `git status --porcelain` | The catalogue wording — flags that change the command are never silently dropped | | `git rebase -i` | Refused — it needs a terminal. Suggests `jj rebase`, `jj squash`, `jj absorb` | | `rm -rf .git` | Refused, and explains that `jj`'s commit objects live there | | `jj status`, `jj log`, … | Run normally | | `echo "git commit"` | Runs — it never touched Git | Three rules make the translation safe to paste: Git revisions are rewritten into revsets (`HEAD~2` → `@--`, because `HEAD` is not a `jj` revset), anything that does not map exactly falls back to the catalogue wording rather than a half-translated command, and every argument is shell-quoted. Reads and writes are configured separately. A user who is happy to let the model _look_ with Git has not thereby agreed to let it _write_. ### Eleven `jj` tools | Tool | What it does | | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | | `jj_status` | The working copy, including whether it is **conflicted** | | `jj_log`, `jj_diff`, `jj_op_log` | History, changes, and the operation log | | `jj_new`, `jj_describe`, `jj_squash` | Start, describe and fold changes | | `jj_bookmark`, `jj_op_restore` | Name revisions; undo anything | | `jj_hunk_list`, `jj_hunk_apply` | Select and apply individual hunks | All of them return **structured JSON**, never prose. Revisions are addressed by **change ID**, which survives a rewrite — a commit ID does not. ### Teaches the model The model is told, in its system prompt, that version control here is Jujutsu and what that implies. The rule is withheld where it would be false: in a plain Git repo, or in a directory with no repository at all. In a directory with **no** version control, the plugin says so — so the agent can offer to initialise one, suggesting `jj git init` (colocated, so Git tooling still works). **Plain Git repositories can be adopted, deliberately.** Turn on _Use Jujutsu in Git repos_ and the first session in a Git repo that has no `.jj` runs `jj git init --colocate`: the history is imported and the agent gets jj, while Git tooling keeps working because `.git` is untouched. It is refused outright for repositories jj cannot represent — LFS (where jj would commit raw bytes over the pointer), submodules, shallow clones, linked worktrees, and a Git operation in progress. See [docs/37](docs/37-git-compatible-adoption.md). Depth is deferred rather than paid for. The rule and the workspace state ride the system prompt because they must be in force before the model's first Git command; the **manual** — the working-copy model, the Git→`jj` verb map, what each of the eleven tools returns — is registered as a `jujutsu` runtime skill, so its cost is one catalog line until the model actually needs it. Turn it off with _Offer the jj manual_. Why the split is drawn there, and why the manual is not an MCP server, is [docs/36](docs/36-ai-and-jujutsu.md). ## Configuration Open **Plugins → Jujutsu**. Most settings are on that page: | Setting | Default | What it changes | | ------------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Guard | on | Off leaves the guard mounted but inert — useful to see what it _would_ have caught | | Read-only Git | `ask` | What to do with `git status`, `git log`, … | | Writing Git | `ask` | What to do wi

plugins.description: A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with translucent surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.
plugins.readme_text:
# AIR-pixel Liquid Glass

A configurable Liquid Glass theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It adds translucent interface surfaces, an optional wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.

## Screenshots

Full transparency: strength 2.0 (效果强度) with desktop transparency on (透出桌面), so the desktop reaches the eye unfiltered. The per-side conversation plates are what keep the body copy readable this far up the slider.

![Liquid Glass with desktop transparency](assets/preview-transparent.png)

The same screen with and without the theme:

![The stock shell beside Liquid Glass](assets/preview-vs-stock.png)

At the default strength, over the theme's own wallpaper — sidebar, pane, dialog, menu and floating panel:

![Frosted panels at the default strength](assets/preview-surfaces.png)

| Custom cursors | Click ripple |
| --- | --- |
| ![The five shipped cursors](assets/preview-cursors.png) | ![A click ripple, held](assets/preview-ripple.png) |

The four tint presets, light and dark:

![Tint presets in light and dark](assets/preview-tints.png)

These are renders, not photographs. `node tools/docshots.mjs` boots the real `client.js` in a stand-in shell over a drawn desktop. A screen capture cannot show this feature at all: `PrintWindow` drops the alpha channel, so a see-through window comes back as a black rectangle — measured in `tools/appshot.py`.

## Features

- Frosted surfaces with adjustable strength, blur, tint, and wallpaper.
- Optional transparent desktop and Windows window material controls. Desktop transparency requires the included client patch helper; the setting reports when the patch is unavailable.
- Custom cursors and click ripples, each independently configurable.
- Separate contrast settings for human and assistant messages.
- English and Chinese settings UI.

## Install

Install `air-pixel-liquid-glass` as a DeepSeek Harness bundle, then enable **Liquid Glass** in Settings. The desktop transparency and window blur controls need their host-side patch; the theme and other visual options do not.

## Development

Requires Node.js. Run the syntax and behavior checks with:

```powershell
node tools/preflight.mjs
node tools/verify.mjs
node tools/patcheck.mjs
node tools/mutationaudit.mjs
```

Regenerate the images above with `node tools/docshots.mjs` (writes `assets/`, which `screenshots.json` points the plugin market at). Some visual inspection scripts need Python with Pillow. See [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md) for architecture, checks, and rename migration details.

## Compatibility

Designed for DeepSeek Harness on Windows and the web GUI. Desktop transparency and window blur depend on the installed Harness build and supported Windows compositor APIs.

Verified against Harness core `0.2.1-rc.2`; that is the only core this version declares support for. The slots seat moved into the core's client runner in the 0.2.x line, so `0.1.x` cores are out — stay on plugin `0.1.0` there.

## Permissions and behavior

The plugin injects theme styles and custom cursors into the Harness web UI, reads and writes its own JSON settings through a local host API, and logs diagnostic status through the host logger. The optional `tools/asarpatch.py` helper modifies the installed Harness `app.asar` only when run explicitly by the user; it keeps a backup and supports checking or reverting the patch. The plugin does not make external network requests.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Side-by-side session grid for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: click sessions in the sidebar, get an equal-cell grid of live conversations (max 3 per row), drag the top-right handle to reorder, each pane keeps its own composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-multi-chat

**Side-by-side sessions for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, as an equal-cell grid.**
Click a session in the left sidebar and it joins the conversation area as its own pane: one
click → one session, three clicks → three sessions. At most **three panes per row**; the grid
degrades to two or one column when the window is narrow. The session you clicked (the shell's
current session) stays highlighted, every pane keeps its own bottom-pinned input box, and panes
can be reordered by dragging the **⠿ handle in the top-right corner** of a pane header.

中文说明：[README.zh.md](README.zh.md) · 设计依据：[docs/design.md](docs/design.md) ·
Design notes (EN): [docs/design.en.md](docs/design.en.md)

---

## What it does

| | |
|---|---|
| **Follow the sidebar** | Every session you click in the sidebar becomes a pane. The pane order survives a page reload. |
| **Equal-cell grid** | At most three equal cells per row (`3 × 3` = 9 panes max, six by default). Rows share the height but never below a comfortable pane height (~420 px); beyond that the grid scrolls. Narrow windows degrade 3 → 2 → 1 columns. |
| **Highlight** | The current session's pane is ringed, its title emphasized, and its sequence badge inverts. |
| **Focus by click** | Clicking inside a non-active pane asks the shell to make that session current (the official sidebar highlight follows). |
| **Reorder by drag** | Grab the ⠿ handle at the top-right of a pane header (immediate drag) or press the header itself (4 px of travel, or a 300 ms hold on touch). Drop on another pane to **swap** the two, drop on empty grid space to move the pane to the end, `Esc` cancels. The dragged pane follows the pointer as a ghost card and the drop target is outlined. |
| **Reorder by keyboard** | The handle is focusable: `Ctrl/⌘ + arrows` swaps with the neighbouring cell (grid-aware for up/down), otherwise nothing happens. |
| **Close** | Each pane has a close control. The active pane can only be closed by handing the shell over to a sibling — otherwise the control is disabled with a reason. The toolbar's **Keep only active** collapses the grid. |
| **Sidebar toggle** | Each session row gets an extra action button (next to archive/pin) that adds/removes that session as a pane **without** navigating. |
| **Degrade, never break** | A single pane → the official single-session UI is used untouched. Unknown/closed sessions render a note card. A crashed pane is contained by a pane-level error boundary. No `slots`/`sessions` service → the plugin stays inert instead of failing the web boot. |

## Install

The package is a DSH bundle plugin: the host half (`.` → `lib/index.js`) only exists so the
package becomes a loader entry; the browser half (`./client` → `lib/client.js`) is what the web
shell loads through the `dsh.client` declaration.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<path-to-this-package>
# then restart the desktop app / profile (bundle layers apply at boot)
```

Read-only check that the row composes (writes nothing):

```powershell
dsh --profile desktop --dump-config | Select-String dsh-multi-chat
```

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-multi-chat`.

## Development

```powershell
npm install    # dev-only: react, react-dom, jsdom, yaml, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots
npm test       # 7 suites, 90 tests
npm run typecheck
```

**v0.3.0 feature — the grid can be switched off**: pick **Settings → Plugins → dsh-multi-chat** and flip
*Enable the side-by-side grid* (or press **Exit grid** in the grid toolbar). Off returns the conversation area to
the official single-session view; the panes you had opened are remembered, so switching back on brings the grid
straight back. The preference is stored separately from the pane order, so toggling can never disturb it.

**v0.2.6 fix**: the official turn navigator (the tick rail with turn previews on the right of a
conversation) hid itself inside every pane, because the official stylesheet hides it whenever its
conversation container is narrower than 900px. One pane-scoped rule with higher specificity restores it
(the official class prefix is read from the official stylesheet at runtime, and nothing is injected when
that stylesheet is missing). Verified live: the rail renders 28×102px with its marks inside a 456px pane.

**v0.2.5 fix**: the column count was hard-coded to three, so two sessions left a third of the row empty.
The grid now fills: columns follow the available width (`auto-fit` collapses the tracks no pane lands in),
two panes share the row, and three across appears only when the width allows — panes stay at least ~400px
wide. Measured at a 1680px window: two panes = 2×688px (100% of the row), three = 3×456px, four = 3+1
equal cells.

**v0.2.4 change**: the grid is a wide-window feature, so a narrow window keeps the official single
session view. Below 720px of window width the plugin is completely inert — no session is retained, no
slot is replaced, and nothing is written to the shared storage (which the floating session window would
otherwise clobber with its own pane set). Widening the window brings the grid back; narrowing hands the
conversation area back. Verified live: 490×640 cold start shows the normal conversation, 1680×1050 shows
the grid, resizing switches both ways.

**v0.2.3 fix**: in a narrow window (the ~490 px floating session window) the grid toolbar wrapped into
three lines and squeezed the conversation. It now never wraps and degrades by width — dropping the drag
hint, then the usage counter, swapping the title for a compact "N panes" label — and the row height
yields to short windows (`min(420px, 62vh)`). Measured in a 490×640 window: one 37 px line, single
column, composer fully visible.

**v0.2.2 fixes** (reported from a live session, located in a real browser): the grid used to be
registered in a *session-scoped* slot, which the renderer remounts whenever the shell switches
session — so every switch rebuilt the grid and all pane conversations (the lag that grew with the
number of panes) and replaced the composer input mid-click (the "needs a second click to focus"
bug). The grid now lives in the **root-scope `main` / `conversation` panel cell** (same replacement
semantics, no remount), and pane activation runs on `focusin`/`click` instead of `pointerdown`.
Measured live: one click focuses the composer, session switching ≈ one frame, 5 panes ≈ 2.6k DOM
nodes with off-screen panes virtualised. Details: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) §4.9.

**v0.2.1 fixes**: switching a session no longer walks a `retain` → publish → `retain` recursion (it
used to overflow the stack, slow every switch down and leave the pane ring and the sidebar highlight
disagreeing); dragging can no longer strand a ghost or a drop ring when the pointer is released
outside the grid; the selection ring is a single crisp outer ring instead of a double-drawn edge.
Details and the reproduction evidence: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) §4.8.

| Suite | Covers |
|---|---|
| `tests/manifest.test.mjs` | package/bundle/client-half/patch/locale contract, plus "the composer fix stays in place" |
| `tests/host.test.mjs` | the inert host half never throws |
| `tests/store.test.mjs` | pane ledger: follow adds panes, ceiling 6/9, eviction, highlight, `swap`/`moveToEnd`, persistence + the v1→v2 migration, untrusted payloads, drop targeting, keyboard steps |
| `tests/registration.test.mjs` | activation contract: no registration for one pane, shadow registration for 2+, retention/release, sidebar button, unknown sessions, disposal, missing services |
| `tests/real-slot-core.test.mjs` | the same wiring driven through the **real** `SlotCore` shipped by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` |
| `tests/render.test.mjs` | structural rendering: equal-cell grid, single highlight, handle + close per header, `variant: 'embedded'` for the conversation body, hero/settling phases, token-only stylesheet |
| `tests/interaction.test.mjs` | React DOM in jsdom: pointer drag → swap, drop on empty → move to end, `Esc` cancel, header 4 px threshold, `Ctrl+Arrow` keyboard swap, close/focus, sidebar toggle, toolbar, pane-level crash containment |

End-to-end install verificati

plugins.description: A Restart button for DeepSeek Harness Settings: replaces the dsh web process serving the page, then reconnects the page by itself.
plugins.readme_text: **A Restart card in DeepSeek Harness Settings.** One click replaces the `dsh web` process that is serving your page — and the page reconnects by itself. No terminal, no re-opening the desktop icon. That matters because some changes cannot hot-reload: - you changed a plugin's **host half**, and Node caches imported ES modules by URL; - you edited `config.json`, the port, or the workspace; - a session holds in-memory state you want gone. Today those mean walking back to a terminal. This plugin turns them into one click. ## Try it ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:chenkui-luo/dsh-plugin-restart ``` Then **refresh the page once** and open **Settings → Restart**. Without the `dsh` CLI (no pnpm, or a patched profile): copy the package into `/node_modules/dsh-plugin-restart` and add this row to `/cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: restart name: 'dsh-plugin-restart' ``` The bundled installer does both steps with a backup and a read-back check before it writes: ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 -Action disable powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 -Action uninstall ``` ## What happens when you click | Step | What runs | | --- | --- | | 1 | The page sends `POST /dsh-restart/restart` — same origin, authenticated | | 2 | The host half starts a **detached helper** and answers the request *before* anything is stopped | | 3 | The helper waits for the port to stop accepting connections, then hands over to your launcher | | 4 | The launcher starts a fresh `dsh web` with a new launch token and writes its token file | | 5 | The helper confirms the replacement is up, then lets the old process exit — gracefully | | 6 | The page sees a new instance id on its next poll and reloads itself | Nothing is force-killed in the middle of the response, and the old process is stopped **last**, by itself. A restart that fails leaves a diagnosis in the log instead of failing silently. ## Why the helper is a detached **node** process This part was measured on a real Windows machine, not assumed: | how a background helper is started | does it run | does it outlive the process it must replace | | --- | --- | --- | | PowerShell, `detached: true` | **no** — exits 0, silently | — | | PowerShell, attached | yes | no — dies with its parent | | **node, `detached: true`** | yes | **yes** | | node, attached | yes | no | On Windows a "detached" PowerShell child gets no console and never runs the script — the same trap [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) documents. An attached helper dies together with the process it is supposed to replace. So the helper is a detached node process, and it gives its own children a hidden console through `powershell -WindowStyle Hidden`. Force-killing the whole tree is the other half of the story: it leaves a Windows port unbindable long enough for the replacement to die with `EADDRINUSE`. Waiting for the port to go quiet and only then starting the replacement is what makes the handover reliable. ## Verified, not asserted | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | Helper generation, offline (`runtime-test/CheckHelperScript.mjs`) | 11/11 | | End to end, real plugin code (`runtime-test/VerifyRestartPlugin.mjs`) | 21/21 | | **Real** launcher + **real** `dsh web`, full restart cycle (`runtime-test/SmokeRestartReal.ps1`) | pass | The end-to-end runs cover: the installer writing a managed patch row, the host half claiming its routes, an unauthenticated request being fenced off, the restart being accepted before the port goes away, a second click inside the guard window being refused, the port wait, the launcher handover, the successor process appearing, and the page noticing it. These live in the toolkit this plugin was built in; this repository is the packaged plugin. ## API Every route passes the connection trust fence (loopback peer + matching `Origin` + login cookie), so only an authenticated same-origin page can reach them. | Method | Path | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | GET | `/dsh-restart/status` | `instanceId` (this server's pid), port, workspace, launcher path and availability, whether a restart is in flight | | POST | `/dsh-restart/restart` | Arms a restart. A second request within 15 s gets `409`. The response carries **no** launch token | | GET | `/dsh-restart/log` | Tail of the shared restart log | If the automatic reload comes back unauthenticated — a fresh launch token is minted on every start — the page's own token is handed back to the *same* browser connection once, so it can reopen itself with `?token=…`. ## Logs `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\restart-plugin\logs\restart.log` — append-only, so the record of a restart survives the process that performed it. The helper writes the launcher's exit code, whether the port is still being served, and whether a fresh token file appeared, because the process that would normally log a failure is the one that just exited. ## Configuration | Variable | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `DSH_RESTART_INSTALL_DIR` | Launcher runtime directory (default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness`) | | `DSH_RESTART_DATA` | Plugin-private data directory (default `\restart-plugin`) | | `DSH_RESTART_LAUNCHER` | Point at another launcher script (portable installs, tests) | **Restart target.** By default it delegates to the launcher a hosted install already has (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`), which owns the reliable stop/start/readiness sequence. When that file is missing the button reports a clear error instead of pretending to work, and the status card shows the path it looked for. Making the plugin fully standalone is the next step on the roadmap. ## Safety - Authenticated same-origin loopback only; proxy-forwarded requests are not honoured. - No admin rights, no system configuration touched. - It **interrupts a running conversation turn** — that is what a restart is, and the card says so. - If the port is owned by a process the launcher does not recognise (a `dsh web` you started by hand), the restart takes that port over, including its terminal's process tree. ## Credits - **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** — the open-source agent harness this plugin extends and is built on: its `dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml` declaration, the dual host/browser plugin shape, and the webserver's trust fence. [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · MIT. - **[dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)** — the community plugin market. Its `restart.js` is the reference for the approach used here: delegate to a detached helper, wait for the port instead of guessing with a fixed delay, and make a failed restart leave evidence. ## License MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-desktop-linux

[**English**](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A desktop pet for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) on Linux: a small transparent,
always-on-top GTK3 window that floats over your desktop and animates according to
what your DSH sessions are doing — idle, working, waiting for an answer, failed,
or finished and awaiting review. It is not click-through: the window keeps its
input region, so clicks on the pet land on the pet.

**Platform: Linux with X11 or XWayland only.** Windows, macOS and native Wayland
(no XWayland) are not supported. See [Requirements](#requirements).

![The pet floating transparently over the desktop](assets/screenshots/desktop-pet-linux-1.png)

The window has no background and no border — the wallpaper shows through, and the
pet stays on top of ordinary windows. The sprite follows your DSH sessions:

![Idle, working, waiting, failed and review poses](assets/screenshots/desktop-pet-linux-2.png)

> **Canonical copy:** this plugin is only published as
> `dsh-pet-desktop-linux` (no scope) under the `Wlaeg` account. Any other
> package with this name is not ours.

---

## This is not a meta-package

This plugin ships **its own working program**; it is not a bundle that only
re-exports somebody else's dependency list:

| Part | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop program | `desktop/pet.py` | The pet window itself: GTK3 transparent window, spritesheet animation, right-click menu, work-status dialog |
| Host half | `lib/index.js` | Probes system dependencies, spawns/stops the Python program, exposes the HTTP routes, reads and writes the config file |
| Browser half | `client.js` | The **Desktop Pet** panel in DSH Settings, with the packaged `locale/{en,zh}.json` manifest strings |

The single dependency, `@michengai/dsh-codex-pet`, is used **only to read the pet
sprite sheets**. This plugin deliberately does not copy that artwork into its own
repository: store rules require a bundle's dependencies to resolve to the original
author's published package, so this plugin depends on the upstream npm package
and resolves the artwork path at runtime
(`require.resolve('@michengai/dsh-codex-pet/package.json')`). See
[Artwork and licensing](#artwork-and-licensing).

The upstream plugin draws a pet **inside the DSH web page**. This plugin draws a
**separate always-on-top desktop window** that works while the page is in the
background, minimized, or closed. They are different things, not duplicates.

---

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Platform | **Linux with X11 or XWayland.** Verified on Manjaro GNOME (Wayland session, pet runs through XWayland) |
| DSH | Any DSH build with the Cordis plugin system that provides `webServer` and the `settings.section` slot |
| Node | **>= 22** (DSH's own requirement) |
| Desktop session | A GTK3-capable session. Under GNOME/Wayland the pet is an XWayland client — a **pure Wayland session with XWayland disabled will not work** |
| npm dependencies | `@michengai/dsh-codex-pet` (artwork lookup only) |

### System packages

The Settings panel probes five of these — Python 3, PyGObject, GTK3, GdkPixbuf
and `xdotool` — and shows the matching install hint for your distribution when
one is missing. The other two rows (the WebP loader and `zstd`) are not probed;
check them yourself with the commands below if the pet starts but looks wrong.

| Component | Arch / Manjaro | Debian / Ubuntu | Fedora |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python 3 | `python` | `python3` | `python3` |
| Python 3 + PyGObject (`import gi`) | `python-gobject` | `python3-gi` | `python3-gobject` |
| GTK3 typelib | `gtk3` | `gir1.2-gtk-3.0` | `gtk3` |
| GdkPixbuf typelib | `gdk-pixbuf2` | `gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0` | `gdk-pixbuf2` |
| WebP loader for GdkPixbuf | *(built into `gdk-pixbuf2`)* | `webp-pixbuf-loader` | `webp-pixbuf-loader` |
| `zstd` CLI *(only if Python < 3.14)* | `zstd` | `zstd` | `zstd` |
| xdotool | `xdotool` | `xdotool` | `xdotool` |

```sh
# Arch / Manjaro
sudo pacman -S python python-gobject gtk3 gdk-pixbuf2 zstd xdotool

# Debian / Ubuntu
sudo apt install python3 python3-gi gir1.2-gtk-3.0 gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0 webp-pixbuf-loader zstd xdotool

# Fedora
sudo dnf install python3 python3-gobject gtk3 gdk-pixbuf2 webp-pixbuf-loader zstd xdotool
```

The session event files are zstd-compressed. Python 3.14 and newer decode them
with the standard library (`compression.zstd`); on older interpreters the plugin
falls back to the `zstd` command-line tool, so install `zstd` if your `python3`
is older than 3.14. Without either, the pet still runs but never leaves `idle`.

The sprite sheets are WebP files, so GdkPixbuf must be able to decode WebP.
Depending on your distribution's GdkPixbuf version this may need the separate
`webp-pixbuf-loader` package (Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora). You can check yours with
the command below; if it prints `False`, install the loader package:

```sh
python3 -c "import gi; gi.require_version('GdkPixbuf','2.0'); \
from gi.repository import GdkPixbuf; \
print('webp' in [f.get_name() for f in GdkPixbuf.Pixbuf.get_formats()])"
```

The plugin's dependency probe checks GTK3, GdkPixbuf and `xdotool` by name but
does not decode a WebP sprite itself; if the loader is missing, the pet window
appears and the sprite fails to load, which shows up in the log tail.

`xdotool` is used for the two EWMH window hints GTK3 cannot set by itself:
`_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE` (keep above) and `_NET_WM_STATE_STICKY` (show on every
workspace). Without it the pet still appears, but it will not stay on top of
other windows or follow you across workspaces.

Decoding goes through `GdkPixbuf.PixbufLoader` and frames are drawn as
`Gtk.Image` pixbufs, so **Pillow is not needed**, and because no drawing goes
through a `cairo.Context`, **pycairo is not needed either**.

---

## Installation

This is a DSH Cordis plugin **bundle**. Install it through DSH's plugin manager
(`plugin_manager`, action `install_bundle`), pointing `target` at either:

- the **Git repository** — `https://github.com/Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux`
- or a **local checkout** — the absolute path to this directory

Equivalently, from a DSH shell:

```sh
# once published to npm
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet-desktop-linux

# straight from the repository
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux

# from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pet-desktop-linux
```

The bundle declares its own patch in `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
    "client": {
      "platform": "web",
      "immediately": true,
      "inject": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer"]
    }
  },
  "icon": "./assets/icon.png"
}
```

(`dsh.client.inject` is a client-module **load-order** declaration: DSH loads the
listed packages' browser bundles before this one. It is not Cordis service
injection. The browser half declares the services it actually needs itself:
`return { inject: ['slots', 'locale'], apply }`.)

and that patch is a single `insert` that mounts the host half:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-pet-desktop-linux
      name: 'dsh-pet-desktop-linux'
      config: {}
```

The browser half is declared by `dsh.client` and bound to the row whose `name` is
the bare package name — subpath rows do not carry a browser half.

After installing, reload the DSH Web UI page so the browser half registers its
Settings panel. Nothing else is required: **DSH starts the pet window by itself**
as soon as it boots (`autostart` defaults to `true` — see “Configuration”). The
pet process stops when you stop it or uninstall the bundle.

> Replacing an already-installed copy (for example after editing the source)
> needs a restart of the DSH host process — the running process keeps the JS
> module generation it loaded at startup. A page reload is not enough.

---

## Features

**Window**

- Borderless, transparent GTK3 window — only the pet is visible, the window
  background is fully transparent
- Always on top (`_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE`), so it stays above normal windows
- Sticky across workspaces (`_NET_WM_STATE_STICKY`, via `xdotool`) — no API for
  this exists in GT

plugins.description: DSH 会话太大、加载越来越慢、最后 OOM 打不开？启动时清掉会话日志里没人读的流式碎片：实测 272 MB -> 12 MB，843 万对象 -> 不再撞内存上限，58 -> 238 tok/s。DeepSeek Harness plugin that deletes dead streaming fragments so the next load is smaller.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-vacuum

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-community%20topic-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![deepseek-harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/deepseek--harness-plugin-4b6bfb)](https://github.com/topics/deepseek-harness)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

> **Topics:** `dsh` · `dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `session-cleanup` · `session-log` ·
> `streaming-fragments` · `vacuum` · `prune` · `oom` · `long-session` · `memory-optimization`

**Is your DSH session getting slower every turn, slower to load, and eventually unopenable — or
does it just OOM?**

That is not a feeling. Every token is written twice: the fragments (`assistant/chunk` and the
packed `text-chunks` / `reasoning-chunks` / `tool-call-chunks` rows) are read by nothing, and
they pile up. A 1,813-turn conversation reached **272 MB on disk**, expanded into **8.43 million
objects** when loaded, took **1.29 GB resident**, and died.

This plugin deletes them **on disk** — not hidden, actually deleted — so the next load is
smaller before anything else happens. Same session after one pass: **86.67 MB → 16.99 MB**,
169,795 fragments → 0, and the non-fragment content: **nothing lost** (`dropped=0`).

**You are accumulating this from turn one.** Measured on real sessions, the number of prunable
fragments tracks output tokens at roughly **0.95–0.99 : 1** — eight sessions, from 88 fragments
for a 91-token one-turn chat up to 1,498 fragments for a 1,516-token six-turn one. Nothing reads
them; they are write-only.

**So you do not have to be in trouble yet.** This is a preventive plugin as much as a rescue one:
install it while the log is still small and the threshold is never crossed. It is not only about
avoiding the crash, either — measured across 60 sessions, the median **log-read** speedup after a
pass is **×7.77** (best ×97.5, scope spelled out below), which is exactly the cost a page refresh
sits on. Below the thresholds it touches nothing, and a session you are using is never touched at
all. Every DSH session accumulates this; none of them has to be broken first.

**It runs unless you stop it**, but you can look before it touches anything: `dryRun: true`
records what it *would* do and writes nothing. A pass that cannot verify its own output writes
nothing at all. The swap is atomic, and `.orig` is never deleted for you.

- **Live by default.** A fresh install prunes idle logs with no configuration at all. Set
  `enabled: false` to switch it off, or `dryRun: true` to watch without writing.
- **Never touches a session written in the last 2 minutes** (`liveWindowMs`).
- **Verified before it writes.** The pruned log has to satisfy the loader contract, or the
  original file is left exactly as it was.
- **Destructive by design.** The fragment rows are **deleted**. `.orig` is the only backup,
  and it is never removed for you. Read [Destructive by design](#destructive-by-design)
  before enabling it.

**Why not just hide the chunks?** Folding them out of the `session.history` response is a real
fix for the client, and this plugin does not replace it — the two run together. But the OOM does
not happen in the client. It happens when DSH loads the log: the file is read, every row is
parsed, and the chunk rows expand into millions of objects. If the file on disk is still 272 MB,
skipping them in the response does not stop the next load from rebuilding them. The only way to
stop that is to make the file smaller — see
[How this differs from the runtime approaches](#how-this-differs-from-the-runtime-approaches).

---

## Why

A session log is a concatenation of zstd frames holding JSONL rows. Every token a model
streams is written twice: once as a raw delta (`assistant/chunk`, and the packed rows
`text-chunks` / `reasoning-chunks` / `tool-call-chunks`) and once inside the finalised
`assistant/message`. **Nothing reads the fragments.** Replay does not read them, the model is
never fed them — the projection layer does not even know the word `chunks`. They accumulate
because they are write-only.

Measured on the session that motivated this plugin, a 1,813-turn conversation:

| | |
|---|---|
| rows in the log | 224,000 |
| file on disk | 272 MB |
| objects after loading it | 8.43 million |
| resident memory while loaded | 1.29 GB |
| outcome | out of memory |

The file is small enough to sit on disk unnoticed and large enough to kill the process that
loads it. And because every load pays that cost, the session gets slower and eventually
unopenable — while the rows that cause it are provably unused.

After a cleanup, on the very same session:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| session file | 86.67 MB | 16.99 MB |
| fragment rows | 169,795 | 0 |
| non-fragment content | — | **nothing lost** (`dropped=0`) |
| generation speed shown by the UI | visibly slow | **back to normal** |

> ⚠️ **The "generation speed" row is an observation, not a promise, and it is not explained.** ✗
> What was observed: after the fragments were removed and load memory dropped, the generation
> speed reported by the UI recovered. No controlled before/after tok/s reading was taken, so
> this records the symptom only. Do not read a mechanism into it: context size, cache hit rate,
> time of day and the reasoning-effort setting were each suspected and each ruled out by data,
> and this is the only thing that was actually confirmed.

### What the file size costs on the read path (measured 2026-10-15)

Opening or refreshing a conversation pays for reading its log: the multi-frame zstd stream is
decompressed and every row is parsed. That is the server-side cost a page refresh sits on, and
it scales with the fragment rows this plugin exists to remove — so it was measured directly.

60 logs that still had their pre-cleanup `.orig` beside them, i.e. the **same conversation** on
both sides, decompress + `JSON.parse` of every row, median of 3 runs each:

| | |
|---|---|
| fragment rows across the 60 logs | 960,042 → 300,868 |
| total read time across the 60 logs | 62,893 ms → 6,668 ms (**9.4×**) |
| median speedup | **×7.77** (best ×97.5, worst ×0.72) |
| a 15,298-row log | 859 ms → **37 ms** (×23) |
| a 6,293-row log | 331 ms → **18 ms** (×18) |

> **Scope, so the number is not over-read** ✗: this measures **the log read** (decompress +
> parse every row). It does **not** cover projection computation or client-side rendering —
> neither was measured. The ×0.72 case is a log whose pre-cleanup copy is barely larger than
> the current one, so it is noise on a small number, not a regression. Eight further pairs were
> discarded outright because their `.orig` predates later activity, which would have compared
> two different conversation lengths.

## What it does

`startDelayMs` after boot, once:

1. **Scan.** Walk `$DSH_HOME/sessions` for `session.jsonl.zstd`, sort by size, biggest first.
   A file modified inside `liveWindowMs` is `skipped-live` — the plugin never swaps a log
   out from under a session that may be writing to it.
2. **Threshold.** Count fragment rows and their share of all event rows. Below `minChunkRows`
   or below `minRatio`, the file is `below-threshold` and is not touched at all. A few
   hundred kilobytes of fragments is not worth rewriting a log for.
3. **Prune.** Delete the fragment rows, then renumber `seq` and **remap every cross-event
   reference** onto the new numbering — `sourceEventSeqs`, `surfaceOp.start/end`,
   `shadowedSeqs` and `data.shadowedRange`. Events that the remap itself invalidates (a
   `surfaceOp` whose endpoints were dropped, a surface event left without a marker) are
   dropped too, in a fixpoint loop, so the result is consistent rather than almost-consistent.
4. **Self-verify.** The pruned log must satisfy the same contract DSH loads by: contiguous
   `seq` from 0, a marker on every surface event, no dangling references and no reference to
   a later event. Any violation ⇒ `verify-failed` ⇒ **nothing is written** and the log keeps
   its original size. Refusing to shrink a file is always acceptable; writing a file that DSH
   cannot load is not.
5. **Replace atomically.** Copy the original to `<l

# 避峰岗（dsh-peak-valley-router）

> 峰时站岗换班：谷时让 DeepSeek 干苦力，峰时换 ChatGPT Plus 顶班，你的 API 账单从此不再被高峰期收割。

DeepSeek Harness 的跨 provider 峰谷路由插件 + 公开 SKILL。详见 [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)。

当前版本：**v0.12.0**（pre-1.0）。版本号唯一来源是 `package.json`；运行时可在设置页标题下方或 `debug.log` 的 `apply: vX.Y.Z, …` 行确认当前加载的是哪一版。变更记录与版本策略见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

## 它做什么

- **设置页「避峰岗」**：配置有序策略。每条策略 = 触发条件（生效星期 + 峰时窗口）+ 主模型（谷时）+ 可选副模型（峰时）。另有**高级思考模型**，它是**另一根轴**：只在会话本身要求 `max` 思考时使用（`reasoningEffort === 'max'`），**不作为未命中策略时的兜底**。未命中任何策略的时刻（周末、假期）→ 用**第一个方案的主模型**。设置页顶部会写明「此刻生效：model@effort · 原因」，例如「无匹配方案（周末/假期），用首个方案的主力模型」，所以任何一次目标都能解释，不会像故障。
- **Provider / 模型一律下拉选择**：候选来自运行时**已注册的全部 provider**——API 与你装的订阅套餐并列（如 DeepSeek、ChatGPT Plus / Codex、Claude、Grok、Copilot、Antigravity），模型经该 provider 的 `listModels` 接口读取。避峰岗自身**不会**出现在候选里：它是 provider 之上的一层选择器逻辑，不是 provider。
- **左侧「启用避峰岗」开关**：默认关闭 = 纯透传，行为与未装插件一致。开启后由避峰岗决定实际调用的模型，**连会话里已经选过的模型也会被改写**（会话自带的模型选择器本身不改动，只做功能接管 + 尽力而为的置灰提示）。
- **每会话独立状态 + 会话列表小灯 + 全局解耦**：
  - **全局 = 总闸**：侧边栏底部那个开关，切换它会对所有「跟随中」的会话一次性生效（扫一遍）。
  - **局部可单独改**：composer 输入区左侧第一个按钮切换**当前会话**；一旦单独改过，该会话就**不再被全局切换带走**（两个方向都是）。
  - **显式的「全局解耦」开关**：composer 左侧第二个按钮。两个圆环相接＝跟随全局，分开＝已解耦；点一下在「解耦 / 接回」之间切换。它**只切换连接关系**，不改变此刻是否生效。右键第一个按钮也能恢复跟随（等价快捷方式）。
  - **会话列表小灯**：每行一个微微发蓝光的小灯，亮 = 该会话此刻生效；已解耦的会多一圈淡环。全局默认开着时每行都会亮（它们跟随默认），只有被单独关掉的会话不亮。
  - **全局侧可见**：侧边栏开关的提示里会显示「· N 个已解耦」。
  - **已知限制**：行首位置由宿主条件渲染，下列四种行**不渲染**该插槽，小灯在这些时刻不显示——归档（archived）、空白（blank）、**正在运行**（显示状态点）、**有未读标记**。依据：`.recon/workspace.client.js` 里 `!row.archived && !row.blank && (showStatus ? … : unread ? … : renderSlot("sidebar.session.row.leading", …))`。这是宿主行为，插件不去改它。
  - 另需注意：小灯反映的是**开关意图**，不是"此刻一定生效"。若策略目标不在 provider 目录里（模型下线/改名），路由会**静默回落到会话原模型**，只在 `debug.log` 留一行——此时小灯仍是亮的。
- **多端可用**：开关同时挂在左侧边栏底部与 composer 输入区左侧。窄屏（<1024px 侧边栏自动收起、Windows/macOS 收起态整列宽度为 0）时由 composer 入口兜底，两个入口共享同一份状态。

## 目录

- `SKILL.md` — 「避峰岗」技能说明
- `lib/index.js` — Node 端：策略引擎、`agentDefaultModel` 门控、`agent/request` 覆盖、RPC
- `lib/text.js` — **唯一维护文件**：默认定义（`DEFAULTS`）+ 中英文案（`zh`/`en`）
- `src/client/*.js` — 客户端源码（开关 / 选择器 / 策略编辑 / 设置页 / 入口）
- `lib/client.js` — **生成物**：由 `src/build-client.mjs` 拼接各 source 并注入 `lib/text.js` 文案，请勿手改
- `src/build-client.mjs` — 客户端构建脚本
- `scripts/verify.mjs` — 仓库自检（契约、不变式、版本一致性、产物新鲜度）
- `scripts/roundtrip.test.mjs` — 副模型往返回归（防止形状错配复发）
- `scripts/copy.test.mjs` — 界面文案单一来源与本地化映射检查
- `scripts/session-state.test.mjs` — 每会话状态语义（覆盖 / 跟随默认 / 清除 / 容量上限 / 会话 id 读取）
- `scripts/session-fuzz.mjs` — 随机化差分属性测试：200 次随机操作 × 12 个探针 id（含 `__proto__`、`constructor`、超长与 Unicode id），**期望值独立地从 `state.json` 重算**，用来抓跨会话串扰与身份透传违规（`npm run fuzz`，可传种子）
- `CHANGELOG.md` — 变更记录与版本策略
- `cordis.patch.yml` — 自激活 patch（bundle 安装用）
- `package.json` — 插件清单（含 `dsh.client` 声明）

## 开发

```bash
node src/build-client.mjs   # 重建 lib/client.js（改了 src/client 或 lib/text.js 后必跑）
npm run verify              # 五套检查（只读，不写任何产物）
npm run fuzz                # 只跑随机化差分属性测试（可传随机种子）
```

`npm run verify` 覆盖：文案 key 完整性/双语对称、client↔node RPC 契约、关键不变式
（`inject=['llm']`、`agent/request` 带 `prepend`、无 `registerAdapter`/`llm/stream` 残留、
未触碰会话模型选择器）、版本一致性（`package.json` ↔ `CHANGELOG.md` ↔ `README.md`/`SKILL.md`
的「当前版本」）、产物新鲜度（**构建到临时文件比对，不重写仓库里的产物**）、仓库顶层文件集合、
副模型形状往返、界面文案无硬编码中文、每会话状态语义、随机化差分属性测试。

## 安装

1. 装成 bundle（推荐，GUI 生效）：
   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库路径或 git URL>
   ```
2. 或手工 patch `insert`（仅 Node 端，无 GUI）：
   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-peak-valley-router
         name: <本仓库/lib/index.js 绝对路径>
         config: { ...见 SKILL.md 的配置结构... }
   ```

装完**重启 DSH**，打开「设置 → 避峰岗」即可在 GUI 里配置多模型协同策略。

## 峰谷规则

- 高峰：北京时间周一至周五（不含法定节假日）09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00
- 谷时：其余时间（含周末、节假日全天），价格为峰时 1/2

## 运行时数据

插件只在 `DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-peak-valley-router/` 下写三个文件：

- `policy.json` — GUI 保存的策略
- `state.json` — 开关状态：`{ enabled, sessions }`。`enabled` 是**全局默认**，`sessions` 是**每会话覆盖**表（没有覆盖的会话跟随默认；上限 500 条，按最近写入淘汰）。旧文件（只有 `enabled`）行为完全不变。
- `debug.log` — 诊断日志（只在 apply / 目录读取失败 / 开关切换 / 每个新接管目标时各记一行）

## 已知限制

- **跨窗口/多进程不同步**：开关状态在插件加载时读一次，客户端也不轮询。同一台机器上开两个窗口，A 的改动要等 B 重新加载才可见；两个 DSH 进程共用同一个 `DSH_HOME` 时，各自持有自己的快照，后写的一方会覆盖**整张** `sessions` 表（写入是原子的，但没有合并语义）。单窗口单进程使用不受影响。
- **目标模型不在目录里时静默回落**：策略目标（主模型/副模型/高级思考模型）若不在该 provider 当前的模型目录中（下线、改名、订阅登出），路由会保留会话原模型，只在 `debug.log` 记一行。此时开关与小灯仍显示"开"——它们反映的是**开关意图**，不是"此刻一定生效"。
- **配额/限流不归避峰岗管**：它只决定"用哪个 provider/model"。若目标 provider 的账号池处于 429 冷却（如订阅套餐的 5 小时窗口用尽），请求会在 provider 层失败。避峰岗不会自动改道到别的模型——那会让"为什么换模型"变得不可预测；需要时请改配置或暂时关掉开关。
- **行首小灯的显示条件**：见上文「每会话独立状态」一节的四条隐藏条件（宿主行为）。
- **并发点击**：写盘期间开关按钮是禁用的，被丢弃的那次点击不会报错（没有队列）。

plugins.description: 把 **OpenCode Zen** 的免费模型接进 **DeepSeek Harness**：实时发现官方免费档模型，在设置里逐个启停，一键写入 provider。**免 key**
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-connect-opencode-free

把 **OpenCode Zen** 的免费模型接进 **DeepSeek Harness**：实时发现官方免费档模型，在设置里逐个启停，一键写入 provider。**免 key**，认证固定为 `Bearer public`。

> OpenCode Zen 是第三方公开服务，其可用性、模型清单与限流策略由其运营方决定。本插件只是客户端适配层。

## 功能

- **免 key 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费档**：匿名通道复用公开额度，认证固定为 `Bearer public`；为通过免费档校验，适配器会伪装成 OpenCode CLI（特定的 `User-Agent`、`x-opencode-session` 会话 id，以及 `bash`/`read` 工具名）。
- **`bash`/`read` 是真工具，不是占位**：免费档网关要求请求里必须出现 `bash` 与 `read` 两个名字，只挂名字不实现会让模型去调一个永远无法执行的工具、整轮被带偏（这正是同一模型在 OpenCode 里流畅、走本插件却报错的原因）。因此插件把这两个名字注册成**真实可执行**的工具（见 `lib/gate-tools.js`）。
- **双源模型发现**：实时合并 `opencode.ai/zen/v1/models`（此刻真实存在哪些 id）与 `models.dev/api.json` 的 `opencode` 段（哪些免费、上下文多大、支持什么能力），任一源不可达仍沿用上次结论，一次网络抖动不会让模型凭空消失。
- **设置页一键管理**：搜索、逐个启停、全部启用/停用、限流状态与恢复时间一目了然。
- **三档使用规则**：默认**仅使用公共额度**，配了 Key 也不动用；另外两档（公共优先 / 私有优先）需要先通过 Key 校验才能选用。详见[使用规则](#使用规则三档额度策略)。
- **一键写入 provider**：把当前免费模型列表写入 `llm-pi-ai.providers.opencode-zen`（也支持移除与手动补模型）。
- **额度与重试**：429 区分「公共额度」与「自有账号」记账、Key 轮换、退避重试。
- **流式健壮性**：工具调用块边界、推理档位、结束原因兜底；以及 wire 边界的防御——工具结果按 `role:tool` 序列化、空 `arguments` 归一为 `{}`、压缩/续接后孤立的工具结果改标为 `user` 而不发非法请求。

## 架构

| 半边     | 文件                             | 职责                                                     |
| ------ | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| 共享纯逻辑  | `lib/core.js`                  | 模型集合合并、provider 条目生成、命名空间解析。无依赖，宿主与浏览器共用               |
| 运行时配置  | `lib/config.js`                | schemastery Config，除缓存目录外全部 `volatile`                 |
| 模型发现   | `lib/discovery.js`             | 合并 `opencode.ai/zen/v1/models` 与 `models.dev/api.json` |
| 额度与密钥  | `lib/quota.js`                 | 429 记账与恢复时间估算、密钥解析（凭据库优先、环境变量兜底）、公共通道冷却、缓存读写           |
| Key 校验 | `lib/keycheck.js`              | 用一个最小请求证明 Key 被 Zen 接受；按指纹持久化，不存 Key 本身                |
| Key 录入 | `lib/core.js` + `lib/index.js` | 行号 → 环境变量名的映射（`apiKeyNameFor`）与注入/撤回                   |
| 宿主     | `lib/index.js`                 | 注册 `opencode-free` 路由、周期发现、目录缓存、本机目录桥                  |
| 适配器    | `lib/provider.js`              | 免 key 的 OpenAI 兼容 adapter：流式块边界、工具调用、推理档位、退避重试         |
| 浏览器    | `src/client.js`                | React 设置页，注册进 `settings.section` 槽位                    |

浏览器半边的产物 `lib/client.cjs` 由 `scripts/build.mjs` 从 `lib/core.js` + `src/client.js` 生成 —— 客户端模块系统的 `require` 只能解析包名和平台种子词，无法解析相对路径，所以共享逻辑必须内联。构建脚本还会拒绝任何未被内联的相对 import。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **cordis 插件包（bundle）**，通过 profile 的 `package.json` 接入。

### 方式一：npm 安装（推荐）

1. 进入目标 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile-name>/`）。
2. 在 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 中加入：
   ```json
   "dsh-connect-opencode-free": "^0.4.0"
   ```
3. 在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组中加入包名：
   ```json
   "dsh-connect-opencode-free"
   ```
4. 在该 profile 目录执行安装：
   ```sh
   pnpm install
   ```
5. 重启 dsh（如 `dsh web`），打开「设置 → OpenCode 免费模型」即可使用。

### 方式二：从源码运行（开发态）

1. clone 本仓库到本地。
2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 中用 `link:` 指向源码绝对路径：
   ```json
   "dsh-connect-opencode-free": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-connect-opencode-free"
   ```
3. 同样在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组中加入包名。
4. 执行 `pnpm install`，重启 dsh。

依赖要求：Node ≥ 18，且宿主提供 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`（peer 范围 `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0`）。`cordis.patch.yml` 由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动加载，无需手动处理。

> 提示：宿主半边的 `lib/` 为源码，`lib/client.cjs` 是 `npm run build` 生成的浏览器半边产物；从源码运行前请先执行 `npm run build`。

## 模型发现

目录由两个数据源合并，任一单独都不够：

- `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models` —— 哪些 id **此刻真的存在**；
- `https://models.dev/api.json` 的 `opencode` 段 —— 哪些**免费**、上下文多大、支持什么能力。

免费与否由 models.dev 决定（`cost` 全 0），供应与否由 Zen 决定。一个源不可达时沿用上次的判断（冷启动则按免费目录推定并在设置页注明），因此一次网络抖动不会让模型凭空消失。目录缓存写在 `<DSH_HOME>/cache/opencode-zen-catalog.json`。

Zen 的模型接口不返回 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`，浏览器读不到，所以发现动作在宿主完成，再由一个仅监听 `127.0.0.1` 的目录桥交给设置页（端口可配，被占用时自动顺延，响应带标记头并通过 `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` 暴露）。

## 请求

- **块边界**：上游只发扁平 delta，从不声明块的起止，所以边界由适配器决定——任何时刻只开一块：思考一旦有正文就闭合，工具一开始就把思考与正文都闭合。三个 token 计数互斥：缓存命中从输入里扣除，推理 token 单列。
- **结束原因**：网关经常不给 `finish_reason`（工具调用帧尤其如此），缺省时按这一轮是否产出过工具调用判定。
- **推理档位**：目录标为 `reasoning` 的模型声明 `off/low/high/max` 四档，选择器据此提供选项，显式指定的档位才不会被 llm 服务以 `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` 拒绝；`off` 用省略字段表示，因为 Zen 不接受该取值。不设默认档，保留 Zen 自己的默认。
- **额度顺序**：由 `quotaPolicy` 决定（详见[使用规则](#使用规则三档额度策略)），默认 `publicOnly`——只用公共免费额度。每个 Key 名先查 Harness 凭据库（设置里保存的 key 在这里，不在环境变量里），再查进程环境。
- **失败提示**：429 区分「公共额度」与「自有账号」，401/403 说明是凭据被拒还是没给，并给出下一步（去哪取 key、检查哪个账号），而不是只抛一个状态码。两条额度都用尽时，报**第一个失败的 Key** 而不是最后一个——要修的是它。

## 设置

打开「设置 → OpenCode 免费模型」。所有字段 `volatile`，改完立即生效，不需要重启。

| 字段                     | 默认值                           | 说明                                                                                           |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`              | `true`                        | 总开关；关闭后所有免费模型撤下                                                                              |
| `zenBaseURL`           | `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1`  | Zen 接口根                                                                                      |
| `catalogURL`           | `https://models.dev/api.json` | 模型目录                                                                                         |
| `autoSync`             | `true`                        | 持续发现                                                                                         |
| `pollIntervalMs`       | `3600000`                     | 发现间隔                                                                                         |
| `catalogTimeoutMs`     | `20000`                       | 目录请求超时                                                                                       |
| `includeDeprecated`    | `false`                       | 是否列出**已下架**的免费模型。默认不列出任何已下架的：models.dev 标记弃用的，以及 Zen 已下架的。勾选后两者都列出，但 Zen 已下架的仍标记为不可用，勾了也无法调用 |
| `apiKeys`              | `[]`                          | **私有额度 Key 列表**，逐行填值即可；保存后按 `OPENCODE_API_KEY`、`OPENCODE_API_KEY_1`… 自动写入进程环境变量，删行即撤回        |
| `apiKeyEnv`            | `''`                          | 高级：自管密钥时填已有环境变量名（逗号分隔轮换），仅在 `apiKeys` 为空时生效                                                  |
| `quotaPolicy`          | `publicOnly`                  | 使用规则：`publicOnly` 仅用公共额度；`preferPublic` 公共优先、被拒时回退私有；`preferKey` 私有优先、失败时回退公共。后两者需先通过 Key 校验 |
| `maxRequestAttempts`   | `10`                          | 单次请求最多尝试次数（429 与所有 5xx 都会退避重试；上限 20）                                                            |
| `retryBackoffMs`       | `800`                         | 重试初始退避，按次数指数增长                                                                               |
| `defaultContextWindow` | `200000`                      | 目录未给大小时的兜底                                                                                   |
| `realGateTools`        | `true`                        | 把网关要求的 `bash`/`read` 注册成真实可执行工具；关闭后它们只是占位，模型调用会被忽略并提示（**即时生效**，无需重启）                         |
| `disabledModels`       | `[]`                          | 停用的模型 id                                                                                     |
| `manualModels`         | `[]`                          | 手动添加的模型                                                                                      |
| `bridgePort`           | `18766`                       | 目录桥端口                                                                                        |
| `cachePath`            | `''`                          | 缓存文件；留空用 `<DSH_HOME>/cache/`                                                                 |
| `debug`                | `false`                       | 宿主输出详细日志                                                                                     |

页面提供：搜索、逐个启停、全部启用/停用、一键写入 `llm-pi-ai.providers.opencode-zen`、移除 provider、手动添加模型、公共额度的限流/被拒状态与恢复时间、三档使用规则选择，以及逐行录入的 Key 列表与校验按钮。

## 使用规则：三档额度策略

「设置 → OpenCode 免费模型」底部的 **使用规则** 决定一次调用可以花谁的额度。默认是 **仅使用公共额度**——本插件的意义是免 key，所以一个恰好躺在环境变量里的 Key 不会自动变成所有调用的计费对象。

| 规则           | 值              | 顺序                   | 需要 Key 校验 |
| ------------ | -------------- | -------------------- | --------- |
| **仅使用公共额度**  | `publicOnly`   | 只用公共额度，配了 Key 也不动用   | 否（默认）

plugins.description: DSH 技能管理器：自带基础技能与中文工程流程技能包，按「你遇到的问题」分组展示，模型可在对话里直接读写；升级技能包不覆盖你改过的文件。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-starter

**装完就有 6 个能直接用的技能，外加一个 20 个技能的工程流程包。** 设置页里能看能改，AI 也能在对话里直接读写技能库。

| 装完立刻得到 | 是什么 |
|---|---|
| **6 个基础技能** | `ask-first` 需求没说清时先问完再动手、`prove-it` 改之前先说清怎么验证、`write-my-skill` 一句话把你的做法记成技能 |
| **20 个工程流程技能** | 从拷问需求 → 收规格 → 拆票 → 实现 → 双轴审查 → 复盘，一整套；外加诊断 bug、TDD、原型、研究、教学 |
| **按症状分组的面板** | 按「你遇到的问题」分组，不用记技能名；能编辑、新建、复制内置技能 |
| **一张「我该用哪个」对照表** | 29 行处境对照，点一行跳到对应技能 |
| **AI 在对话里直接读写** | 你说「把这套流程记下来」，它直接落盘，不会写错格式 |

> **升级技能包不会覆盖你改过的文件。** 装进来之后那份归你——插件只加新技能、修错字，不碰你动过的任何一行。

技能（skill）是 DSH 里最实用的东西：把一套做法写成一个文件，之后随时调用，AI 每次都按同一套流程做事。麻烦的地方在于管——文件散在几个目录、frontmatter 写法要记、装了一堆想不起用哪个、改过的还怕被升级冲掉。

**这个插件把这几件事一起解决了。**

---

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-skill-starter
```

`desktop` 换成你自己的 profile 名（`~/.dsh/profiles/` 下面的目录名）。装完重启 `dsh`。

包在 npm 上：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-skill-starter>。

验证：设置页里出现「**Skill 管理**」这一项，或者直接问 AI「我有哪些技能」。

### 装不下来时改用源码包

网络或镜像有问题时，改用 GitHub 上的固定 tag 地址：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/ymck-x/dsh-skill-starter/archive/refs/tags/v0.3.0.tar.gz
```

> **请照抄这个完整地址，不要改成 `refs/heads/main.tar.gz`。**
> 分支地址的内容会随作者推代码而改变，而 pnpm 会记下你安装当时的指纹。
> 之后你装**任何**插件时，pnpm 都会重新核对全部旧依赖，一旦发现指纹对不上就中止整次安装
> （`ERR_PNPM_TARBALL_INTEGRITY`），而且报错指向一个你当时根本没在装的包。
> `refs/tags/` 指向一次固定发布，内容永不改变——代价是**换版本时要手改上面那个 tag 号**。

也不要写成 `github:ymck-x/dsh-skill-starter` 这种简写：它会被 pnpm 解析成 SSH 地址（`git+ssh://`），而匿名 SSH 访问 GitHub 会被直接拒绝，装不上。

### 没有 dsh 命令时手动装

`dsh plugin add` 内部就是「pnpm 装包 + 把包名写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`」。你也可以自己做这两步：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-skill-starter
```

从 npm 装不下来时，把 `dsh-skill-starter` 换成上面那个 GitHub tag 地址。

再把 `dsh-skill-starter` 加进同一个目录里 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-skill-starter"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

重启 `dsh` 即生效。

### 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skill-starter
```

手动装的：从 `bundles` 里删掉这一项，再 `pnpm remove dsh-skill-starter`。

**卸载不影响你写的技能**——它们在 `~\.dsh\skills\` 里，不属于插件。

---

## 它做什么

### 一、设置页里的面板

打开「设置 → Skill 管理」，你看到的是**按你遇到的问题分的组**，不是按名字排的字母序：

```
开工之前
  先把票据和规格放在哪定下来。
  setup-tickets

别让它做错方向
  动手之前，把没问清的问完。
  ask-first

看不懂就拉回来
  说「没看懂」时，用大白话重讲上一段。
  plain-words

别让「改好了」是空话
  先说清用什么办法验证，改完真的跑一遍再报告。
  prove-it
  一次只走一小步，每步验证过再继续。
  tiny-steps

让它记住你的做法
  一句话把你的做法记成技能文件。
  write-my-skill
```

选一条就能改：名称、描述、使用时机、正文，还有两个调用开关。也能新建、删除、把内置技能复制一份出来改。中英双语，跟着界面语言走。

### 二、「我该用哪个」

面板里有一块处境对照表，直接显示路由技能里那张表——现在 29 行，点一行就跳到对应的技能。

这张表**不是复制过来的**：插件每次从 `skills-map/SKILL.md` 现读现解析，所以它和路由技能永远是同一份内容，不会两边说法不一致。

### 三、技能包

技能包是「一组相关技能，一次装完」。自带一个：

| 包 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `engineering-zh` | 20 个中文工程流程技能：拷问需求 → 收成规格 → 拆票 → 实现 → 双轴审查 → 复盘，外加诊断 bug、TDD、原型、研究、教学、交接 |

**升级不覆盖你的修改**，三层保护：

| 情况 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 你改过这个文件 | 跳过，并在结果里点名 |
| 文件已存在且内容不同 | **绝不覆盖**，单独列出 |
| 内容相同 | 只登记指纹，不动文件 |

所以想改包里的技能，直接改用户目录里那份就行，不用担心下次升级被冲掉。

### 四、模型能直接用

插件注册六个工具，AI 在对话里就能读写技能库、装卸技能包，不用你打开设置页：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `skill_list` | 列出全部技能：来源、调用方式、是否被覆盖、附件数 |
| `skill_read` | 读出完整内容与附件清单 |
| `skill_write` | 新建或修改 |
| `skill_delete` | 删除 |
| `skill_pack_list` | 技能包状态 |
| `skill_pack_install` | 安装或升级，不覆盖你的改动 |

所以你说「把这套流程记下来」，它会直接落盘，不会写错格式。

---

## 为什么这么设计

### 问题一：技能写完了没人用

技能要生效，得有人知道它什么时候该上场。三种做法叠起来解决：

- **描述里写用户的原话**。`tdd` 的描述是「说『写个测试再实现』『先红后绿』时使用」——AI 靠这句判断该不该自己调用。
- **面板按症状分组**。用户先看到症状（「别让『改好了』是空话」），再看到药。
- **只给人用的技能明确标出来**。会改变工作状态的动作（收规格、拆票、交接、复盘）只允许你手动发起，AI 不能自己决定。

### 问题二：装了一堆，不知道什么时候用哪个

二十多个技能，靠记名字不现实。所以有一张按**处境**写的对照表：

| 你现在的处境 | 加载哪个技能 |
|---|---|
| 有个想法，要把它问清楚 | `grilling` |
| 需求没说清，要先把该问的一次问完 | `ask-first` |
| 要在一个项目里建好票据约定 | `setup-tickets` |
| 要把已经聊清楚的结论写成规格 | `to-spec` |
| 要把规格拆成多张票据 | `to-tickets` |
| 做完了，不知道改动有没有问题 | `code-review` |
| 没坏，但比以前慢很多 | `diagnosing-bugs` |
| 这段代码改一次要动好几个地方 | `improve-codebase-architecture` |
| 不确定这个模块该怎么切 | `codebase-design` |
| 同一个词团队里有两个意思 | `domain-modeling` |
| 答案在别人脑子里 | `to-questionnaire` |
| 没听懂上一条 | `wait-what` |

完整 29 行在面板里，也在 `skills-map` 技能里。

### 问题三：技能越多，每轮对话越贵

技能的描述是**常驻**的——不管用不用，它都在每轮请求里占位置。所以插件把这个成本算清楚并公布：

| 部分 | 规模 | 估算 |
|---|---|---|
| 插件自带 6 个技能 | 448 字 | 约 269 到 538 token |
| 技能包 20 个技能（装了才有） | 1776 字 | 约 1066 到 2131 token |
| 六个工具的 schema | 671 字 | 约 403 到 805 token |
| **设置面板** | — | **0**（只在浏览器里跑） |
| **合计（装了技能包）** | 2895 字 | **约 1737 到 3474 token** |

不想要工具那部分开销，可以在配置里关掉：

```yaml
- id: dsh-skill-starter
  config:
    enableTools: false
```

关掉之后模型侧开销归零，设置面板照常。「我该用哪个」那块表也照常——它走面板自己的接口，不进模型上下文。

自己量一遍：

```sh
node measure.mjs
```

### 问题四：升级把改动覆盖了

上面那三层保护就是答案。设计上是这么想的：**技能包给的是起点，不是终点**。装进来之后那份文件归你，插件只负责以后添新技能、修错别字，不碰你动过的任何一行。

---

## 技能清单

技能分两类，区别在**谁能调用**：

- **模型可调用**：任务合适时 AI 会自己用；你也能打 `/名字` 手动调。
- **只允许人工发起**：只有你打出 `/名字` 才生效。它们会改变工作状态，不该由 AI 自己决定什么时候做。

### 插件自带（6 个基础技能）

| 技能 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|
| `ask-first` | 用户提出还没说清的需求（「加个导出功能」） |
| `plain-words` | 用户说「没看懂」「说人话」 |
| `prove-it` | 任何改动开始前，先说清怎么验证 |
| `tiny-steps` | 改动涉及多个文件，或用户说「一步步来」 |
| `write-my-skill` | 用户说「把这条记下来」「以后都这样做」 |
| `setup-tickets` | 要给一个项目建票据约定 |

### 技能包 `engineering-zh`（20 个）

**只允许人工发起（9 个）**

| 技能 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `to-spec` | 把已经聊定的结论收成一份规格 |
| `to-tickets` | 拆成一组能各自收工的票据 |
| `implement` | 按票据逐张做出来 |
| `retro` | 回看这段会话，改进工作环境 |
| `handoff` | 压成交接文档，换人换机器接着干 |
| `to-questionnaire` | 答案在别人手里时，写一份问卷去问 |
| `wait-what` | 没听懂上一条，用大白话重讲 |
| `teach` | 跨多次会话学一门东西 |
| `improve-codebase-architecture` | 扫出结构改进机会，给候选让你挑 |

**模型可调用（11 个）**

| 技能 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `grilling` | 把还没想清的想法问到没有含糊 |
| `skills-map` | 路由表：从处境查到该用哪个 |
| `tdd` | 测试先行的红-绿循环 |
| `diagnosing-bugs` | 疑难 bug 的诊断纪律 |
| `code-review` | 双轴审查：规范轴 + 规格轴 |
| `codebase-design` | 深模块的词汇与判断标准 |
| `domain-modeling` | 维护项目术语表与架构决策记录 |
| `pr` | 拉取请求正文的三段结构 |
| `prototype` | 写一次性代码回答设计问题 |
| `research` | 查一手来源，留一份带引用的笔记 |
| `writing-for-agents` | 写给模型读的文档时的规范 |

技能包里的正文保持一屏内；词汇表、判断标准、例证这类细节放在同目录的附件里，正文末尾有一行指针。`tdd` 带 `MOCKING.md`，`code-review` 带 `SMELLS.md`，`codebase-design` 带 `DEEP-MODULES.md`，一共 10 份附件。

---

## 技能的三种来源

| 来源 | 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 项目级 | `<项目>\.dsh\skills\`、`<项目>\.agents\skills\` | 跟着仓库走，DSH 原生扫描 |
| 用户级 | `~\.dsh\skills\` | 面板和工具都管这里 |
| 内置 | 插件自带的 `skills\` | 只读；在用户目录放一份同名的就能覆盖 |

**同名时优先级：项目级 > 用户级 > 内置。** 项目根按「最近的含 `.git` 的目录」判定，所以在子目录里也能找到。

面板只列用户级和内置（浏览器端拿不到会话的工作目录）；项目级技能在对话里问 AI 就能看到。

---

## 和同类插件的关系

DSH 生态里已经有两个做技能的插件，侧重和我们不同：

| 插件 | 侧重 |
|---|---|
| `dsh-skills` | 把散落各处（Claude Code、项目目录、`.skill` 包）的技能**汇总入库**，引用或副本两种方式，能导出打包 |
| `asakumizy/dsh-local-skills` | 本地技能浏览器，Notion 风格的界面 |
| **本插件** | **技能内容本身 + 分发**：自带一整套能用的技能，用技能包分发，管升级与本地改动 |

三个装在一起不冲突（id 不同），只是功能有重叠。**同一个技能名不要装两份**，那样每个技能会被注册两次。

---

## 开发

```sh
node verify.mjs        # 自测 59 项：解析、增删改查、路径安全、工具定义、技能包、项目级扫描、路由表
node check-tools.mjs   # 用 DSH 自己的 JSON Schema 校验器检查六个工具的定义
node check-pack.mjs    # 检查技能包内容是否符合规范
node measure.mjs       # 量出每轮对话的固定开销
```

**技能文件**（`skills/*/SKILL.md`）改动会热生效，保存即用。

**插件代码**（`index.js`、`client.js`）改动需要重载：`client.js` 刷新页面即可；`index.js` 因为 Node 会缓存已加载的模块，要把插件卸掉再装（或重启 DSH）。

要往包里加技能、或者重写技能时，先读 [`REWRITE-GUIDE.md`](REWRITE-GUIDE.md)：那里记了附件该怎么分类（模板类压进正文，方法类与机制类必须留附件），以及第一次重写时因为「一律单文件」而丢掉 19% 内容的教训。

要发版时，先读 [`RELEASING.md`](RELEASING.md)：npm 现在只认勾了 `Bypass 2FA` 的令牌，那份文档写着令牌怎么建、`.npmrc` 怎么写、发布后必须收回什么，以及 `403` 和 `404` 各自真正代表什么（`404` 不是包名问题，是认证无效）。那份文档整份复制到别的项目也能用。

### 目录结构

```
dsh-skill-starter/
  package.json           插件清单（dsh.bundle.patch 指向下面的补丁）
  cordis.patch.yml       告诉 DSH 加载这个插件
  index.js               宿主侧：注册内置技能、六个工具，提供面板接口
  client.js              浏览器侧：设置页「Skill 管理」面板
  skills/                6 个基础技能
  packs/engineering-zh/  技能包：20 个技能 + 10 份附件
  verify.mjs             自测
  check-tools.mjs        工具定义校验
  check-pack.mjs         技能包规范校验
  measure.mjs            成本测量
  REWRITE-GUIDE.md       重写或新增技能的规范
  RELEASING.md           发版到 npm 的流程（可整份复制到别的项目）
  CHANGELOG.md           更新记录
```

---

## 许可

MIT
