plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ios-simulator-helper

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
![platform: macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS-lightgrey.svg)
[![target: DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-blue.svg)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) native port of the official ZCode `ios-simulator@0.1.0` plugin: all 20 original MCP tools preserved as native DSH tools, plus a full **settings page** (Settings → iOS Simulator) that edits the simulator parameters in-app instead of through environment variables.

- Tool and argument names are identical to the original, so workflows written for the `ios_simulator` MCP server keep working; one tool is added — `ios_shutdown_simulator`, because the original could boot a simulator but never stop one.
- 17 settings fields in 5 groups, all live-editable; an empty field falls back to the original plugin's `IOS_SIM_*` variable, then to the built-in default.
- The settings page detects the host system and, **on a non-macOS host, states that this plugin only supports macOS**; every tool that drives Apple tooling then refuses with a clear message instead of failing with `spawn xcrun ENOENT`, while `ios_preflight` reports the failing host check and `ios_discover_project`, `ios_create_app` and `ios_ui_status` still answer.
- Published as `@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper`; the plugin page shows **iOS Simulator Helper** / **iOS 模拟器助手** from `locale/` rather than the raw package name, and both descriptions say the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with Apple.

## Quick start

On a Mac with full Xcode, at least one iOS runtime and DSH installed:

1. **Install the plugin**

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper
   ```

   In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins** and add the same package name there. Reload or restart DSH afterwards.

2. **Check the machine** — open **Settings → iOS Simulator** and press **Run diagnostic**. It runs exactly the checks `ios_preflight` runs (full Xcode, a simulator runtime, `idb`), and prints a fix for anything missing.

3. **Use it** — ask for what you want ("build and run this project on the iPhone 16 simulator", "screenshot the running app"), or call the 21 `ios_*` tools directly. Everything the tools need is editable on that settings page.

## Contents

- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Settings page](#settings-page)
- [Screenshots](#screenshots)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Skill and slash command](#skill-and-slash-command)
- [Differences from the original](#differences-from-the-original)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Releases](#releases)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## Requirements

| Dependency | Notes |
|---|---|
| macOS | The only supported host. `xcrun simctl`, `xcodebuild` and the simulator window app exist nowhere else. |
| Full Xcode | `xcode-select -p` must point at `Xcode.app/Contents/Developer`; Command Line Tools alone are not enough. |
| An iOS Simulator runtime | At least one iOS/iPadOS runtime installed from Xcode → Settings → Platforms. |
| Node.js ≥ 22 | The DSH host runtime. |
| `idb` (optional) | Needed only by the `ios_ui_*` tools. Without it, build/run/screenshot/logs are unaffected. |

`ios_preflight` checks every item above and prints a fix for each failure; the settings page's "Run diagnostic" button runs the same checks.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper
```

**DSH Desktop**: the `desktop` profile belongs to the Electron app — open **Plugins**, add `@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper` there, and enable the row it creates. After a reload or restart the page is at **Settings → iOS Simulator**; it only appears while the host half actually serves this plugin's settings namespace.

The published tarball contains everything the plugin needs — the host half, the browser bundle, the bundled skill and the `locale/` entries — and nothing is compiled at install time, so no build approval step is involved. `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are **peer dependencies** provided by the harness, so the plugin pulls in no second copy and has **no runtime dependencies** of its own; DSH's compatibility gate compares the `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges against the running version and refuses to install on a mismatch.

> Mount the package exactly once. `dsh plugin add` records the row in `dsh.profile.bundles`; adding a second row for the same package in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` registers every tool name twice and fails at the loader.

### Upgrade and uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper@latest   # upgrade
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper      # uninstall
```

Settings live in the profile, not in the package, so both commands leave them in place. The data directory (by default `$DSH_HOME/ios-simulator-helper`) holds screenshots, build logs and DerivedData; it is yours to delete, and uninstalling does not touch it.

### Version gate

The DSH compatibility range is **`>=0.2.0-rc.2`, a lower bound only**, declared identically in `peerDependencies`, `engines.dsh` and `dsh.compatibility.dsh`: a runtime below it is refused at install time, and no future harness release is excluded.

One node-semver detail survives — a **new tuple's** prerelease such as `0.2.1-alpha.1` is not admitted by npm's and pnpm's default rules, so that install fails until either the range gains a branch for the tuple (`">=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.1-0 || >=0.2.1-0"`) or the peer check is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper \
  --config.strict-peer-dependencies=false
```

Stable releases (`0.2.0`, `0.2.1`, `0.3.0`, `1.0.0`, …) are unaffected and always admitted.

## Settings page

The settings namespace equals the profile patch row id equals `ios-simulator-helper` (also `dsh.name`). The page reads and writes through `ctx.configForms`, so staged edits, dirty detection, inline validation, optimistic concurrency (revisions) and "overridden / reset to default" all come from the harness. It is one card per category, built from the same field kit as the built-in settings pages (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`); the three timeouts are entered in whole seconds, while the legacy `IOS_SIM_*_MS` variables are still read in milliseconds and converted.

Saving happens in a pill that sticks to the bottom of the page: it appears while edits are staged (or a write is in flight, or one failed), names that state next to a status dot, and carries **Discard changes** and **Save** (disabled while a draft is invalid). A draft that merely puts a control back to the value already in effect counts as no edit at all, a confirmation toast reports a write that landed, and leaving the page discards staged edits.

| Group | Field | Type | Default | Legacy env fallback | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Simulator and device | `defaultDevice` | text (suggestions from this machine) | `iPhone 16` | `IOS_SIM_DEFAULT_DEVICE` | Device-name fragment used when a tool names no `udid`/`device`; falls back to the first available iPhone on a miss. |
| | `defaultRuntime` | text (suggestions from installed runtimes) | empty | `IOS_SIM_DEFAULT_RUNTIME` | Runtime fragment such as `iOS-27`; empty matches any. A **preference, not a requirement**: a stale value widens the pool instead of erroring. |
| | `autoBootSimulator` | switch | on | `IOS_SIM_AUTO_BOOT` | When off, tools fail instead of running `simctl boot` for a stopped target. |
| | `autoOpenSimulator` | switch | on | `IOS_SIM_AUTO_OPEN` | Matches the original by opening the Simulator window (boot / show / open URL / build and run); off keeps everything headless. |
| | `bootTimeoutSeconds` | integer | `120` | `IOS_SIM_BOOT_TIMEOUT_MS` (ms) | Longest wai

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Computer Use 插件：25 个工具让模型像人一样操作 Windows 桌面（截图 / UI Automation / 鼠标键盘 / 剪贴板），含置顶操作指示器与随包技能。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use 把 **ZCode 的 Computer Use（「电脑控制」）能力逆向重建为 DSH 插件**：让模型能看屏幕、 读应用界面、点按、输入、按快捷键、拖拽滚轮、走剪贴板——像人一样操作这台 Windows 电脑。 25 个工具与上游 Computer Use 工具面**同名**，参数语义、坐标纪律、`state_id` 元素寻址、 错误码语义都按上游契约重建；后端换成 Windows 上可用的原生实现 （长驻 `powershell.exe` + System.Drawing + UI Automation），不再依赖 ZCode 那份从未开源的 原生 Helper。 * 逆向复盘（过程 / 决策 / 验证强度 / 诚实的未竟项）：[docs/reverse-engineering.md](docs/reverse-engineering.md) * 上游契约取证（432 处 `path:line` 证据）：[docs/zcode-cua-contract.md](docs/zcode-cua-contract.md) * 原生桥协议（冻结接口）：[docs/native-protocol.md](docs/native-protocol.md) * 模型面操作手册（随包技能）：[skills/computer-use/SKILL.md](skills/computer-use/SKILL.md) --- ## 1. 它从哪来：一次真实的逆向 上游 ZCode 的开源仓库里 Computer Use 是**不可用占位包** （`packages/zcode-cua/index.js` 里 `createComputerUseRuntime()` 直接返回 "Computer Use is not available in this build."），三个必需资产 （`docs/computer-use.md`、`scripts/computer-use-client.mjs`、`skills/computer-use/SKILL.md`） 也不在仓库里。git 只有三个提交，真实实现从未进过历史。 能重建，是因为契约全留下了： | 留下的东西 | 位置 | |---|---| | 25 个工具名 | `packages/ui/src/ToolCallBlocks/renderers/cuaSummaryMessages.ts` | | 元素寻址/坐标/`action_sent` 等模型面纪律 | `apps/zcode-cli/packages/node-repl-host/src/tool-contract.ts` | | broker 私有传输协议（JSON 行 + `id/token/method/input/context`） | `node-repl-host/src/cua-bridge.ts`、`cua-broker.ts` | | 稳定错误码（`element_unavailable`/`foreground_required`/…） | `packages/zcode-cua/broker.js` | | `state_id`、`screenshot_display.bounds`、图像配额、`_meta` 关联键 | `core/src/tool/executor/result-display.ts`、`packages/zcode-cua/frame-contract.*` | | 官方插件定义、版本、seed 资产清单 | `bootstrap/src/app/official-plugin-definitions.ts` | **没**留下的：真实 SDK 的方法签名、Windows Helper 的 RPC、AX 角色映射表 （`ROLE_TO_KIND = {}`）、以及那三个资产文件本身。这些只能重建，见 [docs/zcode-cua-contract.md](docs/zcode-cua-contract.md) 的「未解之谜」与「重建对照表」。 --- ## 2. 架构 ``` ┌──────────────────────── DSH 进程 ────────────────────────┐ │ src/index.js 插件入口：读配置、注册工具、自装技能 │ │ src/tools.js 25 个工具定义 → 参数映射/信封/降级 │ │ src/schema.js 官方同语义的参数校验 + 无损宽化 │ │ src/format.js 模型面信封、app-associations 元数据 │ │ src/bridge.js NDJSON 客户端：串行队列/超时换进程/自愈│ └───────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘ │ stdin/stdout NDJSON（dsh-cua/1） ┌───────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐ │ src/native/cua.ps1 长驻 Windows PowerShell 5.1 进程 │ │ SetProcessDPIAware → 截图/窗口/UIA/输入/剪贴板/启动应用 │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` 几个刻意的选择： * **不走 MCP、不用 `defineTool`。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 在插件侧解析不到 （实测 `createRequire(profile/index.js).resolve()` 失败），因此按注册表接受的 **原始 JSON Schema** 直接 `ctx.tools.register()`——这正是 MCP 服务器注册工具的方式。 参数校验由 `src/schema.js` 按官方子集语义补上（文案逐字对齐，测试里与官方实现对比）。 * **PowerShell 而不是原生 addon。** Windows 上 `System.Drawing` + `UIAutomationClient` 在 5.1 宿主开箱可用；不需要随包发布二进制，也不受 DSH 内部 koffi 影响。 * **`SetProcessDPIAware()` 是必须的。** 实测 150% 缩放下不调用它，截图是 1707x1067 而 UIA/窗口坐标是 2560x1600，两个坐标空间不一致，整个 Computer Use 的坐标映射都会错。 * **超时即换进程。** 协议是串行的；超时后无法判断迟到响应属于哪条请求，因此直接 kill 并在下次调用时重启，绝不猜测归属。 --- ## 3. 安装 插件是普通 npm 包 + 一份 cordis patch，两种装法： ### 3.1 App 内从路径安装（推荐） DSH 的「插件」页 → 从路径安装 → 选择本目录 （本仓库 clone 后的目录），然后**重启 DSH**。 ### 3.2 手改 profile 编辑 `/profiles//package.json` （Windows 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`）： ```jsonc "dependencies": { "dsh-computer-use": "link:E:/OpencodeProject/Project/DSH-Plugin/dsh-computer-use" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // …其它 bundle "dsh-computer-use" // ← 加入这里，它的 cordis.patch.yml 才会被应用 ] } } ``` 然后在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。 `cordis.patch.yml` 只做一件事：把本插件的宿主端入口 insert 进 profile 树。 ### 3.3 验证装好了 六层验证，全部可重复执行（数值是本机实测结果）： ```powershell cd <本仓库目录> node tools/ref-extract-validator.mjs # 从 app.asar 提取官方实现到 .ref/（开发期依赖，可选） npm test # 95 通过：单元 + 与官方实现的等价性交叉验证（含访问闸门矩阵） npm run smoke # 147 通过：原生后端 24 个协议方法（真机） npm run e2e # 74 通过：完整链路端到端（真机，含访问闸门验收） npm run indicator:smoke # 54 通过：操作指示器三条硬性质（真机，见下） npm run verify:registry # 10 通过：真实 cordis + 真实 dsh-tools 注册表加载 npm run verify:in-dsh # 14 通过：真实 DSH 里让模型自己点一次按钮（accessMode=auto） node tools/verify-in-dsh.mjs --patch=tools/verify-profile-patch.yml --access-mode=off # 10 通过：禁用场景（桌面未被碰） node tools/verify-in-dsh.mjs --patch=tools/verify-profile-patch.yml --access-mode=ask # 11 通过：询问场景（fail-closed） node tools/install-skill.mjs status # 技能是否已进用户技能根 ``` **关于 `--patch=tools/verify-profile-patch.yml`**：验证用的 `cu-verify` profile 来自出厂 headless 模板，默认走 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`；该 key 余额耗尽后每次运行都返回 402（`error.code === "QUOTA"`）， 模型压根不启动，于是这一层会全红——那不是插件的失败。这个叠加层把模型路由指到可用的 provider （你桌面 profile 里正在用的那套），**通过 `dsh --patch` 叠加，不修改任何 profile 文件**。 **关于 `--access-mode`**：三个场景跑的是**同一个任务**，唯一差别是这一条设置；判据用夹具窗口标题 这个外部事实，而不是工具自己的返回值。`off`/`ask` 场景的期望是"被拒 + 桌面一字未变"， `auto` 场景的期望是"真的点成功"。 `npm run indicator:smoke` 的两条判据（退出码 `0` 通过 / `1` 产品失败 / `2` 环境不稳定无法判定）： * **首选，与背景无关**：`PrintWindow` 让窗口把自己画进抓图 DC——指示器必须整张全黑（拒绝渲染）， 而同构造、无 affinity 的孪生窗必须正常画出卡片。实测 `indicator distinct=1 avgLuma=0` / `twin distinct=45 avgLuma=130`。 * 旁证，逐像素：显示 vs 隐藏截同一区域要求逐像素一致且 PNG 字节相同，并用「目击区」 排除「背景自己在变」。这条要求该区域静止；你屏幕上若跑着全屏游戏/视频，工具会诚实报 **INCONCLUSIVE** 而不是 FAIL。 `verify:in-dsh` 是最强的一层：在**真实 DSH** 里跑一个受控任务 （`dsh --profile

--json`，任务经 stdin 送入），让模型自己加载技能、读界面、 按 `element_index + state_id` 点我们自己的 WPF 夹具按钮；**结论不采信模型汇报**—— 脚本跑完后用原生后端独立再读一次窗口标题，只有真的变成 `CLICKED:1` 才算通过。 它需要一个独立验证 profile（不碰 `desktop`）： ```powershell # 1) 在 dsh 源码 checkout 里用出厂 headless 模板建验证 profile pnpm dsh cu-verify --from-default-profile headless # 2) 把插件装进它（DSH_PROFILE 决定目标 profile） $env:DSH_HOME="$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh"; $env:DSH_PROFILE='cu-verify' node tools/install-plugin.mjs --apply --install # 3) 跑 node tools/verify-in-dsh.mjs --profile=cu-verify ``` 也可以用带备份的安装器一步装进 profile（默认只预览，不改任何东西）： ```powershell node tools/install-plugin.mjs # dry-run：打印将要发生的改动 node tools/install-plugin.mjs --apply --install # 备份 + 写入 + pnpm install node tools/install-plugin.mjs --rollback # 从备份恢复 ``` 装好并重启 DSH 后，在会话里让模型调 `request_access`：它会回报平台、屏幕、DPI 感知、 显示器数量与后端可用性。**这是最直接的端到端确认。** --- ## 4. 配置 配置读 `/plugins/dsh-computer-use/config.json`（不存在则用默认值）， 也可以在 profile 的插件条目里用 `config:` 覆盖（内联优先）。损坏/缺字段时逐字段回退默认值。 | 字段 | 默认 | 含义 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 关掉后一个工具都不注册 | | `tools` | `"native"` | `native` = 25 个独立工具；`single` = 一个 `computer_use`（带 `action`），省 schema token | | `warmup` | `true` | 加载时预热后端；关掉则首次调用才拉起（多等约 1-2 秒冷启动） | | `installSkill` | `true` | 把随包技能装到 `/skills/computer-use/`（带所有权标记，不覆盖用户自写版本） | | `accessMode` | `"auto"` | 谁能调用电脑操控：`auto` 全自动 / `ask` 每次弹审批 / `off` 禁用（见 §5.4） | | `allowSubagents` | `false` | 是否允许**子代理**调用电脑操控（默认关闭：子代理动用户鼠标键盘时用户看不见也难喊停） | | `indicator` | `true` | 是否显示屏幕最前端的「DSH 正在操作电脑」浮层（见 §5.5） | | `indicatorLocale` | `"auto"` | 浮层文案语言：`auto` / `zh-CN` / `en-US` | | `indicatorShowAction` | `true` | 文案后是否带上当前动作（「· 正在点击」） | | `indicatorAutoHideMs` | `30000` | 无操作活动多久后自动隐藏（兜底，防止浮层滞留） | | `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 单次调用默认超时 | | `screenshotTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 截图/取界面树超时 | | `startupTimeoutMs` | `20000` | 等待后端 ready 上限 | | `maxRestarts` | `3` | 后端崩溃后自动重启上限，超出后报明确不可用原因 | | `screenshotMaxWidth` | `1600` | 模型可见截图长边上限（0 = 不缩放） | | `screenshotMaxBytes` | `524288` | 单张截图字节预算，超出按 png→jpeg→更小栅格降级重拍 | | `screenshotFormat` / `screenshotQuality` | `"png"` / `80` | 默认编码与 jpeg 质量 | | `saveFrames` / `keepFrames` | `true` / `40` | 截图落盘到 `plugins/dsh-computer-use/frames/`，只保留最新 N 张 | | `debug` | `false` | 把原生后端的 stderr 诊断写进 DSH 日志 | ```jsonc // 示例：省 token 的单工具模式 + 更小的截图 { "tools": "single", "screenshotMaxWidth": 1280, "screenshotFormat": "jpeg" } ``` --- ## 5. 工具面（25 个，与上游同名） | 分组 | 工具 | |---|---| | 环境与观察 | `request_access` `list_apps` `list_windows` `get_app_state` `screenshot` `zoom` | | 启动与聚焦 | `open_application`（聚焦窗口走 `list_windows` + 前台语义） | | 鼠标 | `left_click` `double_click` `triple_click` `right_click` `middle_click` `mouse_move` `left_click_drag` `scroll` | | 键盘 | `type` `key` `hold_key` | | 元素动作 | `set_value` `select_text` `perform_action` | | 等待与剪贴板 | `wait` `read_clipboard` `write_clipboard` | | 收尾 |

plugins.description: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation from both ends: a routing gate refuses flooding calls (curl/wget in any shell, web_fetch/read_page), and output already inside is slimmed after the tool runs — JSON re-encoded losslessly, tables windowed with line numbers, logs folded keeping diagnostics — originals readable byte-for-byte via ctk_retrieve.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-toolkit

> [简体中文](./README.zh.md) | **English** | [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle whose single job is **keeping bulk output out of the conversation**.

It separates *raw bytes* from *conclusions*: commands run in a child process, files are analysed in a sandbox, and long material is filed into a local knowledge base — while the conversation receives only conclusions, excerpts and counts. A routing gate refuses, before execution, the calls that would inevitably flood the transcript.

**No third-party runtime dependencies.** The knowledge base rides on Node's own `node:sqlite` (FTS5 included) and code execution uses interpreters already on the machine, so installing it pulls nothing else.

## What it is for

| Problem | What this does |
|---|---|
| A command prints thousands of lines; you only need a count | `ctk_execute` runs it in a child process and returns the answer |
| A large file needs statistics, not a full read | `ctk_execute_file` keeps its bytes in the sandbox |
| Many commands, one question | `ctk_batch_execute` answers in one call with per-command status |
| A page or spec is read once and never reused | `ctk_index` files it; `ctk_search` pulls excerpts on demand |
| `curl` / `wget` paste whole responses into the conversation | The routing gate refuses them and names the alternative |
| You cannot tell how much was saved | `ctk_stats` reports the ledger; the settings page shows a live occupancy panel |

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ctk_execute` | Run code in a sandboxed child process (javascript / esm / typescript / shell), return only the answer |
| `ctk_execute_file` | Run code over a file for statistics or extraction; the file text stays in the sandbox |
| `ctk_batch_execute` | Several commands in one call, per-command status, conclusions only |
| `ctk_index` | File text or a file into the local FTS5 knowledge base |
| `ctk_search` | Multi-query retrieval; excerpts are centred on the match |
| `ctk_retrieve` | Read back a slimmed output's stored original, byte-for-byte, from its `[ctk_retrieve id=…]` marker |
| `ctk_fetch_and_index` | Fetch pages → strip markup → file them |
| `ctk_purge` | Delete filed material (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `ctk_stats` | Savings ledger: refusals, sandbox bytes, filed bytes, call counts |
| `ctk_doctor` | Self-check: interpreters really start, scratch dir writable, knowledge round-trip |
| `ctk_context_report` | This conversation's context occupancy and composition |

## Install

From npm (recommended):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-context-toolkit
```

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chimneyQ/dsh-context-toolkit
```

From a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\dsh-context-toolkit
```

Confirm `dsh-context-toolkit` appears in `dsh.profile.bundles` inside `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/package.json`.

Remove:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-context-toolkit
```

## Use it well

**Reach for `ctk_*` first** whenever the work is analysis, counting, filtering or summarising — reading that output into the conversation is the exact problem this bundle exists to solve.

```js
// How many .log files, and how big in total?
await ctk_execute({
  language: 'javascript',
  code: `
    const fs = require('fs');
    const dir = process.argv[2];
    let n = 0, bytes = 0;
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
      if (!f.endsWith('.log')) continue;
      n++; bytes += fs.statSync(dir + '/' + f).size;
    }
    console.log(n + ' files, ' + bytes + ' bytes');
  `
});
```

File long material once, then pull sections:

```js
await ctk_index({ path: 'D:/specs/api.md' });          // the full text stays in the store
await ctk_search({ queries: ['rate limit', 'auth'] });  // only the relevant excerpts come back
```

## TLS on a proxy-intercepted network

If every `ctk_fetch_and_index` fails with `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE`, the machine sits behind a
TLS-inspecting proxy and Node's built-in roots cannot verify what the proxy presents. `caPemPath`
names a PEM to trust instead.

`auto` (the default) points at `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode/ca/windows-roots.pem`. **This package does not
ship that file** — it is a snapshot of the *host's own* root store, so on a fresh machine it simply is
not there and fetching falls back to Node's default roots.

Settings → Context Toolkit shows a row under `caPemPath`:

- a badge saying whether the file exists (and its size), checked with a stat on page load — the bundle
  itself is never read just to render the page;
- a button that writes it from the system root store (`tls.getCACertificates('system')`, ~500
  certificates, ~820 KB) when pressed.

A bundle that already exists is never replaced on a single click: the first press asks, and only the
explicit confirmation overwrites it.

**What this does not do:** it exports the *system* store. If the proxy's root certificate was never
installed into that store — IT pushes it via group policy, for instance — the exported bundle still
will not verify the proxy. Install the root first, then export.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `routing` | `true` | Master switch for the routing gate |
| `denyCurlWget` | `true` | Block curl / wget outright |
| `bashNudgeMinCommandBytes` | `4096` | Nudge threshold for long commands (0 disables) |
| `maxReadBytesBeforeAsk` | `51200` | Nudge threshold for whole-file reads (0 disables) |
| `nudgeFetchTools` | `true` | Nudge the host fetchers (`web_fetch` / `read_page`) too |
| `trustedReadBasenames` | `package.json` etc. | Filenames exempt from the read nudge |
| `compressNudgeTokens` | `120000` | Occupancy warning threshold (tokens) |
| `searchLimit` | `5` | Excerpts per query in `ctk_search` |
| `snippetChars` | `900` | Character ceiling per excerpt |
| `fetchMaxBytes` | `2000000` | Per-page fetch ceiling |
| `caPemPath` | `auto` | TLS trust store for `ctk_fetch_and_index`: `auto` = `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode/ca/windows-roots.pem`, an absolute PEM path, or empty for Node's default roots. Set it when a TLS-inspecting proxy makes every https fetch fail on the certificate. |
| `storageDir` | empty | Knowledge-base root; empty = `<DSH_HOME>/context-toolkit` |
| `tools.*` | see below | Per-tool switches |

Tool switches: `tools.execute`, `tools.executeFile`, `tools.batchExecute`, `tools.index`, `tools.search`, `tools.fetchAndIndex`, `tools.purge`, `tools.stats`, `tools.contextReport`, `tools.doctor` — all on by default.

## Verify

The offline suites need no DSH runtime:

```bash
node smoke.mjs        # 104 checks: contract, runtime discovery, tools, gate (segment matching, host-aligned path base, script_path and host-fetcher coverage), output slimming with reversible retrieval and retention, CA bundle presence/export, resource disposal, knowledge base, observability, version reporting
node test-client.mjs  # 27 checks: browser-half contract and bilingual dictionary parity
node test-package.mjs # 20 checks: publish manifest and the zero-dependency constraint
node release-check.mjs # 34 checks: release readiness (manifest, deps, tool count, gate matching, version, SHA coverage, no hardcoded paths)
```

## Output slimming (after a tool runs)

The gate works at the *door*; slimming handles what is **already inside**. They catch different traffic: the gate can only read a call's *arguments*, while slimming sees the *bytes that actually came back* — from a tool the gate does not know, an entry point it does not cover, or output that was never predictable from the call.

At `tools/post-execute`, the strategy follows the shape:

| Shape | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Uniform JSON array | **Lossless** tabular re-encoding: keys written once, no information dropped |
| Table | Header plus both ends kept; the middle stride-sampled **with original line numbers** (the model gets a map with coordinates) |
| grep / search | Folded by file, first hits per file kept |
| Log | Ordinary lines folded away, **diagnostics kept verbatim** |
| Long prose | Head/tail window with an explicit elision marker |
| Code / key-value | **Not compressed** (the model may b

plugins.description: Split reading from deciding: the root agent plans and owns every file mutation; subagents are structurally read-only and report findings as summaries.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-root-planner-preset

An agent preset for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) that **separates deciding from doing**.

The root agent's context holds the plan and the decisions; reading, editing and running commands go to subagents that report back summaries. Subagents are full workers — they have `write`, `edit` and a shell — and the one thing none of them may leave behind is **a process still running**.

> The root decides, the workers do the work, and nothing outlives the task.

**Requires DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer.** The package declares it as `engines.dsh`, so the plugin manager refuses to install on an older runtime. The floor is not cosmetic: 0.2.1 introduced `agentPreset` on the delegation tool and removed `toolFilter`. On 0.2.0 this preset still composes, and then quietly runs every child on the platform's default preset — wrong persona, twice the tools — which is worse than not installing it at all.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) | [Install](INSTALL.md) | [Maintainer notes](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)

## The problem it solves

On a long task a coding agent's context fills up with raw file contents and command output, and it forgets the goal, loses the plan, and starts repeating work. The usual answer — "delegate more to subagents" — fails in two opposite directions: a delegate with no hands cannot do anything, so every step bounces back; and a fleet of delegates with no bounds will edit whatever they like and leave servers running.

This preset takes the middle line: **workers with tools, bounded by their task.**

| Requirement | Mechanism | Strength |
|---|---|---|
| A subagent can read, **edit files and run commands** | The `root-planner-worker` preset mounts `tool-fs`, `tool-pwsh`, `tool-web` and the delegation rows; every delegation spawns into that preset by name | Grant by construction — a worker without tools is not a worker |
| A subagent cannot leave a process running | `enableRunInBackground: false` on the preset's `pwsh` row: the call is refused **and** `run_in_background` is removed from the tool schema | **Structural** — no model at any depth can reach for a detached process |
| Nobody runs an unbounded service | Persona rules for the root and for subagents | Prompt-level, covering what a schema cannot (`ops_bash` has no job registry) |
| A subagent stays inside its own workspace | Persona rules: write only under `_agents/<label>/`, the parent's files read-only to it, outside changes sent as a request | Prompt-level, **verified** by the parent (see below) |
| Delegation depth is the user's setting | The runtime depth cap (`subagent.maxDepth`) | **Structural**: past the cap it throws `SubagentDepthError` |
| Live children are capped as well | `subagent.maxActiveSubagents` | **Structural**: past the cap a delegation fails with `subagent limit reached`, and it does not queue |
| The root decides; workers execute | Persona rules | Prompt-level |

The worker's toolset is an **allow list by construction**: a tool exists for a worker only if the worker preset mounts the plugin that provides it. A tool added by a future plugin — or by the app — is invisible to workers until a row is added here.

One caveat, measured rather than assumed: a small number of tools are registered **globally** by the Host and cannot be removed by any preset. On 0.2.1-rc.2 those were `ops_glob`, `ops_grep`, `ops_inspect_local_file`, `ops_replace` (from the `dsh-ops` plugin) and `working_directory`. A worker sees them whatever this package does; the curated set below is what the rows add on top.

### One workspace per worker

Concurrency is handled by separation rather than by coordination. Before delegating,
the root creates `_agents/<label>/` and puts that absolute path in the task; the child
writes **only** there, reads the parent's files freely, and sends a change request
instead of editing anything outside. On completion the child reports its artifacts and
the root decides which to copy in — merging into an existing file where that is what the
change means, keeping them separate where it is not. `_agents/` stays (and belongs in
`.gitignore`) so the same agent can be continued later.

**The boundary is enforced, not just agreed.** This preset's package also ships the fence
as a profile-level entry (`dsh-root-planner-preset/guard`), so one install carries the
protocol and its enforcement together. It refuses a `write`, `edit` or `ops_replace` whose
target resolves outside `<workspace>/_agents/`, and refuses a shell call whose `workdir` is
outside it or whose command names an absolute path into your files:

```
write: outside your workspace. You may write only inside "...\_agents"; everything else
in the parent's directory is read-only to you. Send your parent a change request instead
of writing "...\report.md" directly.
```

The root session is never fenced: it owns the workspace and has to be able to write
anywhere in it to integrate a child's artifacts.

**Being profile-level, it fences every delegated agent in this profile** — including
subagents under a different preset, which were never told about `_agents/`. If that matters
on your machine, turn the entry off in your profile patch:

```yaml
- id: root-planner-guard
  disabled: true
```

Declaring the guard as a row *inside* the preset would scope it to this preset only, and
that was tried first: measured against a live session it registered nothing — six probe
steps all came back allowed while the composed config looked correct. `verify-patch.mjs`
now fails if anyone declares it as a preset row again.

One limitation survives, and it is worth knowing before you rely on this: a shell command
can build a path at runtime (`$env:X` + `'..'`, a script that writes, a Here-String), and
no argument scan can see it. The command scan matches **drive-letter** paths, so on POSIX
it detects nothing at all — the two CI cases for it are skipped there rather than pretending
otherwise. Confining a child's shell properly would need a narrower
sandbox write root, which DSH cannot give a child — `sandboxPolicy.resolve()` accepts only
`{ session, mode }` and derives `workspaceRoot` from the immutable, inherited
`session.header.cwd`. So keep the parent's check as the backstop:

```sh
# before delegating
touch _agents/.mark-<label>
# after the child reports
find . -path ./_agents -prune -o -type f -newer _agents/.mark-<label> -print
```

No output means the child touched nothing outside its own directory; any output is a
file to inspect. The command needs no git repository — which matters, because the
workspace this was developed against is not one.

### Two limits you will meet on a broad task

Both are Host settings, both are structural, and both are documented because they read
like defects the first time:

- **`subagent limit reached (active child limit: N)`** — a delegated child is
  *resident*, not merely running: a slot returns only after its turn ends, its inbox
  is empty, and its own children are disposed. A wide fan-out therefore holds every
  slot until that work actually finishes, and the batch does not queue behind the
  cap. Raise `maxActiveSubagents` (**Settings → Subagents**) if the machine can
  carry more live agents, or dispatch a batch you can finish and collect it before
  opening the next. The author's own profile carries 16 for this reason.
- **`subagent depth N exceeds maxDepth M`** — a delegation from a leaf. That is the
  cap working, not a failure; the child reads the material itself.

## How it works

```
root agent  ──delegates──▶  subagent  ──delegates──▶  … until maxDepth
   │                            │
   └── decides, integrates, and states what each worker may touch
```

Two mechanisms decide what a worker gets and how far the tree goes, and they pull in the
same direction:

- **The worker preset** gives *every* subagent, at *every* level, the same working set —
  read, write, shell — and withholds the same things, because each level spawns into the
  same preset. The grant does not weaken with depth, and neither does the bound.
- **The depth cap** (`subagent.maxDepth`, a Host setting you control) decides how
  many levels exist. `2` means root →

plugins.description: Give your AI a project memory: /init makes it read the codebase and write .dsh docs, then every later turn gets them injected back automatically.
plugins.readme_text: **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) # dsh-knowledge — project knowledge system for DSH Let the AI read the project and write what it understood into `.dsh` documents, so every later development request starts with that knowledge already in context. **This plugin does not analyse code itself.** It does exactly two things: hand the prompt to the model, and inject the existing documents back into later turns. Reading the code, deciding feature boundaries and writing the documents is all done by the model with its own tools. ```text /init → the prompt goes in → the model explores the code → the model writes .dsh documents ↓ a development request → documents + update reminder injected → the model changes code → it decides for itself whether the documents went stale ``` ## Install Clone it (or point straight at the GitHub repo) and register it as a bundle in your DSH profile: ```bash cd "$DSH_PROFILE_DIR" pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile # links dsh-knowledge ``` `package.json` needs the dependency and the bundle: ```json { "dependencies": { "dsh-knowledge": "link:" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-knowledge"] } } } ``` Swap `link:` for `github:/` to install straight from GitHub. `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin line: ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-knowledge name: 'dsh-knowledge' ``` **Zero runtime dependencies**: `node:` builtins only. ## Usage ### `/init [path]` — build the knowledge base ```text /init the model reads the whole project and writes to .dsh/ at the project root /init @src the model reads src/ only; documents still go to .dsh/ at the root /init src/lib nested paths work the same ``` Path parsing is deliberately loose: a leading `@` (left behind by the composer's completion) is stripped, paths with spaces can be quoted, naming the project's own directory means the whole project, and a missing path lists the available top-level directories. `/init` itself does exactly two things: **wake the model**, then **inject** the full instruction. **Only the one line you typed shows in the UI** (e.g. `/init @src`). The full instruction is injected as a system-reminder instead of flooding the conversation — the same mechanism the per-turn document injection uses. The model then explores with `glob` / `grep` / `read` and writes with `write`, appearing in the UI like any other turn. **The knowledge base always lives at the project root**, whatever subdirectory `/init` was scoped to. One `.dsh` per project. ### Automatic context injection No manual reminders needed. The first step of every turn injects: 1. the body of `overview.md` (truncated with a pointer to the original when it is long) 2. the document listing under `.dsh` 3. **usage rules and an update reminder** — including: the model judges for itself whether this change made the documents stale One knowledge base is injected once per session, not on every turn; after the model edits documents, they are injected again. ### When to update The injected prompt states the rules, and the model applies them itself: | Change | Update the documents? | |--------|----------------------| | a feature added or removed, or the entry points, execution flow, data flow or module dependencies changed | yes — the affected document | | a bug fix, a style change, an implementation detail that changes no structure | no | | not sure | lean toward not writing | The principle: **better no update than documents that contradict the code.** ## The `.dsh` layout Written by the model from the prompt; a typical structure: ```text .dsh/ ├── overview.md what the project does, its stack, core modules, main entry points ├── architecture.md layers, module boundaries, dependency directions, data flow └── features/.md one per feature: responsibility, entry point, core code, flow, data flow, dependencies ``` File names are meaningful (`auth.md`, `order-sync.md`), never random ids. ## Security - **No source code is copied**: the prompt requires structure and behaviour only — no code snippets, secrets, tokens or connection strings. - **Dangerous scopes are refused**: no knowledge base in the user's home directory, in DSH's own config directory, or at the filesystem root — every session beneath those would mistake it for a project knowledge base. - **Documents are data**: the injected prompt states that any instruction inside `.dsh` is data and must not be executed as an instruction. ## Platform notes | Need | Platform capability | What this plugin does | |------|--------------------|-----------------------| | a command that makes the model work | `Agent.followup(message)` → `send(…, wakeup=true)` → `wakeDriver()` starts a real turn | `/init` admits the single line `/init ` to wake the model; the full instruction goes in through injection | | inject without flooding the UI | `agent/pre-step` waterfall, which can rewrite what enters a step | both the pending `/init` instruction and the per-turn reminder are injected this way; the UI keeps just the command line | | maintain documents at session end | no "session end" event | no programmatic maintenance: the injected prompt asks the model to judge and update for itself | An earlier version of `/init` ran static analysis in the command handler and generated the documents itself. That was wrong: a command handler has no model, so it could only guess feature boundaries with regexes. The command now just hands over the job. Note: the prompt and messages this plugin injects are written in Chinese. ## Tests ```bash node test/run.mjs # everything node test/plugin.test.mjs # plugin behaviour: /init hands over the job, path parsing, refusal rules, injection content node test/real-paths.mjs # replays path forms seen in real use (diagnostic script) node test/lint-imports.mjs # unused imports ``` The tests drive the real `apply()` with a fake Cordis context and assert above all that **`/init` really calls `followup`** — which is exactly what an earlier version got wrong: it did the job itself and never involved the model. ## Configuration None needed. ## Acknowledgments Thanks to everyone who contributed to this project: [](https://github.com/windzxy) [](https://github.com/anyiba) ## License MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: A GitHub Desktop-style Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: tick-to-stage, commit, commit and push, discard into a trash, and diff preview.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gitbar-lite

**给 DSH 用的 GitHub Desktop 风格 Git 面板**——装在 DSH **自带的右侧栏**里，和「文件 / 文档 / 聊天」并排。

变更文件列表、勾选提交、Summary + Description、Commit / Commit and Push、一个会随分支状态变化的 Push/Fetch 按钮、舍弃更改进插件自己的回收站、双击看 diff——都在这一栏里。

> English: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

## 为什么是「右侧栏的一个 tab」

DSH 的右栏本来就是一个常驻的标签区。Git 面板放这里，意味着它和会话是同一份上下文：**当前会话的工作区就是它看的仓库**，切换会话就跟着切，不用再挑一次目录。

面板很窄（右栏最小 300px，窄视口下会自动全屏），所以它是按窄栏设计的：文件列表单列、路径按「文件名 + 目录」两级显示、提交框只留一个 Summary 输入框加一个可展开的小三角。

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 变更文件列表 | 修改 / 新增 / 删除 / 重命名 / 未跟踪都能识别，每行带 `+n −n` 行数统计 |
| 勾选 | **勾选就是真的 `git add`**，取消就是 `git restore --staged`。终端里 `git status` 看到的就是同一件事 |
| 半暂存 | 一个文件索引和工作区都有改动时，勾选框显示成「半选」，点一下把它整体重述为勾上或没勾 |
| 全选 | 列表标题左边一个三态框：全选 / 取消全选，部分勾选时显示半选。**冲突文件不参与**，和自动勾选同一条规则 |
| Summary / Description | Summary 常驻一行；最右边一个小三角展开 Description |
| Commit | 只提交勾上的（因为勾选写进了索引） |
| Commit and Push | 提交后立刻推送；**推送失败不会说「提交失败」**——提交已经发生了，面板会明说「已提交 xxx，但推送失败」 |
| 上下文按钮 | 有本地未推送提交时是 **Push**，没有上游时是 **Publish**，否则是 **Fetch** |
| Push 前先 Fetch | 推送前会先 `git fetch --prune`，然后才推。**已经落后就拒绝推**并说明落后几个——git 的 push 从不合并，早晚都是被拒，先知道比推完再被拒有用。fetch 本身失败不阻断推送 |
| 自动 Fetch | 面板可见且仓库有远端时按 GitHub Desktop 的口径自己抓：默认 1 小时，每次到点重新判断，下一次从**上一次完成后**开始排，并加随机抖动防止多个面板同步。节奏是 `autoFetchMs`（`0` 关掉），并且用 `FETCH_HEAD` 的 mtime 判断"是不是刚抓过"——你在终端里抓也算 |
| 面板获得焦点 | **每次重新看向面板**都刷新一遍列表，并跑一遍脚本填 Summary：**打开面板**、切回这个标签、从对话点回面板、切回 DSH 窗口、浏览器标签回来，都算。手写的 Summary 不会被覆盖——只有空着的、或者还留着上次脚本填的那句话时才自动填 |
| 舍弃更改 | 单个文件或「全部舍弃」；动手前先把这次改动的 diff 归档，确认框里可以勾「彻底删除」 |
| 回收站 | 独立 tab。每次舍弃存一份 diff，并记下**是对哪个提交（`abc1234 初始提交`）取的 diff** |
| diff 预览 | 双击文件，或点回收站里的一条，在右栏开一个 diff 标签页——**永远只占一个**，再点就复用 |
| 仓库绑定 | 工作区本身是 Git 仓库就自动绑定并记住；不是就让你从工作区里扫出来的仓库里挑，或直接填路径 |

## 前置条件

| 需要什么 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` | 右侧栏 tab API 是这一版的行为 |
| Node `>= 22` | 宿主半边用到 `AbortSignal.any` 与 `node:test` |
| **本机有一个 `git`** | 默认从 `PATH` 找；找不到时面板会明确说「本机找不到 git」，不会静默失败。装在别处可以用 `gitPath` 指定 |
| 凭据 | Push 用的是**系统 git 的凭据**（credential helper）。先在终端里成功 push 过一次，插件就跟着能推 |

插件不会自己存任何凭据。宿主半边不读 `$DSH_HOME` 里的密钥，也不写。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-gitbar-lite
```

装完**重启 DSH**。然后在一个会话里打开右侧栏，引导页上会多一张 **「Git 更改」** 卡片，点它就进面板。

<details>
<summary>从本地克隆安装 / 卸载 / 装完打不开怎么办</summary>

**本地目录安装**（改代码时用这个）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/dsh-gitbar-lite
```

**卸载**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-gitbar-lite
```

**装完 DSH 起不来**：先跑 `node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs .`。DSH 把
`exports["./client"]` 当**精确文件路径**读，没有扩展名补全也没有目录回退；指向一个不存在的文件会直接
`MissingClientBundleError` **中止整个 Host 启动**，而不是「这个插件不显示」。这个脚本就是复刻那条判定，让你不必靠重启去试。

</details>

## 使用

```
右栏引导页
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│  ▸ Git 更改                      │  ← 引导卡片，点开面板
│    查看改动、勾选要提交的文件…    │
└──────────────────────────────────┘
        ↓ 点开
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│ dsh-gitbar-lite  main   ↑1 ↓0    │  ← 仓库名 / 分支 / 领先落后
│              [Push] [↻] [🗄] [⑂]  │  ← 上下文按钮、刷新、回收站、换绑
│ 更改   5 个文件 · 已勾选 2  [全部舍弃] │
│ ☑ M  a.txt                  +3 −1 ↩│  ← 双击 = 看 diff；↩ = 舍弃这个文件
│ ▣ M  src/big.ts            +12 −4 ↩│  ← ▣ = 半暂存
│ ☐ ?  new note.md             +7   ↩│
│ ☐ D  docs/old.md             −31  ↩│
│ ☐ R  moved.txt                    ↩│
│ ┌────────────────────────────┐ ˅ │  ← ˅ 展开 Description
│ │ Summary（必填）             │   │
│ └────────────────────────────┘   │
│ [   Commit   ] [ Commit and Push ]│
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **勾选**：点一下写进索引，再点一下撤出。半选状态点一下会整体勾上，再点整体撤出。
- **双击文件行** → 右栏开 diff 标签页；再双击别的文件，**复用同一个标签页**。
- **舍弃**（行尾 ↩ 或「全部舍弃」）→ 弹确认框：

  ```
  舍弃「a.txt」的更改？
   · a.txt
   ☐ 彻底删除（不存入回收站）
     这次的 diff 会存进插件的回收站，之后还能回看是改了什么。
  [ 取消 ]  [ 舍弃 ]
  ```

  **默认不勾「彻底删除」**：这次改动的 diff 会存进回收站。勾上就什么都不留。这个勾选框会记住你上一次的选择。
- **回收站**（🗄）：按时间列出记录，每条显示「多久之前 · 单个文件/全部更改 · 文件数 · +n −n · 基于 `abc1234 初始提交`」。
  点一条看 diff，点 ↺ 把它恢复回工作区（**恢复出来的文件回到列表时是勾上的**），行尾的 🗑 删掉它，
  右上「清空回收站」一次清掉（只清当前仓库，勾上「显示全部仓库」就清全部）。
- **换绑**（⑂）：解除当前绑定。工作区是仓库会重新自动绑定；不是的话回到选择界面。

### 舍弃到底做了什么

顺序是固定的，不能换：

1. 按当前改动生成 diff（已跟踪的文件走 `git diff HEAD`；**未跟踪的新文件由插件自己合成一份 new-file diff**，
   因为 `git diff HEAD` 看不见它们，而舍弃未跟踪文件就是删掉它——不先合成，回收站里就只剩一条「删了一个文件」的空记录）。
2. 存进回收站（除非勾了「彻底删除」）。
3. 已跟踪的 `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree`；未跟踪的直接删文件，并把因此变空的目录一起清掉。

> **冲突中的文件会被拒绝舍弃**，只给一句提示。在合并中途 `git restore` 到 HEAD 有扰动合并状态的风险，不值得为省一句话去冒。

### 用脚本填 Summary

**脚本就在面板里写**：展开 Description 的小三角，下面有一个「填 Summary 的脚本」按钮，点开是一个编辑框——写进去、保存、运行并填入，全在这里，不用去翻配置文件。**编辑框一开始是空的**，什么都不会预先填进去（占位提示里给了一个例子）；保存、运行、刷新都会给一条短暂提示，不用猜刚才那一下到底按到没有。**每次重新看向面板都会自动跑一次**（**打开面板**、切回这个标签、从对话点回面板、切回 DSH 窗口都算）——把侧边栏开着，去对话里让 agent 干活，回来，Summary 已经填好了；不过**你自己手写过的 Summary 不会被冲掉**，那时想更新就点星星按钮。配了脚本之后，Summary 框旁边还会多一个星星按钮，一点就填。

脚本以**仓库根目录为工作目录**运行，不喂任何 stdin。所以「取 CHANGELOG 最顶上的版本号」就是：

```sh
grep -m1 '^## ' CHANGELOG.md | sed 's/^## //'
```

输出即 Summary。要同时填 Description，就在输出里单独放一行 `---`，**该行之后**的全部内容是 Description：

```sh
echo "1.4.2"
echo "---"
echo "Bumped the patch version."
```

关于 shell：Windows 上优先用 Git 自带的 `sh`（`grep`/`sed`/`awk` 都可用），并把它的 `usr/bin` 补回 `PATH`——否则那些工具会「command not found」。机器上没有 `sh` 才退回 `cmd.exe`，那时脚本要按 cmd 语法写。非 Windows 就是 `sh`。

脚本失败不弹错误横幅，退出码会以一条短暂提示显示；它的 stderr 原样保留，方便你自己判断。


> 脚本是**按仓库**存的（键是仓库路径，文件在 <DSH_HOME>/dsh-gitbar-lite/scripts.json）：A 项目配的脚本不会跑到 B 项目里。一个从没配过脚本的仓库，编辑框是**空的**——不预先填任何脚本，占位提示只给个例子；清空保存之后它也真的空着。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `gitPath` | `""` | 指定 git 可执行文件；空 = 从 `PATH` 找 |
| `stateDir` | `""` | 插件状态目录；空 = `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-gitbar-lite` |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单条 git 命令超时。推到慢远端可以调大 |
| `maxDiffBytes` | `524288` | 一份归档 diff 的上限；超出按**行**截断并记下丢了多少行 |
| `maxFileBytes` | `2097152` | 比这大的未跟踪文件只列出来，不读内容、不归档、不出 diff |
| `trashLimit` | `200` | 回收站保留多少条；超出丢弃最旧的连同它的 diff 文件 |
| `scanDepth` | `3` | 「不是仓库时」扫描工作区找仓库的目录深度 |
| `autoFetchMs` | `300000` | 面板自己多久 fetch 一次；`0` = 关掉，只用手动按钮 |
| `summaryScript` | `""` | 填 Summary 的脚本。以仓库根为工作目录运行，输出即 Summary；单独一行 `---` 之后算 Description |

每个字段都是 volatile 的，所以在设置页改了立刻生效、不用重启。

**状态存在哪**：`<DSH_HOME>/dsh-gitbar-lite/`（没有 `DSH_HOME` 就回落 `~/.dsh`）——
`bindings.json`（工作区 → 仓库）、`prefs.json`（那两个勾选偏好）、`trash/index.json` + `trash/<id>.diff`。
**回收站只存那一个 diff，不额外留一份文件副本**：恢复时用 `git apply` 把它重放回去，
那既是面板显示的记录，也是回放所需的全部内容；重放完再把这些路径 `git add` 进索引，
所以恢复出来的文件回到列表时是勾上的。都是先写临时文件再 rename，所以写到一半崩了也不会把文件截断。

## 工作原理

```
lib/shared.js          线协议字面量（浏览器半边手抄一份，自检脚本负责比对）
lib/index.js           插件入口：Config、apply、把路由挂到 connection.fetch
lib/host/git.js        git 执行层：走 ctx.subprocess，解析可执行文件、限流输出、清洗环境
lib/host/parse.js      porcelain v2 / numstat 解析（纯函数）
lib/host/diff.js       diff 合成、按行截断、按文件切分（纯函数）
lib/host/repo.js       仓库操作：status / stage / commit / push / fetch / fileDiff / discard
lib/host/store.js      绑定、偏好、回收站（原子写 + 按文件串行化）
lib/host/workspace.js  会话 → 工作区目录
lib/host/routes.js     单条 /api 路由 + action 分发 + 错误码映射
lib/client.js          浏览器半边：三个 tab 类型 + 面板/回收站/diff，手写、无构建
```

几个值得写下来的决定：

- **一条 `/api` 路由 + `action` 字段**，不是一条路由一个操作。`connection.fetch` 按精确 pathname 匹配，
  而每次调用本来就要带 `sessionId`；分开写只会把十五个路径字面量摊到两种语言里。
- **必须挂在 `connection.fetch` 上，绝不挂 `webServer` 的 exact 路由**：web server 会先匹配 exact 路由，
  而同路径的 exact 路由会遮蔽 `/api` 前缀路由——Host/Origin fence、浏览器 cookie 校验、operator 身份**全在那条前缀路由上**。
  用 exact 就等于开了一个不需要鉴权的 git 接口。测试与自检脚本都专门盯这一条，并且**反过来验证这条断言是有牙齿的**。
- **diff tab 用 `dsh-resource://` 固定地址**，不是 page kind。重新打开同一个资源地址会让宿主**聚焦已开的那个 tab**，
  并把新的 `params` 导航进去；page kind 只在当前 dock pane 内复用，被浮动出去就会多开一个。固定地址本身就是「永远只占一个」。
- **不发 `-m`，用 `-F -` 把提交信息从 stdin 送进去**：Summary 里有引号、有换行、以 `-` 开头，都只是文本，不是参数。
- **`:(literal)` pathspec**：否则舍弃一个叫 `docs` 的文件会顺带动 `docs/` 里的所有东西，`a[1].txt` 会被当成通配。
- **不 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`**：浏览器半边只 `require('react')`。
  一个会抛错的 import 会把整个 slot entry 变成空白，而官方插件开发清单也要求客户端半边不导入 Harness Client 包。
  需要的那几个控件手写，颜色全部走 `--dsw-alias-*` token；图标是**逐 path 抄宿主 `IconBranchOutlineRegular`
  等 artwork**，所以它和旁边的宿主图标是一套东西。

更多细节（线协议全表、状态文件格式、为什么这么排序、哪些没验证）在 [`docs/CONTRACT.md`](./docs/CONTRACT.md)。

## 验证

```sh
npm test          # 单测 + 真 git 的 e2e + 产物自检
npm run test:e2e  # 只跑真 git 的 e2e（23 个小节，各自造自己的夹具，294 项断言）
npm run check     # 只用产物自检（不启 DSH 也能发现会让 DSH 起不来的问题）
npm run test:live # 探测一个正在运行的 DSH（不在 npm test 里，需要跑着应用）
```

| 套件 | 覆盖什么 |
|---|---|
| `test/parse.test.mjs` | porcelain v2 与 numstat 解析，含重命名、暂存删除、冲突、非 ASCII 路径、带空格的路径 |
| `test/diff.test

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Qwen-Image 出图与参考图编辑，本地自带受管运行时，不装 ComfyUI 也能跑；也支持 ComfyUI / 官方 API。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-image-forge

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

DeepSeek Harness 插件：**Qwen-Image 出图 / 参考图编辑**，并把官方提示词契约的 `wh_ratio` 做成工具的**一等参数**——比例换算像素由插件做，不需要人工翻译。

- 工具：`qwen_image_generate`、`qwen_image_edit`、`qwen_image_status`、`qwen_image_env`；技能：`qwen-image-forge`（意图路由 + 自撰的 T2I / Edit 改写规则）
- 后端三选一：`local`（随包 `resources/worker.py`，自管 venv + CUDA torch + 10.63 GiB nf4 权重与生命周期，**不需要先装 ComfyUI**）、`comfyui`（只经 HTTP 复用你本机已装的实例）、`api`（自带 key 的云端点）；默认 `auto`

## 安装

**从 npm：**

```bash
npm install dsh-image-forge
# 或 dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Demerier/dsh-image-forge
```

**从本仓库源码：**

**在本仓库目录内构建出 `lib/`，再装进某个 DSH profile。**

```powershell
# 在本仓库目录内构建出 lib/
pnpm install
pnpm build

# 装进某个 DSH profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本目录绝对路径>
```

`cordis.yml` 通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动生效，插件注册名 `dsh-image-forge` 与包名一致。⚠️ 若 `pnpm build` 报 `Cannot find package 'ansis'`，本仓库用 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 固定 `nodeLinker: hoisted` 绕开——删掉 `node_modules` 重装即可。

## 配置

**全部字段都有默认值，下面这 8 个是你几乎只需要关心的。**

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `auto` | `auto` / `api` / `comfyui` / `local` 四选一 |
| `apiKey` | 空 | **建议留空**改用环境变量，key 就不会进 profile 文件 |
| `outputDir` | `~/Pictures/dsh-image-forge` | 图片落盘目录 |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | 单次生成预算（ComfyUI 首次冷加载模型很慢，可调到 `900000`） |
| `comfyEndpoint` | 空 | 如 `http://127.0.0.1:8188`；**空 = 自动探测 `comfyPorts`**，非回环地址会被拒绝 |
| `runtimeDir` | `~/.dsh-image-forge` | 插件自己拥有的运行时目录：venv、worker 日志、`worker-state.json` |
| `minFreeVramMiB` | `5500` | **启动前门禁**阈值：空闲显存低于它就拒绝拉起本地 worker（`0` = 关掉这道门禁） |
| `localReferenceBudget` | `0` | 只对 `local` 编辑生效的参考图条件化预算；**`0` = 按画布推导** |

完整 **32** 个字段（含默认值、边界、实测依据）见 [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md)；步数解析优先级 **调用方显式 > 后端专属 `comfyuiSteps`/`localSteps` > `defaultSteps`**，结果里回显 `steps_used` / `steps_source`。
**设置页只展示日常字段 + 本地「一键部署」**（建 venv / 装 torch / 下 10.63 GiB 权重）；解释器路径、镜像、端口等自定义环境项**不外露**，默认值即可，要改写 profile。
Key 读取顺序：`apiKey` → `QWEN_IMAGE_API_KEY` → `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` → `OPENAI_API_KEY`；key 只在内存里，**不写盘、不进日志**（报错里会被 `<redacted-key>` 顶掉）。

## 用法

**用户说「画一只猫」时，模型先按技能规则把需求改写成契约，再调用工具。**

```json
{"rewritten_prompt": "A wide photograph of …", "wh_ratio": "16:9"}
```

→ `qwen_image_generate(prompt = <rewritten_prompt>, wh_ratio = "16:9")`

`wh_ratio` 7 档（官方）与插件换算出的像素（**~1.5MP 预算**、32 对齐）：

| `wh_ratio` | 像素 | 像素数 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `1:1` | 1248×1248 | 1.558 MP | 精确 |
| `4:3` | 1408×1056 | 1.487 MP | 精确 |
| `3:4` | 1056×1408 | 1.487 MP | 精确 |
| `3:2` | 1536×1024 | 1.573 MP | 精确 |
| `2:3` | 1024×1536 | 1.573 MP | 精确 |
| `16:9` | 1664×928 | 1.544 MP | 32 网格上无法精确，偏差 +0.86% |
| `9:16` | 928×1664 | 1.544 MP | 偏差 −0.86% |

落盘命名：`<outputDir>/<prefix>_<W>x<H>_<n>.png`，`prefix` 默认 `qwen`（可用 `preset` 覆盖），编号从 1 起且**跳过已占用的名字**，重复调用不会覆盖旧图。
图片回传：结果里给 `![](绝对路径)` 的 Markdown（客户端会渲染成真图），另有一份 JSON 供机器读。要显式像素就用 `width`/`height`（必须 32 的倍数），**显式值永远优先**。（细目见 docs/usage-reference.md）

## 参考图编辑（图生图）

**用户给了参考图（一张或多张）就是改图任务，走 `qwen_image_edit`；画布比例三选一，`wh_ratio` 与 `ratio_follow` 互斥。**

```text
qwen_image_edit(prompt = <成品改图指令>, images = ["D:\\pictures\\room.png"], ratio_follow = "image1")
```

| 情况 | 传什么 | 画布 |
|---|---|---|
| 用户明说了比例 / 像素 | `wh_ratio`（或 `width`+`height`） | 该比例，~1.5MP 预算、32 对齐 |
| 用户没说，要跟随某张参考图 | `ratio_follow: "image1"`（也可直接写该图在 `images` 里的那个字符串） | 量出该图的实际长宽比 → 32 网格上最接近的一对像素 |
| 用户什么都没说 | 两个都不传 | **默认跟随第一张参考图**（第 1 张就是编辑目标） |

- 路径必须**绝对**（相对路径会被拒绝）；只认 **PNG / JPEG / WebP**（要读文件头拿像素尺寸），也收 `data:image/…;base64,…`；任何一张读不出来都会报错并点名 `images[n]`。
- 后端只有 `comfyui` 与 `local`（都在本机）：`backend: "auto"` 在编辑场景**跳过云 API**（它没有编辑通道，`api_skipped` 如实说明），显式传 `backend: "api"` 会明确报错。
- `wh_ratio` 与 `ratio_follow` **同时给会直接报错**（官方 Edit 契约要求一个非空另一个为空），而不是悄悄选一个；`preset` 默认是 `edit`。

## 提示词模板（按路由）

**先问自己三句：有没有参考图（→ T2I 还是 Edit）？画幅比谁说了算？是下订单、还是只想问怎么写？再照抄下面对应的三段式；完整规则见 [references/t2i_rules.md](references/t2i_rules.md) 与 [references/edit_rules.md](references/edit_rules.md)。**

**① T2I·分区型**（海报 / 页面 / 多物宽景）
- **你这么说**：「给我画一张夏日饮料海报」
- **改写成**：英文**一整段**散文，先背景与承托面 → 顶部带 → 主体横走一遍 → 底部带；比例只进字段，**绝不写进正文**
- **调用**：`qwen_image_generate(prompt = <成品散文>, wh_ratio = "16:9")`

**② T2I·单主体型**（肖像 / 特写 / 单品）
- **你这么说**：「画我的猫的大头照」
- **改写成**：英文一整段散文，先背景与景深 → 姿态 → 头脸 → 身体与衣料 → 手里拿的/贴着它的东西 → 边缘小物
- **调用**：`qwen_image_generate(prompt = <成品散文>, wh_ratio = "1:1")`

**③ Edit·N=1**（只给了一张参考图）
- **你这么说**：「把这张客厅照片改成晚上的」
- **改写成**：只动被点名的那几个属性、其余按输入锁住；**N=1 不加标签**；没说画布就默认跟随第 1 张；`wh_ratio` 与 `ratio_follow` **恰好一个为空**（同时给会被工具拒绝）
- **调用**：`qwen_image_edit(prompt = <成品指令>, images = ["D:\\…\\room.png"], ratio_follow = "image1")`

**④ Edit·N≥2**（两张及以上参考图）
- **你这么说**：「把这张人像里的我放进那张客厅照片里，光线跟着客厅」
- **改写成**：**必须**用 `<image1>`/`<image2>` 逐张说明用途，并**认准哪张是画布图**（合成/放入取目标场景图），不要写「第一张图」
- **调用**：`qwen_image_edit(prompt = <成品指令>, images = ["D:\\…\\person.png", "D:\\…\\living-room.png"], ratio_follow = "image2")`

**咨询**（「这种需求提示词怎么写」）：只给契约结果、**不调用**任何生成工具，等用户点头再出图。

**按后端的建议提法**（每行一句，理由见上文「后端怎么选」）：

| 后端 | 什么时候这么提 |
|---|---|
| `auto`（默认） | 不用提：有 key 走云 API，否则先探本机 ComfyUI、最后落 `local` |
| `api` | 要云上出图就这么提；**它没有编辑通道**，给了参考图会被跳过——编辑必须提本机后端 |
| `comfyui` | **8 GB 卡上编辑就这么提**（`backend: "comfyui"`）：绕开本地编辑尺寸门，且快得多 |
| `local` | 脱离 ComfyUI 依赖时提；编辑要显式给可靠档尺寸（如 `1216×672`）**或**把 `localReferenceBudget` 设 `512`，否则默认画布会被尺寸门默认拒绝 |

## 工具一览

**两个干活的、两个看环境的。**

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `qwen_image_generate` | 出图主入口：`prompt` + `wh_ratio` 一等参数，另有 `width`/`height`、`steps`、`seed`、`count`、`backend`、`preset` |
| `qwen_image_edit` | 参考图编辑（图生图）：`images` 1–10 张绝对路径，`ratio_follow` 与 `wh_ratio` 二选一，只走本机后端 |
| `qwen_image_status` | 只读健康探测：云端点是否可达、key 是否被接受、本机 ComfyUI 在不在跑、worker 六态；不回显 key |
| `qwen_image_env` | 本机环境体检 + 本地运行时管理：`status` / `install` / `fetch-weights` / `unload` / `repair`，都支持 `dryRun:true` |

## 后端怎么选

**`auto` 的次序：有 key 走云 API，否则先试本机 ComfyUI，最后才落到本地 worker。**

- **8 GB 卡上出图与编辑都优先 `comfyui`**：同画布 992×992 的步数扫描里 `comfyui` 0.727 s/步、`local` 2.014 s/步，每步 **2.77×**（两侧量化档不同，别读成纯后端差异）；编辑差得更远——它的联合序列 ≈ 7576 token 把 reserved 顶到 **8666 MiB**、**越过 8188 MiB 物理上限**，驱动走 WDDM 分页，于是每步 20–40 s。
- **本地编辑尺寸门（只在 `local` 后端生效）**：按画布算出的参考图条件化预算 `_reference_budget` **≤ 896** 放行（1216×672 峰值 reserved 7458 MiB）、**897–960** 放行但结果里带警告、**> 960 默认拒绝**；拒绝时给四条出路——① 改用 `comfyui`；② 显式给更小的 `width`/`height`（可靠档 ≤896，例如 1216×672）；③ 把 `localReferenceBudget` 调到 **512**（1.5MP 画布上唯一实测跑得完的档：wall **109.5 s**、峰值 reserved 6488 MiB、worker 存活）；④ 配 `allowLocalEditOverBudget: true` 显式放行。
- 完整论证、逐档实测与 ComfyUI 探测细节见 [docs/backends.md](docs/backends.md)。

## 排障

**先 `qwen_image_status`，再 `qwen_image_env status`。**

## 已知边界

**这几条最容易咬人，装之前先看一眼。**

- 云 API 后端**没有编辑通道**：`qwen_image_edit` 只走本机（`comfyui` / `local`）；显式指定 `backend: "api"` 会明确报错，而**不会把参考图丢掉**。
- 参考图的像素尺寸只认 **PNG / JPEG / WebP** 的文件头；其它容器（含 TIFF、AVIF）会被拒绝并给出原因。
- 没有局部重绘（inpaint / mask）、放大、相册 UI。
- 真实设备上只验证过 **cu126** 这一档（`torch 2.9.1+cu126`）；cu128 / cu118 是同一段矩阵代码里的备选路径，**未在真机下载验证过**。**建议保持默认环境**（`torchWheels` 留空 / 设置页一键部署），逐档降级矩阵不做真机验证，也不在计划内。
- ⚠️ **8 GiB 卡上本地编辑有实测的硬墙**：1312×736 画布上 ComfyUI 8 步 ≈ 19–23 s，受管 worker 同样尺寸 6 步要 **219 s**（reserved 8666 MiB > 8188 MiB → WDDM 分页）。
- **判断「某个 pid 还活着」在本机不可靠**：`repair` **只停止本会话自己拉起的那个进程**，历史记录里的 pid 只报告并给出 `taskkill` 命令。
- 客户端 4 个工具都有 `tool.call.toolview` 卡片（出图/改图带图网格，status/env 带摘要），设置页有完整布局样式（含窄栏容器查询）。**设置页与 status 卡片已在真实 web 客户端验过**；出图/改图卡片的图网格因本机无后端未在真机出图。图片显示的**主路径**始终是工具结果里的 Markdown 绝对路径。

## 测试

**10 个文件 / 153 个用例，全部不需要 GPU、venv 或 10.6 GiB 权重。**

```powershell
pnpm build
pnpm test
```

`ratio 12 / local-edit-budget 16 / surface 9 / api-e2e 8 / comfyui-e2e 9 / worker-lifecycle 21 / edit-e2e 9 / vram-gate 14 / settings 52 / package-contents 3`；真机端到端（`test/live-worker-e2e.mjs` / `test/live-edit-e2e.mjs`）不在 `pnpm test` 里，详见 [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md)。

## 许可

**本插件自身以 MIT 发布；权重与官方提示词原文都不随包分发。**

- **Qwen-Image-2.1 权重**受 **Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE AGREEMENT** 约束（**限研究用途；商用需自行向权利方取得授权**）：本插件**不随包分发**，`qwen_image_env action:"fetch-weights"` 只**按你的指令**从 `hf-mirror.com` 拉取 `circulus/Qwen-Image-2.1-bnb-4bit`（10.63 GiB）到你的 `modelsDir`。
- **ComfyUI** 是**可选的外部依赖**（GPL-3.0）：本插件不包含、不修改、不分发其代码，只通过 HTTP 与你自己安装的实例通信。
- **官方提示词原文**（`system_prompt_t2i.txt` / `guide_t2i.md` / `guide_edit.md` 等）**不随包分发**；`skill.md` 与 `references/*.md` 是本插件**自撰**的规

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: search files by name or content, customizable shortcuts, and in-app text editing
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-finder

A DeepSeek Harness plugin for finding workspace files without leaving DSH: search by file name or by file content, then open the result in DSH's own right-sidebar preview — or in the built-in editor when you need to change something.

[中文文档](README.zh.md)

## What it does

- **Search by file name**, including a path fragment such as `src/view`.
- **Search by content**, with one result row per matching line.
- **Open natively**: Enter opens the file in DSH's right-sidebar document preview, the same surface the Files tab uses, and jumps to the matching line for content hits.
- **Edit in place** when you need to: ⌘/Ctrl+Enter opens the built-in editor, which saves through DSH's workspace filesystem and refuses to overwrite a file that changed after it was loaded.
- **Native shortcuts**: Cmd/Ctrl+P and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F, like VS Code, without claiming a default binding in DSH's shortcut registry.
- **Optional DS Bot bridge**: when the DS Bot plugin is installed, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B flips between Bot mode and classic Agent mode; without it neither the shortcut nor its settings card exists.
- **Preview, not just text**: images, video, audio, PDFs, HTML pages and Markdown open in the built-in viewer; HTML runs in a sandbox, Markdown is rendered with DSH's own renderer, and relative images inside a Markdown file resolve to the workspace.
- **A redesigned settings page** with cards, keycaps, steppers, and switches, plus an "Opening" preference that chooses whether Enter previews or edits.
- **Polished interaction**: a frosted command palette, spring-eased mode switch, selected-row rail, loading skeletons, and reduced-motion support.

## File system: it already uses DSH's

There is no second filesystem hidden in this plugin:

| Operation | Owner |
| --- | --- |
| Walking, reading, writing workspace files | DSH's `ctx.fs` seam (`index.js`) |
| Search and ranking | This plugin (DSH exposes no reusable search service) |
| Opening and viewing a file | DSH's right-sidebar document preview, via `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource()` and a `dsh-resource://file/session/<sessionId>/<path>` address |
| Editing and conflict checks | This plugin's editor, over the same `ctx.fs` seam |

When the native preview is unavailable (no live Session, or a shell without the right sidebar), the finder falls back to its own editor and says so. The **Settings → File Finder** page lets you make the editor the default action instead.

## Shortcuts

| Action | Default keys |
| --- | --- |
| Search by file name | Cmd/Ctrl+P |
| Search by content | Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F |
| Toggle DS Bot / classic Agent mode (only with the DS Bot plugin installed) | Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B |

The commands are registered with DSH's shortcut service so you can assign your own keys in **Settings → Edit shortcuts**, but they declare **no default binding**. DSH's registry throws when one command's default overlaps another's, and it throws from inside the *other* plugin's `apply()`, so claiming Cmd+Shift+F here took the whole Web UI boot down (`Conflicting shortcut defaults: session.fork and files.searchContent`). The VS Code keys above are served by this plugin's own keydown handler instead.

Note that Cmd+Shift+F is DSH's own "fork session" binding; this plugin uses it for content search, so rebind `session.fork` in **Settings → Edit shortcuts** if you relied on it.

In the browser Web shell (not the desktop app), Cmd+Shift+B is DSH's right-sidebar toggle. With DS Bot installed this plugin takes that key for the mode switch, so assign a different key to `files.toggleBotMode` in **Settings → Edit shortcuts** if you need the sidebar binding there. On the desktop app the combination is free.

## DS Bot mode switch (optional)

When the DS Bot plugin (`ds-bot`) is part of the running boot, this plugin also offers **Toggle Bot / classic Agent mode** on Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B, plus a matching card in **Settings → File Finder**.

DS Bot keeps its surface switch private — it exposes no client service — so the bridge does the two things another plugin safely can: it detects `ds-bot` in the boot graph, and it drives the controls DS Bot renders itself (the account menu's surface-switch entry to leave Bot mode, and the DS Bot return pill to come back). Nothing is patched or forked, and DS Bot's own `ds-bot:surface` preference stays authoritative.

Without DS Bot nothing is registered or shown: the command never reaches **Settings → Edit shortcuts**, the settings card stays hidden, and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B is left to whatever else owns it.

## Settings

**Settings → File Finder** covers:

- Shortcut reference with one-click try buttons
- Case sensitivity
- Extra ignored directory names (with live chips)
- Name and content result limits (steppers)
- The default Enter action: **Sidebar preview** or **Built-in editor**
- Reset to defaults; changes save automatically

## Editing

Choose a result and press Cmd/Ctrl+Enter (or set the built-in editor as the default action). Save writes the full text back through the workspace filesystem and refuses to overwrite a file that changed after it was loaded. Reload, then save again, to take the newer version. The editor is for UTF-8 text under about 1 MB. Binary files and common build or dependency directories are skipped.

Files that are not text open in the built-in viewer instead: images, video and audio render inline (byte ranges, so video seeking works), PDFs open in the platform frame, HTML pages run in a sandboxed iframe whose scripts cannot reach DSH, and Markdown is rendered with DSH's Markdown renderer, with an **Edit source** button that hands the file to the text editor.

The editor shows a line-number gutter and highlights the caret's line. **Cmd/Ctrl+F** opens in-file search: every match is highlighted, the current one more strongly, with a match count, previous/next buttons, and a **Aa** case-sensitivity toggle. Enter and Shift+Enter step through matches, Escape closes the search and returns focus to the text.

## Install

The plugin is published to npm as **`dsh-file-finder`**, so **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin** resolves the package name directly:

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-file-finder
```

Or install from this checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin add /Library/aiProject/dsh-file-finder
```

Restart or refresh the DSH page if the new client module does not appear immediately.

The same operations are available to the agent as the `file_finder` tool.

## Development

```sh
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
npm test
```

`npm test` covers the search helpers, the shortcut-default regression guard, and the UI contract (native preview address, palette hooks, reduced-motion rules, the DS Bot bridge, and the editor's line gutter plus in-file find).

The editor has its own browser check for the gutter and in-file find, and the viewer has one for every preview kind:

```sh
npm run check:find
npm run check:viewer
```

The DS Bot bridge also has a browser check that runs the real key handler against DS Bot's real selectors, with and without `ds-bot` in the boot graph:

```sh
node preview/bot-check.mjs
```

The native-integration research — address grammar, session derivation, service access, HMR behavior, and the keep-vs-delegate matrix — is documented in [docs/native-integration.md](docs/native-integration.md).

`preview/` is a dev-only harness that renders the palette and settings page outside DSH with the real DSH theme tokens, and captures light/dark screenshots with Playwright:

```sh
node preview/screenshot.mjs
```

It is not part of the published package.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Read-only attachment library for DeepSeek Harness: every stored image and file, its size, and which conversations still use it.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-attachment-library · Attachment library

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds **Settings → Attachment library**: every image and file attachment stored on this machine, the space it takes, and which conversations still use it (active, archived, moving to the trash, or in the trash).

**Read-only.** Nothing is deleted: the plugin never creates, changes, moves, or deletes an attachment, a session log, a trash file, or a cache entry; "Show in Finder" only selects a file and never opens or runs it. The plugin's only write is the read-only copy "Open in Preview" places in the system temporary directory (outside DSH data), removed when the plugin stops. Its purpose is to check the reference counts before any cleanup is considered.

- DSH 0.2.x (`engines.dsh: >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`, including the 0.2.1 alpha previews)
- Trash statistics work with [`dsh-plugin-session-trash`](https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash); without it only existing conversations are counted

## Install

**Desktop**: open **Plugins** in the sidebar → **Add plugin**, enter one of the following, click **Install**, then **Enable now** (new plugins start disabled):

- GitHub: `https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library`, or a version such as `github:ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library#v0.4.1`
- npm: `dsh-plugin-attachment-library`
- An absolute path to a local package, for example `/path/to/dsh-plugin-attachment-library-0.4.1.tgz` (made with `pnpm pack`)

Do not enter the source directory: its `node_modules` holds development copies of DSH packages that conflict with DSH's own.

**Command line** (optional): quit DSH, then run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-attachment-library`.

**Uninstall**: uninstall "Attachment library" on the **Plugins** page. The plugin stores no data; attachments are not affected.

## What the page shows

- **Totals**: all attachments (count and size); images and files; used by existing conversations, used only by conversations in the trash, and not used by any conversation (count and size each); attachments referenced but missing from the store; the size of the regenerable resize cache.
- **List**: a type icon (an image icon for images, an icon by extension for files), type, file names (every name stored for the same content), size, image dimensions and format, store time, and each referencing conversation with its title and status. An attachment shared by several conversations lists all of them.
- **Open in Preview** (macOS only): an arrow icon button on stored image rows (tooltip "Open in Preview") opens the image in Preview on the Host. Preview gets a read-only copy with the right extension, not DSH's own file (see below). File rows have no such button.
- **Show in Finder**: a folder icon button at the right of each stored row (tooltip "Show in Finder") selects the file in the Host's Finder (Windows Explorer, or the default Linux file manager): a file attachment shows under its real file name, an image as its content-named object file. It appears only when the page talks to the local DSH, the Host has a desktop file manager, and DSH allows desktop handoff; a failure is shown under the row.
- **Rescan**: the refresh icon button at the top right (tooltip "Rescan"); it is disabled while a scan runs, and "Rescanning…" is shown.
- **Filters**: type (all / images / files) and references (all / existing / trash only / unused); **sort** by time or by size (newest or largest first). The list shows 100 rows at a time.
- **Incomplete logs**: session logs that could not be read in full (damaged, cut short) are listed with a note that the "unused" counts may be too high.

## Why Finder shows no preview for images

DSH stores each image under its SHA-256 digest (for example `attachments/v1/objects/3f/3f9a…`) with **no file extension**, read-only (0400). The content is an ordinary normalized JPEG, WebP, PNG, or GIF, not encrypted; macOS decides the file type from the extension, so Finder shows no thumbnail and a double-click does not open it as an image. File attachments differ: each also has a read-only hard link under its real file name, which Finder shows normally.

## Counting rules

| Rule | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Identity | DSH stores attachments once per content digest (SHA-256); images and files are stored separately, so the same bytes stored as an image and as a file are two rows |
| References | Every `{ type: 'image' \| 'file', attachment: { attachmentId } }` in a session log counts: user prompts, tool results, and system messages |
| Conversations | A subagent session's references count for the conversation that started it; a fork is its own conversation (it inherits its parent's prefix, so both are listed) |
| Existing conversations | Every session the session backend lists, read through the official read-only handle; status active, archived, or moving to the trash |
| Trash | Logs inside the trash directory are read directly (raw JSONL or Zstandard frames); the title is the one recorded when the conversation was moved |
| In use / trash only / unused | Any conversation outside the trash (including one waiting to move) makes it "in use"; only trashed conversations make it "trash only"; none makes it "unused" |
| Size | Each image object and file object counts once; file names are hard links and take no extra space; missing attachments add no size |
| Store time | The modification time of the stored object (when this content was first stored) |

## Cache

The first scan reads every session log and can be slow with many logs. After that:

- existing sessions are read again only when the session backend's revision changed;
- trashed sessions are read again only when the log file's device, inode, size, or modification time changed;
- image dimensions are cached by the same file facts.

The cache lives in the DSH process memory only and is never written to disk; the first scan after a DSH restart reads every log again.

## Configuration

Every DSH directory is only read.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `attachmentDirectory` | `<DSH home>/attachments/v1` | Attachment store; set it when `dsh-attachment-local` has its own `dshHome` |
| `trashDirectory` | `<DSH home>/session-trash` | Session trash; keep it equal to `dsh-plugin-session-trash`'s `trashDirectory` |
| `requestCacheDirectory` | `<DSH home>/cache/attachments/request-images` | Regenerable per-model resize cache; only its size is measured |
| `previewDirectory` | system temporary directory | Where the private temporary directory for "Open in Preview" copies is created; the only place the plugin writes |

## How "Show in Finder" works

- It uses DSH's own capability: the Host calls `revealNativePath` from the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` (`open -R` on macOS, Explorer `/select` on Windows, the containing directory on Linux), the same function behind DSH's built-in reveal actions. Availability uses the same checks (`nativeFileManager()`, `canOpenNativePath()`); the browser also requires `ctx.remote.$host.isLoopback` and follows DSH's `session.canOpenWorkspacePath()` switch.
- The official `session.openWorkspacePath` is not reused directly: it takes an absolute path from the browser and only accepts paths mapped into the workspace filesystem, which the attachment store is not.
- The browser sends only the attachment kind and id (`sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits); the authenticated `/api` gateway validates them strictly and rejects any extra field, a path included.
- The Host derives the path from the id: a file is `attachments/v1/files/<prefix>/<digest>/<name>` (the first name in sorted order, or the `file-objects` object when none exists), an image `attachments/v1/objects/<prefix>/<sha256>`. The target must be a plain file inside the attachment store with no symbolic link on the way; anything else is "not found".

## How "Open in Preview" works

- The browser sends only the image id (`sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits); the gateway validates it strictly and rejects any extra field, a path included. The Host finds `attachments/v1/objects/<prefix>/<sha256>` and requires a plain file i

plugins.description: Adds sessions without a workspace to DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session

为 DeepSeek Harness 增加**未分组（无工作区）会话**：点一下就开一个不占用任何项目工作区的会话，输入区仍是 DSH 原生那一个——模型选择、权限、附件、斜杠命令全部照旧。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/yusunz/dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session)

## 为什么需要它

DSH 的输入区要求会话属于某个工作区；未分组会话在原生判定里是"空白会话"，输入区会被禁用。本插件在创建会话后，**临时**把它挂到与它自己工作目录同名的工作区上，让原生输入区可用；你发出第一条消息后，这个临时工作区被删除，会话落回**未分组**并照常保留、可恢复。

## 两个入口

| 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| hero 行右侧 | 一枚「不在工作区中工作」按钮，与原生工作区选择框同一行；原生选择框保持原生，未被替换 |
| 右侧栏「开始」页 | 一张「非工作区会话」卡片，与「工作区文件 / 新建终端 / 浏览器」并列 |

两处动作一致：新建会话 → 临时挂载 → 原生输入区可用 → 首条消息后回到未分组。

## 工作目录

每次新建会话都会在工作目录下创建 `<YYYY-MM-DD>\<HH-MM-SS>` 子目录并作为该会话的 cwd，因此每个未分组任务互不干扰。

默认位置：`~/Documents/dsh`（可在设置里改）。

- **不留残留**：点了按钮却没发消息就切走，临时分组立刻消失；磁盘上那个空目录会在**下次启动 DSH 时**被回收。目录里只要有文件（代理写过东西）就永远不会被删。
- 会话本身从不被删除。

## 设置

**设置 → 通用设置 → 无项目任务文件夹**：显示当前路径，支持「更改」（宿主原生目录选择框）与「重置」（回落默认 `~/Documents/dsh`）。修改写入当前 profile 的配置并立即生效，之后新建的会话立即使用新位置。

## 安装

在应用内用插件管理器安装，或在命令行：

```bash
# npm
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:yusunz/dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session

# 本地 tarball
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session-0.2.0.tgz
```

安装后**重启 DSH**（宿主半代码只在进程启动时加载），随后**硬刷新页面**（Ctrl+Shift+R）以确保取到新的客户端 bundle。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session
```

然后在应用内用插件管理器移除 bundle 并刷新页面。已创建的未分组会话不会被删除。

## 已知限制

- **右侧栏不能承载会话**：DSH 的右侧栏整套注册都绑定「当前会话」，标签页是文件 / 浏览器 / 终端这类面板类型，没有渲染对话面的座位。所以卡片点击后是在**主视图**打开会话，而不是在右栏开一个会话标签页。
- 放弃的空白会话回到未分组后遵循 DSH 原生规则：空白会话在侧栏不可见（有了消息才会作为普通会话显示）。
- 首条消息直接输入即可；附件走原生链路。

## 兼容性

- 目标：DSH 0.2.0 及以上的桌面版与 Web 版。
- 依赖：`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（DSH 自带，随插件声明）。
- 只在 `conversation.input.dock`、`conversation.hero.options`、`settings.general.item`、`sidebar.right.tab.guide.entry` 这类**增量座位**上注册，不替换任何 DSH 原生控件。

## License

MIT

---

## English

Adds **sessions without a workspace** to DeepSeek Harness: one click opens a session that occupies no project workspace while keeping DSH's own composer (model, permissions, attachments, slash commands). The session is temporarily attached to a workspace named after its own directory so the native composer unlocks; after your first message that temporary workspace is removed and the session lands under **Ungrouped**, resumable as usual. Entry points: a button on the hero row and a card on the right sidebar's start page. Each session gets its own `<date>\<time>` working directory; empty ones are reclaimed on the next DSH start, and a directory holding files is never touched. Install with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session`, then restart DSH and hard-refresh the page. MIT.

plugins.description: 装第三方插件之前，先看它会动什么 —— 静态审查一个包的代码能力（执行/读凭据/出网/装时钩子）
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-tool-vet

**装第三方插件之前，先看它会动什么。**

**关键词**：工具审查 · 插件审查 · 装之前先查 · 权限 · 能力枚举 · 供应链安全 · postinstall · 恶意依赖 · 可信度

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：装一个第三方插件/包**之前**，静态审查它**会干什么** —— 执行命令、读敏感路径、往外发数据、装的时候自动跑什么。

**不是**：
- ❌ **不是沙箱** —— 不拦截运行，只做静态审查
- ❌ **不是运行时权限审批** —— 那是另一类工具（市场里已经很多）
- ❌ **不是漏洞库比对** —— 那是 `dsh-dep-audit` 的活
- ❌ **不下「安全 / 不安全」的结论** —— 只列能力，判断留给你

**一句话分界**：**别人是门卫，这个是体检。** 门卫管进出，体检告诉你这个新来的会动什么。

与 `dsh-dep-audit` 的分界：
```
dep-audit  = 查【你自己项目】的【依赖树】
tool-vet   = 审查【一个第三方包本身】的【代码能力】
```

---

## 它查什么（6 条）

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `VET-INSTALL-SCRIPT` | 装了就会自动执行（`preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`）| 🔴 |
| `VET-CRED-PATH` | 代码里出现 `~/.ssh`、`~/.aws`、`~/.npmrc` 等凭据路径 | 🔴 |
| `VET-OBFUSCATION` | 拼接执行 / 超长编码串（MITRE ATT&CK T1027）| 🔴 |
| `VET-OUTBOUND` | 会往网络上发东西 | 🟡 |
| `VET-EXEC` | 会执行外部命令 | 🟡 |
| `VET-DEP-SOURCE` | 依赖来自 registry 之外（`git:` / `http:` / `file:`）| 🟡 |

**每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、那行代码长什么样、依据是什么。**

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-tool-vet
```

## 用法

```bash
# 审查一个本地目录
dsh-tool-vet --root /path/to/some-plugin

# 看内置演示（一个「看着正常、实际会读私钥并外发」的假插件）
dsh-tool-vet --demo

# 列出规则与依据
dsh-tool-vet --list-rules

# 出 HTML 报告
dsh-tool-vet --root /path/to/some-plugin --html
```

---

## 一个真实的例子

`--demo` 审查的那个假插件，描述是「给会话加一个快速笔记面板」，看起来人畜无害。

它会：
```
🔴 装的时候就自动执行 scripts/setup.js
🔴 读 ~/.ssh/id_rsa、~/.aws/credentials、~/.npmrc
🔴 一段 base64 串还原后 new Function() 执行
🟡 catch 网络：往 telemetry.example-collector.net 发 POST
🟡 调 child_process
🟡 依赖从 git 仓库直装，绕过 npm 包名体系
```

**这六条，装之前就能看见。**

---

## 边界

- **只做静态审查** —— 代码里动态拼出来的路径、从网络拉下来的代码，它看不见
- **不判定意图** —— 「读 `.ssh`」是能力，不是罪证。一个 SSH 工具当然要读 `.ssh`，所以报出来是提示你确认，不是判定它有问题
- **覆盖不到依赖内部** —— 它审查的是这一个包自己的代码，不递归进依赖树（那是 `dep-audit` 的范围）
- **判据是「值得警惕的能力」** —— 不是「违规」。所以这里没有法条，依据是官方文档与公开的威胁模型

---


---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [**工具审查**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)
